༄//shis tshig bden pa'i me togasngon gyi byung ba ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i gtam//sngon rabs rgan po dag gi ngag sgros las//sngon gyi lo rgyus ri mor yal nye ba//sngon gyi las 'phro sad pa khyod kyis rnyed//'dan ma'i yul gyi 'das pa'i lo rgyus dag/'dan ma'i rjes rabs rnams kyi spyan snga ru//'dan ma'i blo gsal gzhon nus bstar ba 'di//'dan ma'i deb ther nyid du cis mi 'thad//tshe 'di'i longs spyod dag la mi gnyer zhing // ring lugs stong ba'i sgrog tu ma tshud par//dbang yod blun po'i rnam thar yongs btang ste//phyug po nor la rngams bzhin 'bad 'di gces//gang gi ngo mtshar sor mo'i 'du byed mngon par 'phrul ba'i zlos 1

gar las//nye bar 'khrungs ba'i 'dan ma'i lo rgyus mdzes pa'i stangs stabs bsgyur ba can//blo gsal gzhon nu dga' ba'i skyes su bden pa'i bzhin ras ngom pa na//gzur gnas yongs kyis bsngags pa'i me tog lan brgyar mi gtor rang dbang ci//zhes ban go'am ming gzhan dbyangs can sgeg pa'i blo gros su 'bod pas shis tshig tu spel ba dge'o//

'go brjod/bod kyi lo rgyus ni yun ring zhing 'dzam gling gi mi rigs kun las ches mchog tu gyur cing / cha tshang ba/ lugs mthun pa/kun gyis tshad mar 'dzin chog pa ni smos ma dgos/ spyir lo rgyus la bden don yin par gal po cher 'dzin rgyur sus kyang snyon thabs bral/deng sang bod ces ngos 'dzin byed sa ni gangs ri'i ljongs su gnas shing rang gi yul srol goms gshis gzhan pa'i mi rigs las dmigs bsal ba sngar nas yod par rgyun 'dzin dang gzhan gyis shan ma zhugs pa/ rang gi skad dang yi ge cha tshang ba/ tshul mthun pa/tshad ldan du bed spyod thub mkhan de dag yin pa las/ kha chen pos nga ni bod yin ces za ran dus khrung khrung dkar mo'i ske dang las ran dus mi skyod rdo rje'i sku lta bu byed cing / bod kyi cha lugs goms srol dang bsam pa'i kun slong /'dun pa'i khyer so/ tshe 'di phyi dang las rgyu 'bras sogs ci yang med pa/ gang yang mi shes pa'i ra ma lug gi ngang tshul 'dzin 3

mkhan de dag la mi rigs shi bo'i mi yin pa las de dag rang gi rigs su bzhag tshe rkang 'dren pa/ bla btsong ba/ rang brlag gzhan phung dang 'khrugs rtsod kyi rgyur gyur pa las ma mchis/ da rnyog 'dzing de dag slong ba'i khungs gang yin ce na/ de ni bod rang nyid kyi lo rgyus la 'khyog bshad dang rdzun shan zhugs pa kho nas so//lar mi rigs shig gi lo rgyus la gzhan pa'i mi rigs shig gis go lo thos lo tsam dang sngar gyi deb ther las 'phri snon bsres gsum dang gong smras ra ma lug gi mi'i kha nas ham bshad byas par gzhir bzhag ste bris na don gyis stong la rdzun gyis bslad/ rtsod pa'i rgyur gyur pa ni gong du zhus pa ltar ro/'dir tshe ring dbang phyug mchog gis brtsams pa'i 'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig ces pa ni gong gi skyon dang ring du bral zhing /brjod bde ba dang go sla ba/ khungs btsun pa/ chos tshig dang mngon brjod kyis ma bcing pa/ grub mtha'i phyogs ris dang sa gnas ring lugs kyi phyogs lhung gis g.yag zha bas rtswa 4

bzas pa ltar ma yin pa sogs kyi khyad chos gcig /gnyis su deng gi char bod rig pa zhes 'dzam gling yongs su snyan pa'i ba dan g.yo zhing kun gyis der zhib mo blos rtogs dpyod byed 'dod yod par dpyad gzhi yang dag zhig 'don thub pa ni/ rtsom pa pos dngos su mig mthong lag zin gyi yul du gyur cing gong smras khungs btsun dang bden don dngos su bkod pa sogs kyis so/gsum du nye ba'i char ljongs rgyu rig gnas yar ngos zla ltar 'phel bzhin yod par dmigs na/ sa gnas de ga'i ljongs rgyu'i gnas yig tshad ldan zhig tu gyur cing rgyal khyab phyi nang du yul de'i srid 'byor rig gsum dang mi tshul rig gnas/ ljongs kyi bkod pa bcas dngos su 'dren byed yul du legs skyes su phul thub pa bcas khyad chos du mas phyug pas rjes su yi rangs dang deb 'di legs bskrun thub pa'i smon 'dun bcas dge ming ye shes don grub kyis dar mdo nas phul ba dge//5

dkar chagadang po/sa'i snod kyi bkod pa/ (1)gnyis pa/gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung yig las 'dan ma brjod pa'i skor/ (6)'dan ma'i sku mkhar/ (10)gsum pa/ 'dan ma'i dpon khag skor gyi lo rgyus raṭa tsam brjod pa/ (14)〈1〉a sdug tshang / (17)〈2〉g.yas thog tshang / (19)〈3〉gzim dpon yar log tshang / (22)〈4〉churdo tshang / (22)〈5〉gzim dpon mar log tshang / (23)〈6〉dran khog tshang / (23)〈7〉dil 'go tshang / (24) 13

'dan marī zhabs kyis bcags pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi lo rgyus mdor bsdus/ (26)〈1〉lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje/ (26)〈2〉'dan ma rtse mang (27)〈3〉zhu chen tshul khrims rin chen/ (28)〈4〉tā la'i bla ma sku phreng dgu pa lung rtogs rgya mtsho/ (29)〈5〉dpal sprul 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po/ (30)〈6〉'ju mi pham 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal rgya mtsho/ (31)〈7〉karma pa sku phreng bcu drug pa rje rang byung rig pa'i rdo rje/ (33)〈8〉dil 'go mkhyen brtse rin po che/ (36)〈9〉 bla ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ (37)〈10〉 karma zhwa dmar pa/ (39)bzhi pa/'dan ma'i rgyal khab las byed pa dang mi sna 'jon thang can/ (40)〈1〉ye shes don grub/ (40)〈2〉dkon mchog lha dar/ (44) 14

〈3〉tshe lo/ (45)〈'a 〉ngag lo/ (45)〈5〉karma don 'grub/ (47)〈6〉rdzong rim pa khag gi 'go khrid/ (47)〈7〉chus zhang khag gi 'go khrid/ (50)〈8〉las ka gzhan dag gi mi sna 'jon thang can/ (53)'dan ma mchog sprul sku phreng rim byon gyi rnam thar mdor bsdus/ (54)lnga pa/ 'dan sgrol ma lha khang / (93)mdo stod 'dan ma'i thub bstan slob gling / (100)'dan ma dgon pa'i gnas tshul gsal ba'i re'u mig (109)'dan ma'i dus chen skor/ (111)〈1〉'dan ma'i bod kyi lo gsar/ (111)〈2〉 'dan ma'i smon lam/ (114)〈3〉 sgrol ma'i gter dbang / (115)〈'a 〉'dan ma'i rta rgyugs dus chen/ (116)'dan ma'i gnyen ston/ (118)15

'dan ma'i rgyan gos/ (122)'dan ma'i bro chen/ (127)'dan ma'i bza' btung g.yos sbyor skor/ (134)drug pa/ pad ma ri'i gnas bshad/ (137)'dan ma'i nyin phyogs gnas kyi bshad pa/ (154)rma mgrin dang dung lung nang bar gyi gnas bshad/ (163)dran thang dang lo ltas sgrub phug ra dkram brag sogs kyi gnas bshad/ (173)gnyan yab gzhis bsam grub pho brang dang de'i phyogs kyi gnas phran bskor/ (182)mtha' rgyan rang byung 'gyur med rol dbyangs/ (202) 16

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig sa'i snod kyi bkod pa/stod kyi mnga' ris bskor gsum rdzing gi tshul//bar du dbus gtsang ru bzhi yur ba 'dra//smad du mdo khams sgang drug zhing lta bu//kun kyang chu yi rgya mtshor gyur pa'i ma/nga //mtsho de 'khol ba zhi zhing rab tu bsil//kong gi chu brlag ces bya'i zom bye bas//ru bzhi chu yis gang ba de ru thim//chu gzhan dag kyang de ltar thim pa yis//bod khams yul gyi rnam pa gsal por dod//ces sngon gyi yig tshang du ma'i nang gsal ba ltar dang thog bod yul stod smad bar gsum thams cad chu yis yongs su gang ba'i rgya mtsho chen po zhig yin pa dang / de nas rim bzhin kong chu brlag kha bye nas chu rnams der thim ste bod yul gyi sa khams dbyibs kyi gzugs brnyan gsal po 'bur zhing / de nas 'gro ba mi'i rigs byung ba nas rim gyis 'phel ba dang / ngal rtsol 1

'dan ma'i lo byus gser gyi 'od thig thon skyed dal 'bab kyi rgyun bzhin byas te grong dang grong tshom/grong rdal la sogs pa rim par chags shing / yul yar klung gi lha ri gyang tho yi rtser byung pa'i mgo nag gdong dmar bod kyi rgyal po dang po gnya' khri btsan po byon pa brgyud gdung rgyud zam mi chad pa sprin lam yongs pa mthil gyi sgra can bzhin pa'i chos kyi rgyal po chen mo 'phags pas rnam par sprul ba'i skyes mchog bcu phrag bzhi dang gnyis byung te bsil ldan kha ba'i ljongs su chos sring kyi kha lo bsgyur/ sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dag gi rnam par sprul pa'i mkhas grub bsam gyis mi khyab pa gnam gyi ka ba lta bu rim par byon nas/ snyigs ma'i dus su ston pa thugs rje can rang nyid kyis gsal bar lung bstan pa ltar/sā la'i sman ljongs bhoṭa chen po ru mi mjed bdag po'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad do/ de lta bu'i bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'di la/ stod mnga' ris skor gsum/ bar dbus gtsang ri bzhi/ smad mdo khams sgang drug gam/ dbus gtsang chos kyi chol kha mdo stod mi'i chol kha/ mdo smad rta'i chol 2

'dan ma'i lo byus gaber gyi 'od dzig kha zhes yongs su grags pa las/skabs su bab pa'i brjod bya ni/bod chol kha gsum gyi bar ma/ smad mdo khams sgang drug gi ya gyal tsha ba sgang gi cha gtogs/ bstan pa'i gnas chen bcu drug gi yan lag gnas rten nags la gnas sam pad ma ri bo'i mdun ngos su phyogs bzhi rab dkar shel gyi rdul brtsegs kyis nor 'dzin dga' ma'i mtha' ru rdo rje'i lcags ri tshar du dngar ba bskor pa dang mtshungs pa'i gnas mchog 'dan ma grags pa 'phags pa'i gdul bya ru bde 'byung dbang phyug chen pos lung bstan pa/ nang bstan yar ngos zla ba'i lang tsho mchog tu dar ba'i phu nu sum cu pa'i ya gyal tsha zhang 'dan ma'i bzhugs gnas su smras pas 'dan ma zhes ming du chags pa dang / 'bri zog zhig gi sna nyag lta bu chu khungs nas phyogs thams cad kyi chu phran mu bzhin 'bab te chu chen grub pas 'bri chu/ g.yu 'brug sngon mo gar du rtsen pa'i 'gros kyis 'dan ma nyin phyogs dang srid phyogs dgar nas gzhung brgyud cing shar phyogs su 'khyog pa dang / gnas chen pad ma ri bo'i g.yas nas thon zhing rim 3

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig bzhin 'bri chu 'khyog pa la klong chu dang / g.yon nas bgrod de 'bri chur 'dres pa la spam chu bcas bgrod lugs kyis 'dan ma'i sa gzhi'i dbyibs ni byu ru brgyad ma lag ya'i rgyan la bzhag 'dra'o/de lta bu'i gnas yid du 'ong bar sa le sbram gyi phye ma 'dres pa'i dal 'bab 'bri chu sngon ma'i phyogs gnyis su grangs las 'das pa'i gnas ri dang gnas ri'i phreng bas bskor zhing /dkyil la gzhal thabs bral ba'i ljang mdog gi lwa ba thang la khebs 'dra'i nas zhing sha stag dang / dri med gsom dkar ljon pa tshar du dngar ba'i lha yi dmag dpung g.yul du chas pa dang 'dra ba/ lha shing shug pa rab tu rgyas pas nam mkha'i mthongs yangs sgril ba byed pa'i tshal du/ dpyid kyi pho nya khu byug gzhon nus snyan 'jebs drug 'gyur gyi ngag la brtson/ ne'u gsing du bya bye'u sna tshogs kyis nyan dga' ba'i bod ljongs nang ma'i gdangs kyi rjes su 'brangs/ 'gyur khug bdun rdzogs pa'i 'jol mos khengs pa'i tshul gyis glu dbyangs len pa/ spu sdug gi 4

'dan ma'i lo rgyas gser gyi 'od jig ri dwags rna ba dang rgo ba/ shwa ba gla ba sogs kyis 'dzad med kyi rtswa chu la longs su spyod nas bag phebs kyis gnas 'dug pa/ phu mtha' med pa'i spang ljongs ne'u gsing gi g.yu lo thags su bkra ba/ kha dog sna lnga'i me tog phon po la ra yig gnyis pa'i 'du 'god kyi rtsed 'jo dar dir dbyings su len pa/ dwangs shing bsil pa'i dal 'bab kyi ngos su 'dab chags dkar bo'i khyu tshogs kyis mgrin rnga snyan dgur 'khrol ba/ da dung gser dngul zangs lcags dang zha ne sogs kyi thon khungs legs pa/ lhag par du shwa rwa gla rtsi/ dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu sogs sman rdzas rtsa chen bcas grangs las 'das pas rnam thos sras kyi bang mdzod mi yul du spo bar som nyi za ba/ gang zag yongs kyi spro gseng byed sa'i lha'i dga' tshal gnyis pa'i yul bzhin gyur te/ ma btabs rang skyes kyi ljon pa/ /ma bos rang thon gyi srog chags/ /ma bsdus rang byung gi gter kha//ma thus gya nom gyi sman rigs/ /bcas sa'i zlum pa'i dngos po thams cad ma lus par 'dzoms/mdor na/ 5

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig de lta bu'i dge bcu tshang ba'i yul la//bsam don gyi sbrang char 'bab//bsod nams kyi me tog bzhad//longs spyod kyi ge sar rgyas//dgos 'dod kyi 'bras bu smin/gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung yig las 'dan ma brjod pa skor/dang po/ tsha zhang 'dan ma byang khra/nga dang nga ngo ma shes na// chu ra skyid pa'i mar nang na// nya bu skyid pa'i yar nang nas// 'dan ma lha khang ring mo nas// shar lung ri drug mkhar nang nas// tsha zhang 'dan ma zhang khra yin// tsha zhang mig dang 'bras bu yin// tsha zhang mgo dang ske mgul yin//tsha zhang lus dang grib ma yin// tsha zhang ber dang phu thung yin// tsha zhang mar dkar spu lu de// me nyi ma min pa kun la mdzes tsha zhang ras dkar lhan pa de// sbra re ba min pa kun la mkho// tsha 6

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig zhang byang tshwa dkar po de// chang mchod me min pa kun la mkho//〈hor gling g.yul 'gyed/〉shog grangs 33(mtsho sngon/)nga 'dra nga ngo ma shes na// rma yul gling khri gong ma nas//'dan ma chu la nyin srib zer// 'dan yar lung gser gyi mkhar gcig yod// mar lung dngul gyi sgo mo yod// bar lung dung gi lde mig yod// 'dan g.yu rdzong lha mkhar ring mo nas// g.yu 'brug bzhin du grags le de// nga 'dan ma khri btsan bsam grub yin//dpon nyi ma 'dra ba'i gong blon yin// dgra ma thub steng gi shi bdud yin// gnyen khra mo'i steng gi rgya dar yin// nga 'dan ma ngar ngar stag ngar yin// cha med kun la grags le yin// nga 'dan ma mar grags rgya la grags// rgya nag ri bo'i chos rdzong na//bu 'dan ma zer nas grags shing yod// yar grags pa pho brang dbus la grags// pho brang ga'u dgu rtseg na// bu 'dan ma zer nas grags shing yod/ /phar grags spur rgyal bod la grags/ /phyug po lha rdzong nyi ma la//bu 'dan ma zer nas grags shing yod/ / nga 7

'dan ma'i lo khyus gser gyi 'od thig yin rgyu rgod po de 'dra yin// za hor rgyal po'i rgyal rgyud yin//g.yu 'phru dmag gi mgo 'dzin yin//〈mon gling g.yul 'gyed〉kyi shog grangs 119(mtsho sngon)gnyis pa/ 'dan ma'i nas rdzong /dmag khri skor brgyad kyi sa cha la// shar rlung ri yi rdzong drug nas// 'dan ma nas rdzong rgyal po zer// ri zhing po ti brtsegs 'dra yod// thang zhing shog skya bkram 'dra yod// sked zhing thel rtse btab 'dra yod// sngon mo 'bru yi 'byung khungs yin// seng khri nas kyi bla ma yod// a sdug nas kyi grwa pa yod// sngon mo nas kyi bu mo yod// 'bru mkhar nas kyi bu tsha yod// sder yag nas kyi pha rgan yod// 'grang rgyas nas kyi ma rgan yod// dmar nyil 'bru yi zhang po yod// mon mkhar 'bru yi tsha mo yod// kha ra 'bru yi g.yog mo yod// skya mdzangs bang ba dgu brgya yod// nas rdzong sum cu so lnga yod// nga nas rdzong rgyal po de nas thob//〈mon gling g.yul 'gyid〉〉kyi shog grangs 179(mtsho sngon)da lta'i dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul ser shul 8

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od dzig rdzong nas lho nub phyogs su le dbar bdun cu'i ring du 'dan khog gam 'dan ma zhig brjod pa'i yul de ni sngon chad tsha zhang 'dan mas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor sa dang srid kyi kha lo bsgyur gnas yin pa grags pas/ deng skabs su 'dan ma'i mkhar dkar dang mkhar dmar gyi zhig shul 'dren byed kyi lam du khyad mtshar can mngon 'dug da dung khong dgung lo brgyad dang bcu drug gi 'thab rmog che chung gnyis kyang 'dan ma'i yul gyi shug ra dgon dang ka phud dgon du nang rten gyi tshul du nyar tshags byas yod/'dir 'dan ma nas rdzong zhes brjod pa ni yul gyi gnam gshis dro grang yag la sa dpyad bzang zhing sngon ljang 'go dud kyi snye ma sngon nas 'debs srol yod pa dang shin tu skye stobs che pa ma zad gling gi skabs su 'bru rigs kyi thon khungs gtso bo yin pa smras pas ming de thogs pa 'dra'o/ 9

'dan ma'i lo byus gaber gyi 'od thig 'dan ma'i sku mkhar/gser gyi bye ma 'dres pa'i gtsang po g.yon zur nas dal gyi bab la khams kyi gnas chen pad ma ri bo rgyab tu 'gying zhing /glang thang sgrol ma lha khang nas spyi le lnga tsam gyi char/ shar lung ri drug gi dkyil du/ rgya che la sra mkhregs can gyi mkhar shul de ni 'phags yul gyi dpal grub chen sa ra ha yi rnam 'phrul/ gling gi phu nu sum cu dang yang thul dam pa mi bdun gyi ya gyal gling rje ge sar rgyal po'i nang blon te dpal tsha zhang 'dan ma byang khra'i sku mkhar gyi shul yin/ dpa' pho tsha zhang 'dan ma ni gnas 'dir nar son pa dang / chung ming la tsha rgyal zhu ba grags/ yul 'dir khong gis khyad mtshar can gyi mda' rtags kyang mang po bzhag yod/ khong dgung lo che ba dang rim bzhin mda' rtsal sogs slob nas srid gsum grags pa phyogs mtha' bral pas dbyar skyes rnga'i sgra'ang nyams pa'i dpa' bo zhig tu gyur/rjes su khong gis gling dang 'brel ba mdzad nas rang nyid ge sar rgyal 10

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od jig po'i nang blon dang / de nas bzung gling gi 'thab mo skabs khong gis byas rjes ma bzhag sa dang dpa' kha ma len sa med pa dang /der brten mi rabs nas mi rabs song na'ang bod gangs can pa yongs kyis dpa' bo dam pa'i mtshan snyan de dus gtan du brjed mi srid pa ma tshad da dung yang 〈gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung 〉dang mnyam du 'dzam gling gi sgang la grags dang grags bzhin pa yin/ de lta bu'i dpa' bo dam pa de'i sku mkhar gyi kha zheng la smin nyi shu lhag dang mkhar sgo nub phyogs 'khor yod pa 'dra/ mkhar 'di ni gyang las grub pa dang lo mang song stabs kyang phal bo che zhig zin na'ang brtsigs rmis dang mtho tshad brtsegs gcig man gyi gyang ni ha cang sra mkhregs can zhig tu gyur/ mkhar 'di'i mtha' bskor du g.yu 'brug 'khyil ba'i gad pa zer ba'i mtho tshad 'dom gang lhag tsam gyi sa dong bskos nas bzhag 'dugagayas zur gyi thog la 'dan shug ra skyid kyi dgon pa dang /pho brang gi gsham du 'dan ka phu skyid kyi dgon pa chags yod pa 11

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od jig dang /ka phu skyid kyi dgon pa 'di la de sngar 'dan ma'i khrab dang rmog mda'/gzhu/ sag thag mdung bcas cha tshang ba yod pa/ lo rgyus kyi bden dpang yod la dngos rdzas kyi rin thang mchis pa'i gna' shul gyi yo byad de dag dus 'gyur gyi skabs su brlag zin/da ltar 'dan ma'i rmog de ka phu skyid kyi dgon pa'i nang rten du nyar tshags byas yod/gling rje ge sar rgyal po dang khong gi phu bo rgya tsha zhal dkar/ blon 'dan ma gsum gyi rmog ldug byed kyi lcags rgyu gcig yin pa dang / ge sar dang rgya tsha'i rmog la gser yig yod pa/'dan ma'i rmog la gser yig med pa bcas sgrung yig las gsal ba bzhin 'di la'ang gser yig sogs mi gsal lo/'dan ma'i sku mkhar rgyab kyi gnas mchog pad+ma ri yi steng la 'dan mas tshe yi lha tshogs sgrub nas 'grub pa'i phug pa yod pa dang / phug pa'i mdun nas 'dan mas gter blangs pa'i chu 'gro ba 'dren pa bzhud bzhin yod pa de 'thung na tshe ring ba'i phan yon ldan zer pas nye 'dabs kyi yul mis khur ba ma tshad yul gzhan du'ang khur nas 'thung bzhin yod/ de'i nye gnas su 12

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig 'dan ma'i nas rdzong phab shul brjod ba'i lung pa de nas rde'u nas 'dra ba zhig dus rgyun chad med par zhud bzhin mchis/nas rdzong zer brjod don de'i rnam pa kho na ma yin la/ spyi btang 'dan khog 'di'i nyin srib tshang ma'i ri bo'i ngos zur dag la sa leb mo lag mthil tsam la'ang zhing rmos shul dang zhing rwa las shul sogs yod pa la bltas na zhing las thon skyed thad du ha cang brtson pa dang / gling dang thag nye ba'i phyir gling la'ang 'bru rigs skyel 'dren byed bzhin pa dang / nas rdzong yang skabs der 'bru rigs 'bor che gling la 'dren pa dang gling gi 'bri rigs 'ong khungs gtso bo yin pas nas rdzong zhes grags pa 'dra'o/'dan sras g.yu 'od kyi g.yu mkhar smug po'ang da lta'i 'dan chos 'khor dgon gyi nang du yod/ 'dan khra bo la yi man chad ka phu skyid kyi yan chad la dbang bsgyur ba'i 'dan khrims skor bcu gnyis kyi dpon po de rim bzhin gling dpa' thul sum cu'i yang rtser gyur nas lo ngo brgya phrag mang po'i ring la dpa' 13

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig bo'i mtshan snyan je grags su gyur pa dang / dang/'a bo'i mkhar shul de'ang lo de tsam gyi ring yongs su ma 'jigs nas je sra dang je mdzes shig tu gyur te 'jig rten khams la yang lta byas nas dgrongs nge 'gying 'duga'adan khog dpon khag skor gyi lo rgyus rags tsam brjod pa/spyi lo 842lor bod chen po'i rgyal po khri dar ma 'u dum btsan lha lung dpal rdor gyis sku bgrongs rjes/ bod btsan po'i gdung rgyud kyis gangs ljongs la srid kyi kha lo bsgyur pa'i mjug rdzogs shing / snyan pa grags pa'i bod chen po'i rgyal khams de kha 'thor dgu 'thor sil bu zhig tu gyur pas/ bod kyi lo rgyus rnams su skabs der bod sil bu'i dus skabs zhes brjod cing /de'ang khams phyogs 'dan mar chos lugs grub mtha' sna tshogs kyi dgon sde dang yul sde byams kyis skyong pa'i dpon rigs drag zhan mang po byung zhing / re re bzhin brjod par ma nus pas 14

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig 'dir bod khams phyogs sde dge rgyal po'i lo rgyus su bkod yod pa dang spyi tshogs yul sder khyab gdal che pa'i dpon mi 'ga'i byung ba mtshon tsam zhig brjod par/bod chen po rgyal khams sil bur 'thor rjes 'dan yul yang 'dan khra bo la man chad dang ka phu skyid yan chad la dpa' tsha zhang 'dan mas bdag bzung mdzad pa dang de'i rjes 'dan sras g.yu 'od nyid g.yu mkhar smug por bzhugs nas yul sde'i sa khungs 'dir srid kyi kha lo bsgyur zhing las kyi thabs lam bkod pa/dus de dag gi sngon du 'dan ya lung khri ka rgyal po dang ma lung za hor rgyal po gnyis kyis srid skyong ba dang 'dan ma yang za hor rgyal rgyud yin pa grags/ rim bzhin 'dan yul 'di dpon phyogs gnyis kyi 'bangs shig tu gyur/ glang chu yan chad dang khra bo la man chad kyi sde mi thams cad khams phyogs kyi yul dpon grags can chos srid gang thad du 'phrin las che zhing bod kyi lo rgyus steng shugs rkyen chen po yod pa'i sde dge rgyal po'i mnga' 'og tu yin la/glang chu man chad kyi sa kha shas ni gling 15

'dan ma' lo khyus gser gyi 'od thig tshang rgyal pos bzung / sde dge rgyal pos yul sde'i khyad chos dang gnas bab kyi chab srid bcas su gzhigs te gnas 'dir gzim dpon khag bdun bskos ba red/ yin na yang dang thog nas dpon khag bdun bskos pa ma yin par re re bzhin mi shes yon can dang rgyal gces kyi 'du shes ldan pa/ las gnyer gyi 'jon thang yod pa dag la dbang cha'i dpon sa gnang ba/skabs de la'ang dpon khag gzhan yod par 'dan chu srib phyogs kyi dpon ni chab mdo dpon nas mngags gtong gnang pa'i yab gzhes bsam 'grub pho brang nang gi dpon po rim byon dang / de bzhin nyin phyogs su rdza chu kha'i ka phu dpon gyis dbang bsgyur ram lta skyong mdzad mkhan te da ltar sprul sku bstan pa 'phel rgyas mtshan gsol pa zhig rdza chu khar yod pa lags dpon tshang 'di'i rus rgyud yin pa grags/ 'dam thog tu'ang bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas mngags pa'i 'dam thog dpon zhes dpon phran zhig gda'/ de dag khag ming tsam dang mi phal ba las cung zad mi 'dra pa'i 'tsho ba'i dbang cha ldan pa ma 16

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig gtogs phyis su shugs che shos ni gzim dpon khag bdun gyi dbang du yod/ dang po/a sdug tshang /hor khog a sdug tshang bu tshe dbang phun tshogs zer ba zhig yod pa de sde dge rgyal po'i sras tshab tu nyar/ rim bzhin bu tshe dbang phun tshogs dkar mdzes khang gsar tshang la mag pa song mod/ 'on kyang / khang gsar dpon po'i sras mo dang ma mthun pas sde dger phyi log/ slad du sde dge dpon pos gzim dpon du bskos te 'dan yul du mngags par sde dge mdun khag 'og ma'i ril nas/ zer ba de'i bu mo skal bzang chos sgron bag ma bsus te gzhis chags pa las khong gnyis su sras bzhi dang sras mo gnyis 'khrungs pa sras che ba 'jo mda' rlabs bo gdong rdzong dgon pa'i sprul sku gdong rdzong rin po che dang / sras gnyis pa rdza khro zab dgon pa'i sprul sku drel dkar rin po che/ sras gsum pa dpal rgyal ba'i dbang po 7karma pa sku phreng bcu drug pa rig pa'i rdo rje 'chang / sras bzhi pa ni khams rdzogs chen dgon pa'i sprul sku rdzogs chen dpon slob rin po che bcas skad grags kyi 17

'dan ma'i le rgyus gser gyi 'od thig —rdza rnga phyogres kun khyab pa'i sras bzhi 'khrungs/ sras mo gnyis las che ba gzhon dus nas rgyal dbang 7karma pa dakhu mnyam du dbus la phebs ba dang / chung ba tshe dbang sgrol ma sde dger yun ring bzhugs te skabs bab kyi tsag tsig gi bya ba'i zhor du rgal bral seng she'i mjing bsnol bzhin dam bca' nges narnga shrī pha rol du phyin pa'i theg pa dang gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la nyams len mdzad/ spyi lo 1970lor mi nyag btson khang du dgongs pa chos dbyings su bsdus shing sku 'ja' lus grub song pas gzugs phung gru gang las ma lhag ces grags/rgyal pa'i sras po de dag las drel dkar sprul sku ma gtogs gzhan gsum po rab byung gi rten bzhes/ drel dkar sprul sku 'jig rten mthun 'jug gi las su zhugs te sde dge gro ma tshang gi sras mo phun tshogs dbang mo khab tu bzhengs te sras gnyis 'khrungs/ che ba 'jigs med dang chung ba rgyal dbang karma pa zhwa dmar rin po che da ska bas phyi rgyar bzhugs yod pa de lags so/de skabs a sdug tshang dpal 'byor dang stobs mnga' thang 18

— 'danama'elo rgyus gserngo gye 'od big bod chol kha gsum du grags pa zhig tu gyur yod/ khral pa dang 'u lag ma 'bod rang bzhin gyi 'dus pa'i dus kyang byung / dus der g.yog po g.yog mo grangs brgya 'dus pa yod la sa zhing dang mnga' 'khor gzhal pa dka' la sgo phyugs kyang bgrang gis mi langs/yab chen tshe dbang phun tshogs kyi dus su hor khog tu dar rgyas dgon pa dang be ri dpon gnyis srid dbang thang du rtsod 'khrug byung skabs yab chen gyis rgya dmag rang gi pho brang du gab bcugs/ pa la dar rgyas dargon pas shes te a sdug tshang gi gzhis ka la me btang nas gsog 'jog byas pa'i rgyu nor ma nga phyogs brlag 'joms kyang / 'jig/ rten gyi yod rgu la sun snang ma skyes pa'i yab chen gyis thabs dang shes rab la brten nas sngar las rgyas zhing 'thus tshang pa'i gzhal yas pho brang zhig kyang bzhings par da lta'ang 'u/sa yod pa'o/gnyis pa/g.ya sa bog tshang/rgyal dbang lnga pa'i sngon du 'dan khog tu grags che pa'i sa bdas gi gral zhig tu yin pa dang / rgyal dbang lnga nga 'i r+ṣa /baṭatrī/ 1sbyo

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gaber gyi 'od jig srid dbang du shugs rkyen thebs pa'i yul dpon stobs shugs che shos shig kyang yin/skabs der g.yas thog dpon gyis gong sa 7lnga pa la bde dgongs dgon pa dang nye 'gram du mngon pa'i bka' brgyud kyi dgon pa shi ru ma gnyis phul pas/ khong gi 'khor dang bcas pa sngon nas thob dang go sa mtho ru phebs te yun ring du dar rgud spel ma rgyud pa'i chos dang sbrags nas bgrang bya brgya tsam du yul 'khor 'dir chos srid kyi kha lo bsgyur/nye rabs g.yas thog tshang gi sras mo nyin zhig ri la spro gseng phyin skabs dpyid kyi dpal yon mngon pa'i skal bzang 'phrad pas/ spang la me tog rgyan pa dang rlung la dri bzang 'khod pa/gnam la sprin dkar 'khrigs/ gsung la khu byug thos/ gnam sa gnyis kha dog lnga'i spud pa'i 'ja' tshon gyis 'brel gtug bgyis/sras mo yid dgyes nas me tog ser can bkra pa'i spang ngos su ngal gso tshul gyis lus gan kyal gyi nyal nas gnyid song bas rmi lam du gzhi bdag khams gsum dbang phyug gi sprul pa mi rta nag bzhon pa zhig dang 'grogs pa rmis/ de nas bzung lus 20

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig khams sbrum bar zla ngo dgu lon dus skyes gzugs mtshar la rig pa rno zhing drang pa'i bu tshe dbang rab brtan sku bltams/ bu bzang 'di'i dus su g.yas thog tshang sngar las stobs rgyu nor gyi longs spyod rgyas pa byung nas sde dge'i mnga' 'og gi dgon sde yongs la sbyin pa'i bdag po mdzad/ rjes su sde dge rgyal po'i phyag mdzod chen mo'ang gyur/phyag mdzod tshe dbang rab brtan la bu gsum dang bu mo gcig yod pa bu rgyal mtshan la gzim dpon mar log tshang gi bu mo sgrol dkar bag mar bsus nas bu gsum dang bu mo gnyis skyes/ bu che ba bshad sgrub ni bde dgongs dgon la yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi mtshams bzhugs nas yi dam nyid zhal gzigs thob myong ba'i bla ma byang chub kyi rnam sprul ngos 'dzin bgyis pa grags/khong nyid phyis su 'dan khog rdzong gi srid gros las khungs su sku 'das/ bu 'bring ba stobs dga' rnyog 'dzing che pa'i dus 'gyur gyi dus rim nang du bkrongs ba dang /chung ba dbang dga' da ltar ser shul rdzong 'dan mar yod pa'o/

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig gsum pa/gzim dpon ya ra 'o ga tshang /dus kyi 'gros legs nyes dang bstun nas da ra rgud mthud ma mang tsam byung yod pa dang / nye rabs su rdza dpal sprul rin po che'i sbyin bdag phur ba 'phrin las kyis hor khog a sdus/ chang gi bu mo zhig mna' ma bsu sa nas bu gsum skyes/ bu 'bring ba bkra shis dge legs rdza dpal sprul gyi sku mdun nas rab byung gi dge slong sdom pa zhus ba dang 〈gtam pad ma tshal gyi zlos gar 〉〉nang du kho'i mi tshe hril por myong pa'i 'jig rten 'khor pa'i sdug bsngal brjod yod la gser sbrang gi dpe gzhi'ang khong yin pa dang / bgrang bya 'ga'i slad du bo/ nga btson khang du sku 'das/ che ba bsod nams dpal ldan dus zing gi nang du sku bkrongs pa dang chung ba thub dga' bal yu la du phyin pa'o/ba ni pa/chu rdo tshang/yang gong ltar dar rgud rgyun med kyi dus rim mang po zhig brgyud mtha' mi drag chen po zhig yo da nga/ des/ (moḥn mi gsal)sde dge phyos/sa yongs kyi dgron sde dag latshosbyon/ bdag bud/ nger

'angan ma 'i'o4sagarduragyi'odathig da wabu thub bstan zer ba zhig skyes te lo na son rjes g.yas thog tshang gi bu mo g.yu sgron bag la bsus te bu khro dga' dang bu mo pad+ma mtsho gnyis skyes/ khro dga' phyi rgyal la phebs pa dang bu mo pad+ma lha mtsho 'dan stod sum pa tshang la ga/zhis chags nas bu sku chen bsod nams seṅge 'khrungs/ da ltar ser shul rdzong du bzhugs yod/lnga pa/gzim dpon mar log tshang /gzim dpon mar log tshang dang a sdug tshang gnyis thab gcig gi dud tshang bzhin 'brel ba bzang pas phal cher gcig gyur mngon/ drin lan gzha'/ pa dka' pa'i bcings pa grol mkhas kyi dmag mi bod du ma phebs pa'i sngon du 'di'ang mnga' 'bangs longs spyod 'dzoms pa'i dpon khag cig yin/ nye rabs su ma rgan tshe dbang sgrol dkar gyis mnga' 'khor skyong pa dang mor bu mo gnyis yod de che ba lo gzhon dus nas 'chi ba dang chung ba jo rje g.yu sgron zer ba da lta lha sar yod pa 'dra'o/drug pa/drad+dha khog tshang/gong sa 7lnga pa'i sngon la stobs dang 'byor phyug ldan pa'i 23

'dan ma'i lo byus gser gyi 'od dzig dpon phran zhig red zer/ nye dus su dran khog 'bar rdo zer ba'i mi skad grags can zhig dar ba rjes su zi ling go min tang mar pu'u h+phang dpung dmag gis bsad de la bu khra leb dgon pa'i sprul sku khra leb skyabs mgon 'khrungs pa dang / bu mo tshe lo zer ba zhig yod pa des sde dge'i mdun khag cig nas bu bsod rgyal zer ba de mag bsus te bu gsum skyes/ bu che ba 'dan mkha' 'go dgon pa'i sprul sku dang / 'bring ba dang chung ba gnyis da ltar bde mo ngang 'dan yul la 'tsho ba rol bzhin no/bdun pa/dil 'go tshang /dil 'go tshang ni 'dan ma'i srib phyogs 'bar lung 'dabs la chags zhing dus rabs sngar mo'i dpon rgyud kyi khyim tshang che po zhig yin la nye rabs su dil 'go pad nor zer ba zhig 'dan ma chu nyin srib tu skad grags kyi ba dan kun gsal yongs su g.yo ba rtags dang rdzu 'phrul gyis mtshan nas skyes/ sde dge'i mnga' 'og gi dgon sde thams cad du sbyin bdag bud pa dang sde dge rgyal po'i phyag mdzod kyang mdzad/ khong yang 'ju mi 94

'dan ma'i lo thas gaber gyi 'od thig pham mchog gi sbyin bdag rol ba dang / g.yas thog tshang gi bu mo (mtshan ma rnyed pa)khab tu bzhes nas sras bu srid gsum la 'gran zla 'os ba'i sngags rnying pa'i skyes chen dam pa dil 'go mkhyen brtse rin po che sku 'khrungs/ gangs ris ra ba bskor pa'i bod ljongs su nyi brgya'i dkyil 'khor bzhin bstan pa'i 'od zer sa gzhi ma lus khyab bo/'dan ma'i dpon khag gi nye rabs lo rgyus rags bsdus 'di britsho ba la sngon gyi yig tshang nyung ngu dang yul sde'i bgres po rgan lo bdun cu yan dang 'dan yul gyi lo rgyus zhib 'jug byed bzhin pa'i bla sprul rnams kyis zhal brjod tshul du rten nas bris pas nor 'khrul mi nyung ba zhig yod nges pas dpyad ldan mkhas pa rnams kyis yo bsrang gnang ba zhu zhu/

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od this 'dan ma la zhabs kyis bcags cing byin gyis brlabs pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyilo rgyus mdor bsdus/lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje/khong ni spyi lo'i dus rabs brgyad pa'i dus dkyil tsam du 'brom stod gung mo cher sku 'khrungs/ skya ming stag nya bzab zer/rgya bod kyi mtshams bsrungs te pha rol gyi rgol ba can rnams btul bar lan gcig go cha phud pa'i rmog gi nang du tog gi gzungs bzhugs pa bklags pas/ bra nye la ni gang skyes pa/ /rkang mthil rme ba dmar po can/ /shi nas dmyal bar skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes bris pa mthong nas rang gi mthil la bltas pas rme ba dmar po cig 'dug gzhan la bklag tu bcug pas kyang de bzhin du snang zer bas/ khong gi yab mched gnyis dang / spun gsum pa bcas bsam yas parnyi ta la bzhugs pa'i rtsar phyin/bi ma la mi tra las rab tu byung / pad+ma sam+bha wa las byang chub 2 6

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig sems dpa'i sdom pa blangs shing sngags kyi dbang dang gdams ngag thams cad thob ste/ grib kyi dkar mo rong dang yer pa bcas bzhugs nas sgrub pa nyams len mdzad pas ri brag la thogs pa med pa zang thal du gshegs par nus pa'i rdzu 'phrul dang dngos grub brnyes te/ 〈grub mtha' shel gyi me long 7las/ dpal gyi rdo rje ri brag thogs pa med/ ces gsungs so/ dus phyiṭaṭa su rgyal po glang dar ma bgrongs nas 'dan yul dung grong du phebs te rigs gsum mgon pa'i gnas dang po gnas sgo/ phyes pa/ slad du khong yang 'dan ma'i gnas rtsa chen mang grags su byon nas gnas sgo phye ba dang sgom sgrub mdzod pa/ rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i rtogs brjod du gsung par dgung grangs kyang brgya yas mas su bzhugs pa 'dra/ khong ni grub thob rje dang 'bangs nyer lnga'i nang gi ya gyal zhig yin no/'dan ma rtse mang /①khong ni spyi lo'i dus rabs brgyad pa'i dus dkyil tsam du ——da ①/〈jeḍā ༵rno'e khas grub rim byon ming mdzod〉la sa 'di lta ra brjod pa dang / de'i nang ldan ma rtse ma nga 'er brir yo da pa/27

'dan ma'i lo byus gser gyi 'od jig 'dan ma'i dben thang du sku 'khrungs/ khong yi ge 'bri ba la shin tu mkhas pas gter yig phal cher bris shing yig gzugs kyi lag rgyun ma nyams pa'i khrid srol da lta'ang yod par grags/ lo tsā ba yang mkhyen te mchan bu'i lo tsā ba yin/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas las dpang lung man ngag mang du zhus te sgrub pa nyams len la brtson par mdzad pas rtogs pa mngon du shar nas chos thams cad la mi brjed pa'i gzungs rnams thob ste/〈grub mtha' shel gyi me long〉〉las 'dan ma rtse mang mi brjed gzungs rnams thob/ ces gsungs so/ khong ni grub thob rje dang 'bangs nyer lnga'i nang tshan zhig yin no/zhu chen tshul khrims rin chen/spyi lo (1679)lor 'dan khog tu yab lha bzo ngag dbang chos 'phel dang yum bu chog gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/mtshan gzhan la ngag gi dbang po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha dbyangs can snyems pa'i lang tsho'i sde zer ba 28

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od jig dang /gzhon nu dus nas rab tu byung /rig gnas mtha' dag la mkhas pa gyur nas lnga rig smra ba'i dbang phyug tu grags/ sde dge par khang chen mo'i zhu chen par bzhugs nas bstan dang 'gro ba'i don la phyag rjes rlabs chen gnang / spyi lo(177ci sku mya ngan las 'das/tā la'i bla ma sku phreng dgu pa lung rtogs rgya mtsho/yab bstan 'dzin chos skyong dang / yum don grub sgrol ma gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu gsum pa'i shing glang(spyi lo1805)lor mdo khams sde dge'i mnga' khongs 'dan ma'i srib phyogs chos 'khor dgon gyi nye 'gram gnyan yab gzhis pho brang du sku 'khrungs/ chung ngu'i dus nas ngo mtshar che ba'i mtshan ma dang ldan pa zhig yod tshul gang sar khyab/ dgung lo gsum pa'i me yos(spyi lo 1807)lor rgyal tshab rta tshag no min han mchog dang / bka' blon bzhi sogs che rgu thams cad bka' bgros nas tā la'i bla ma'i 'os sprul du dbus su gdan 'dren 29

'dari ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od big byas/ dgung lo bzhi pa'i sa 'brug (spyi lo 1808)lor yang srid dngos su ngos 'dzin byas shing paṇa chen bstan pa'i nyi ma mchog gis gtsug phud bzhes te mtshan blo bzang bstan pa'i 'byung gnas ngag dbang lung rtogs rgya mtsho zhes gsol/ dgung lo dgu pa'i chu bya (spyi lo 1813)lor lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi jo bo shākya/ mu ne'i mdun du paṇa chen bstan pa'i nyi mas mkhan po dang khri chen grags pas slob dpon/shar pa chos rjes dus gsan pa bcas mdzad nas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ rab byung bzhi ba'i shing phag (spyi lo 1815)lo ste dgung lo bcu gcig zin pa dang cham pa'i bsnyun gzhi lta bu zhig gis rkyen byas te sku gshegs/dpal sprul 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po/rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i sa 'brug (spyi lo1808)lor byang rdza chu khar sku 'khrungs/ dpal dge bsam gtan phun tshogs kyi yang sprul du ngos 'dzin byas nas ①mtshan 'jigs med chos kyi —— —— — / —pre'arno ༄ bye rgengh+ru daco/na pan+ḍi ta'i nga nga spru kha bakhrod nga 'ang mod 30

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig dbang bo btags/ khong dus rabs bcu dgur 'dan pad ma ri'i gnas pad ma shel phug la phebs nas sku mtshams yun ring bzhugs myong ba ma zad/ skabs der gnas pa'i 'dan khog gzim dpon yar log tshang gi bu bkra shis dge legs dang 'ju tshang gi bu mo gnyis kyi 'jig rten 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rma khas mnar pa'i gnas tshul gsal ba byed pa'i me long ste〈gtam pad ma tshal gyi zlos gar 〉〉zhes brjod byed tshig bcad lhug spel ma'i snyan ngag gi gtam phal skad go bde ba'i tshig tu bsdebs nas brtsams pa la/ rab byung bco lnga pa'i me phas (spyi lo 1887)lor sku gshegs so/'ju mi pham 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal rgya mtsho/rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i me rta (spyi lo 1846)lo khams sde dge nye 'dabs ya chu ding chung gi sa char yab mgon po dar rgyas dang yum sring chung gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs/dgung lo drug pa nas yab dang zhang bo'i drung du yi ge'i 'bri klog sbyangs/31

'dan ma'i lo khyus gser gyi 'od thig dgung lo bcu gnyis pa me sbrul (spyi lo 1857)lor gsang sngags chos gling dgon du phebs te grwa btsun mdzad/ de nas lo gcig ring dbus lha ldan du gnas skor la phebs/ phyir log ste bla ma 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang po dang / dbang chen dgyes rab rdo rje/ dpal sprul 'jigs med chos dbang / dge bshes ngag dbang 'byung gnas/ blo gter dbang po sogs mkhas chen du ma slob dpon du bsten nas/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i gtsug lag khang brgya phrag mang po sbyangs pa mthar phyin par mdzad cing / rig pa'i gnas bcu las mkhas pa'i yang rtser son/ dgung lo nga gcig pa rab tshes me sprel lor 〈rgyal bo lugs kyi bstan bcos〉mdzad/ dgung lo re gnyis pa sa sprel lor 〈dus 'khor 'grel chen 〉〉brtsams/ de'i phyi lor 〈snyan 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i rol mtsho〉brtsams/ spyir brtsams chos po ti bcu phrag gsum lhag bzhugs/sku tshe hril bor 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi bya bas bstan 'gro la phan pa'i don rgya chen po bsgrubs/ khyad par du bzo dang gso ba/ rtsis rig 32

'dan ma'i lo rgyas gser gyi 'od thig bcas la snga na med pa'i mdzad rjes mdzad de/ ris med mkhas pa yongs kyis bstod tshig gi me tog phyogs kun tu gtor/ mdo dbus khams gsum du mkhas pa grags pa bar med khyab/ khong gi gsung gi bdud rtsis bskyangs pa'i mkhas pa grags che ba rdo sprul rdo rje dang / gter ston bsod rgyal/ kaḥthog si tu chos kyi rgya mtsho/ rdzogs sprul lnga pa/ dpal spungs si tu sogs mkhas grub dam pa shin du mang / rab byung bcu bzhi lor 'dan ma srib phyogs chos 'khor dgon nye gnas kyi gnas mchog 'go thim la phebs te gnas sgo phyes pas 'ju ri khrod cig brjod/ gnas de dkyil mtshams khang chung ngu mngon pa dga' ba zhig yod pa de ni khong nyid lo mang sgrub pa brgyab pa'i sa/nas yin pa dang 〈mi pham sdeb sbyor〉〉brtsams yul yin pa red zer/ de'i ma tshad khong lags spyi lo 1912lo 'dir dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim pa/karma pa sku phreng bcu drug pa rje rang byung rig pa'i rdo rje/mdo khams sde dge rgyal po'i mnga' khongs 'dan khog gi bye 33

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig brag seng ge gnam rdzong du hor khob/ a sdug tshang gi bu tshe dbang phun tshogs dang bu mo skal bzang chos sgron gnyis kyi sras su(spyi lo 1924lor )shing pho byi ba'i zla ba drug pa'i tshes bcu bdun nyin 'khrungs/ lcags lug zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes lngar dpal mtshur phu mdo bo lung gi gtsug lag khang chen por chos kyi seng ge'i khri chen por mnga' gsol/ spyir phyi nang rig pa'i gnas du ma dang / ris med mdo sngags kyi chos sgo mtha' yas pa gsan sbyong dpyis phyin par mdzad/ lhag par byams mgon tā yi si tu pad ma dbang mchog rgyal po dang /'jam mgon kong sprul dpal ldan mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer zung gi zhal snga nas zab don gyi gdams ngag mtha' dag bum pa gang byos gsan zhing / don brgyud kyi dgongs pa 'phos te nges don gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur te mchog gi rdo rje slob dpon chen por dbang bskur zhing sgrub brgyud gsar ri'i phreng bar bzhugs su gsol/ tā yi si tu pad ma dbang mchog rgyal po'i drung du dge tshul dang bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ gzhan phan gyi mdzad pa la gdan sa 3 1

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig mtshur phu zhig gsos rgya bskyed rgya cher mdzad pa ma zad/ shing sprel lo nas bzung / rgya gar dang bal yul/ 'brug 'bras ljongs bcas su chibs bsgyur gyis phyogs de dag gi skye bo mtha' dag smin grol mdzad/ lhag par bod gyongs can ljongs stod smad kun tu dus snga phyir zhabs sor gyi re kha 'khod de smin grol spyi dang /khyad par dge tshul slong gi sdom pa gnang ba ni rgyal dbang karma pa sku phreng gi gral nas mang shos kyi gras shig yin/ de 'brel bshad sgrub kyi sde dngos brgyud gnyis nas gsar 'dzugs gnang ba mang dag cig mchis/ shing rta lor bod kyi bla chen mi dpon che drag nyis brgya tsam dang lhan du mes rgyal nang sar gzigs skor la chibs bsgyur gyis bod spyi'i bstan srid la sman pa'i phyag 'gan rgya gang che bzhes sa phag lor 'brug brgyud rgya gar du phebs/ bstan pa nyams gso'i thugs bzhed kyis 'bras ljongs rum btog/sa kyi gnas su bshad sgrub chos 'khor gling gsar bzhengs/ bal yul dang la dwags gnyis su'ang dgon sde gsar bskrun gnang / la reb dang a gling / shar lho ye shes ya bcas su 35

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig chos lugs mi rigs ris su ma tshad pa'i skye bo mchog dman 'bum tsho brgal bar dam pa'i chos kyi 'brel mdzad pa ma zad/bstan gzhi chos tshogs kyang brgya phrag gsum tsam gsar 'dzugs gnang snga phyir sprul sku dngos 'dzin stong phrag brgal ba mdzad pas mtshon ngo mtshar ba'i lo rgyus shin tu mang / rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che tshar lnga brgya tham pa par bskrun gnang ba dang 'brel/ ris med kyi dgon sde kun la chos sbyin du bstsal bas mtshon gsung rab nyams gso yang rgya cher mdzad/ dgung grangs brgyad pa lcags mo bya lor sprul sku'i 'khrungs yul sogs gsar kha 'khod pa'i zhal chems lung bstan dang don rgyud kyi bstan pa si tu rin po che la gtad de re zhig dag pa'i zhing du gshegs so/dil 'go mkhyen brtse/ spyi lo 1910lor 'dan ma'i srib phyogs 'bar lung 'dabs gzim dpon khag bdun gyi bye brag dil 'go tshang du yab pad nor dang yum gzim dpon g.yas thog tshang gi bu mo 36

༷'dan ma'i lo byus gaber gyi 'od thig (mtshan ma rnyed pa)gnyis kyi sras su rtags dang rdzu 'phrul gyi mtshan nas skyes/ khong nyid chung dus nas ya rabs spyod pa'i goms pa dang dkar po'i chos la dad pas/ /yul mi thams cad kyis skyabs 'gro dang gzengs bstod byed pa/ chung dus nas rab tu byung ste chos grwar zhugs shing / 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse rin po che sogs dge pa'i bshes gnyen du mar bsten nas thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas mkhas par sbyangs/phyis su gnas chen mang por phyin nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bas/ sa'i zlum po kun du nyi brgya'i dkyil 'khor bzhin bstan pa'i 'od zer sa gzhi ma lus khyab/ spyi lo 1991lor dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim/bla ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan/bla ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan nam gnas su bla ma ni 'dan ma'i shar phyogs kyi klong chu grong sde ru yab 'jam dga' dang yum gnas su bu mo gnyis kyi sras su spyi lo1935lor rtags ngo 37

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig mtshar can mngon nas sku 'khrungs/ byis pa lo lnga la lon dus rdzogs chen bshad grwa chen mo la zhugs nas skra phud phul te grwa pa byas shing yi ge sbyong pa'i 'go btsugs/ dgung lo nyer shu rtsa brgyad kyi ring du dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma la brten nas slob gnyer mdzad/ mdo sngags rig gnas dang man ngag bcas la sbyangs pa legs par byas/ rdzogs chen bshad grwa'i bla grwa yongs nas blo rig bkra shos dang yon tan ldan phyogs/ spyod bzang gras su grags/ phyis su 'dan ma la phebs te gnas chen pad ma ri bo'i seng ge nags rdzong du sgom grub kyi mtshams bgrang bya bcu yas mas bzhugs te 'dan ma'i klong chu grong sde la zhabs bcags nas bstan pa rgyas pa'i bya bzhag tu hur brtson khyad gsod bgyis te slob ma mchog tu gyur pa bzhi gso skyong byas la/ ngag dbang sbyin pa dang ngag dbang shes rab/ ngag dbang brtson 'grus/ karma 'jam pa bzang po bcas yin/de nas da dung sngar dus kyi 'pho 'gyur gyis gter brlags zin pa'i shug rwa dgon sde'i shul la gzhigs te dben gnas spang ljang gi 38

'dan mali lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig ngos su kha dog mi gcig pa'i yid 'phrog me tog ldum rwa dang gnyis su ma mchis pa'i kun dga' rwa ba mchog tu dga' ba zhig gsar bzhes mdzad pa bcas rgya mtsho'i nor bu'i rin thang dang kun khyab rgyu skar gyi grangs su 'gran pa'i mdzad rjes rlabs po che dag bzhes/ spyi lo 1990lor 'dan ma'i yul du dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim/karma zhwa dmar rin po che/'dan ma'i nyin phyog/sa gnas kyi bye brag seng ge nags rdzong du gzim dpon ar sdug tshang gi bu drel dkar sprul skus 'jig rten mthun mjug gi las su zhugs te sde dge gro ma tshang gi sras mo phun tshogs dbang mo khab tu bzhengs nas/ spyi lo 1965lo'i nang du sa gzhi dang nam mkha' gnyis 'ja' tshon gyis 'brel zhing / nyi shar gyi dus su 'brug sgra grags pa bcas ltas bzang po dang sbrags nas khong gnyis kyi sras su rgyal dbang karma zhwa dmar rin po che sku bltams/ chung dus nas rgya gar du phebs song pas 39

'dan ma'i lo thas gaber gyi 'od thig rnam thar gsal po 'bri ma thub/ da lta'ang khong nyid rgya gar la bzhugs yod pa'o/'dan ma'i rgyal khab las byed pa dang mi sna 'jon thang can/ye shes don grub/1963lo'i zla 9tshes 10nyin khams 'dan ma la skyes shing / rang lo bdun nas gling 'gi gzi slob chung du zhugs nas rig gnas sbyong 'go btsugs te/ snga gzhug nas rig gnas sbyong 'go btsugs te/ snga gzhug tu 'dan khog slob 'bring dang dkar mdzes dge 'os slob grwa dar mdo'i zab sbyong slob grwa dar mdo mi rigs mtho rim ched sbyong slob grwa nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo sogs su slob gnyer byas nas/ dge rgan rdo rje dang thub bstan phun tshogs/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ nyan shul mkhyen rab 'od gsal dang 'jam dpal phun tshogs/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen mo dor zhi gdong drug snyems pa'i blo ldan/ dpa' 40

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od jig ris sangs rgyas/ ho wus zhon dang krang h+phang ki dpal mkhar sogs kyi mdun nas brda sprod snyan ngag dang lo rgyus/ sgra tshad nang don rig pa/yig sgyur rig pa'i gzhung lugs dang skad yig rig pa/ sdeb sbyor mngon brjod sogs sbyangs brtson mthar phyin te 1995lor nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo las bod kyi skad yig dang rtsom rig gi rab 'byams pa'i thob thang lon/ lo ngo bco brgyad thog nas 'dan khog slob 'bring du dge rgan gyi khur blangs te rim bzhin ser shul rdzong slob 'bring / ser shul rdzong rig slob cus/ dar mdo mi rigs dge 'os slob grwa sogs su las don sgrub cing / deng 'chad dpon dang shang kang thengs gnyis pa'i bod rigs pa'i zhib 'jug lhan tshogs kyi las gtogs pa/ dar mdo mi rigs dge 'os slob grwa'i bod yig tshan khag gi 'go 'dzin pa bcas kyi 'gan blangs/dge rgan gyi khur blangs te slob gso'i las don sgrub tshe/slob ma'i blor bstun gyis 'chad khrid byas pas dkar mdzes khul du bod kyi rig gnas nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams 41

da wa 'danama'ilo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig gong spel thub pa'i shes yon can mang bo gso skyong byas dang byed bzhin mchis/ rnam kun bod kyi rig/ gnas dang slob gso/lo tsā bcas kyi gnas la rtog zhib bya rgyu'i brtson pa lhur blangs te/ dpyad rtsom la sgra sgyur shing rtas lnga zung bcu gnyis bdag ngo/ drangs tshul la dpyad pa lo tsā dgyes pa'i gtam/ sa/sar 'gyur 'bri thabs kyi myong tshor blo gsal dga' ba'i snying gtam/ rig gnas lta bas bod kyi slob gso'i 'gal don la dpyad pa yid mthun dga' ba'i gtam/ dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi skad gnyis slob gso'i skor gyi 'phros don/ shang kang gi 'das ma 'ong da lta'i tshul gyi don chen 'ga' zhes pa bcas rim bzhin bod ljongs slob grwa chen mo'i dus deb dang bod ljongs nyin re'i tshags par gyi bshes gnyen/ dkar mdzes gsar 'gyur sogs su bkod/ 'gyur dpyad mthong ba don ldan ces pa'i dpyad rtsom nub byang mi rigs slob gling gi skabs go gnyis pa'i zhib 'jug slob ma'i dpyad rtsom bgro gleng du dge ba'i bshes sa/nyen dang mkhas/ pa'i dbang po rnams kyis khas 12

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig blangs shing bod kyi skad yig dang rtsom rig gi rab 'byams pa'i thob thang gnangs/ched rtsom deb rgya bod yig sgyur rigs pa'i gzhung lugs dang sgyur thabs blo gsal 'jug sgo zhes pa si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis bskrun te bkram/ dar mdo mi rigres dge 'os mtho rim ched sbyong slob grwa'i slob deb yig sgyur gzhung lugs dang sgyur thabs zhes par rtsom sgrig bya bar zhugs zhing si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis bskrun/ tshan rig byis pa dga' skyed dpe tshogs las srog chags skor bsgyur te si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis bskrun/de min da dung khyad mtshar ldan pa'i rdza chu kha/ lo rgyus kyi rnam thar ring mo ting zha'o phing / cang tse men a rir mtshams 'dri phebs pa'i brnyan 'phrin rtsom gzhung bsgyur te dkar mdzes khul dril bsgra gas pu'u dang rig gnas cus kyis brnyan phab byas te bkram/ rtsom rig thad bkra shi/sa bstod smon khrod kyi mu cor/ 'khrul/ gangs dkar ri bo la bstod pa zhes pa sogs/ brtsams/

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gye 'od jig dkon mchog lha dar/khong ni gzhung sems drang zhing ngang rgyud 'jam pa/ blo khog yangs la shes rgya che ba/ lhag bsam rnam dag gis mi dmangs la zhabs 'degs dang / rgyal khab srid jus la blo dkar ba zhig yin pas/ khong spyi lo 1951lo nas bzung 'dan khog rdzong rgyal khab las byed 'gan khur pa zhig gi ming thob pa dang lo 'ga' zhig gi slad du 'dan khog rdzong u hru'u cing gi 'gan bzhes mdzad/ spyi lo 1973lo'i zla 8la dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul srid khrims u yon lhan khang gi hru'u cing la bskos/khong gis dka' sdug che pa'i lo zla'i nang du dka' ba khyad gsad dang / lci ba rgyab du khur nas gzhung sems drang po mda' ltar 'dzin nas mi dmangs su khe phan gyi bya ba dang tang gi gsung len lag bstar ba kho na la brtson pas/ da lta khong 'das zin yang mi dmangs kyi blo la kun gsal yangs mo'i ngos su nya gong zla ba bzhin gsal po gnas so/ 44

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od jig tshe lo/'dan ma lo phyug sde bar skyes shing / gzhon dus nas blo rig grung la kha lce rno pa/ rgya yig dang bod yig la dge rgan gyis khrid zhor ru rang gcun kyis 'bad 'bangs byas nas/ spyi lo 1982lo zla ba 6pa nas lo bzhi ring lho nub mi rigs slob gling gi mi rigs shes rig tshan khag nas slob sbyong byas te mthar phyin/ de dus slob sbyong gi sbyangs 'bras legs shing / ched las mkhas pas dge rgan dang slob ma kun gyis gzengs bstod byas/ 1986lo nas 1998bar ser shul rdzong rdzong u'i gzhung las khang gi kru'u rin dang rdzong u'i hru'u ci gzhon pa bcas kyi 'gan khur/ 1998lo nas da bar dpal yul rdzong gi hru'u ci'i khur blangs/ngag lo/1966lo 'dan ma'i rgod gsar sde par skyes/ chung dus lo bdun brgyad tsam nas dar rtse mdo la phebs te slob gnyer byas/ 45

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig 1986lo'i zla9 par dar mdo dge 'os ched sbyong slob grwa la rgyugs 'phrod nas dbyin ji yi ge la 'bad brtson chen po byas/1990lor slob grwa de gar mthar phyin te/ ser shul rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung gi gzhung las khang du bya ba bsgrubs/ lo gnyis kyi rjes su gzhung las khang gi kru'u rin gzhon pa la bskos/de ska bas 'dan mar dbyin ji lung pa'i sman pa dang ma/khas pa mang po phebs nas dbul por rogs skyor mdzad pa'i go skabs dang brten nas khos dbyin bod skad bsgyur mtha' 'khyol byas pas/ dbyin mi phyi bzlog dus kho'ang lhan cig du dbyin ji lung par slob gnyer lo gcig tsam khrid/ 1995lo tshur phebs nas sngon ma'i las ka dor te tshong gnyer gyi lam du zhugs/ dar mdo la ri klung ja khang dang zur sbyong dbyin yig 'dzin grwa sogs rig gnas dang bod kyi dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas la shugs rkyen thad pa'i tshong gnyer las ka mang po byatra// da lta khong nyid khams / phyogs kyi tshong ra'i gar stegs steng gi 'khrab ston pa legs po zhig gyur/

'dan ma'i lo rgyus kasar gyi 'od thig karma don grub/khong 'dan ma'i lo phyug sde par skyes/1999 lo'i zla 8bar si khron zhing chen tang gi slob grwa nas mthar phyin/ snga gzhug tu ser shul rdzong thon u'i hru'u ci gzhon pa dang hru'u ci/rdzong mi don cus cus krang / sgrig khrims zhib bsher u yon lhan khang gi hru'u ci bcas las ka'i 'gan khur/1997lo'i nas da lta'i bar ser shul rdzong rdzong u rgyun u rdzong hru'u cu gzhon pa'i khur blangs/rdzong rim pari 'go khrid//rusaming/ phomorigaganaspra/— lasakhungs 'ganadabang sdeb gsalabat+tada'astashā sdopy-iXs/ pho mtho 'bring / ༵dīshāsna ṭ+wāṃ~X/ pu'u krang / bde khag kādī k+ṣiṃ/ —dūl0da/ ngo mtho'abring/ rā~XshāXtram̐/nga krung banagada' 'dasazin /kunasas / nga ༵rtekhadīng serashulahūṃng kru'unye —'dasazan———da wa chabagros —da wa—da wad wa—dirjidze+edzodze+e/ —pho——sdorjotram̐n sa smu pu'urdi khophyu rji

'dan ma'i lo khyus gser gyi 'od thig 'dan mchog sprul rin po che'i sku phreng rim byon gyi rnam thar bzhugs so//dbang chen gyis bsgrigs/'dan ma mchog sprul rin po che'i sku phreng dang po drung nam mkha' legs pa mchog ni rab byung bzhi ba'i shing 'brug lo (spyi lo 124cil khams 'dan stod bar khog sham sil drung pa tshang yab rdo rje dang yum bkra shis bzang mo gnyis kyi sras su sku bltams/ chung dus khu bo lha rje rig gsal gyi mdun nas yi ge 'bri klog dang sman rtsis lha bris sogs bslabs/ dgung lo bcu drug la phebs dus khyim mi rnams dang 'grogs nas dbus gtsang phyogs su gnas bskor song / dbus gtsang phyogs nas gsar rnying ris med kyi bla chen dang mkhas grub rnams la bsten nas gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde bzhi dang bcas pa la gsan bzhes rgya chen mdzad/ dgung lo bcu dgu son dus grub chen sa ra ha pas zhal gzigs/ 'gro mgon rgya nag nas bod du phebs dus 54

'dan ma' lo khyus gser gyi 'od thig sngon nas 'dris pa ji bzhin phan tshun thugs dgyes nas 'phags pas/ khyod rang ma 'ongs par bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don bla na med pa 'grub pa ma tshad khyod ni grub chen sa ra ha'i 'phrin las kyi sprul pa yin pas rgyun ring mi 'gor bar grub chen gyi sku gzhes chog gsungs/ slar yang / 'gro mgon gyi mdun nas gdams ngag gi chos zab mo'i skor rnams zhus nas thugs su chud pa gyur zhing / 'gro mgon gyis drung dbang mchog tu khyed 'dan ma yul 'di ni ma 'ongs par khyod kyi skyes rabs brgyad kyi bar du las kyi gdul byang yin pas der song nas sgom dang yun ring mi thogs pa nged gnyis thug yong gsungs/ bla ma'i bka' bzhin drung nam mkha' legs pa rang yul du phebs nas la lung nges med du sgrub pa mdzad nas bzhugs/ sgrub pa mdzad pa'i dus su mgon po zhal bzhi pa'i lung ltas la/ sus kyang 'dul ma nus pa'i btsan rgod cig gis khyod la bar chad rtsom nges/ de dang bstun nas 'dul dgos gsungs nas mi snang ba gyur/phyi dro ru bud med byad gzhi legs pa zhig gis zho dang 'o ma 55

'dan ma'i tsā khyus gser gyi 'od thig khur nas bla ma'i sku mdun thugs brtag blta bar 'ong / bla mas thugs brtag gzigs dus bud med des 'o ma gang drangs/thugs g.yeng ba'i tshul gyis bzheng / sku la glo bur du snyung gzhi bzheng ba'i dus der bud med des rang gzugs dngos su bstan nas 'tshe ba'i las rtsom/ bla mas kyang skad cig nyid la rang nyid yi dam gyi skur bzhengs te btsan rgod de 'dul bar dgongs/ 'on kyang bdud kyi cho 'phrul gyis spyan sngar du gzi chu mig dgu pa zhig gzigs pas dbu sgur nas bzheng par btsan rgod de shor/ slar yang shor bzung thengs bco brgyad byed mthar glang rgan zhig dang thug pa de la zhugs bskal pa mang po'i sngon nas byang chub kyi sems mtshan rin po che thugs la mnga' bas btsan rgod la snying rje tshad med cig 'khrungs nas rang nyid kyis zhon pa'i sna lo de rdzu 'phrul gyis rdo pha bong la phyag mdzub kyis bu ga phug nas btags te sku ngal gsos/snying rje'i stobs kyis glang rgan de'ang bros ma nus bla ma la phyir bltas byas/ de ma thag bla mas rde'u zhig mi rgod kyi mchan rdor rdzu ste 'phangs pas glang pe6

'dan ma'i lo sa gser sgru 'od thig rgan de'i rkang pa bcag ste dam la btags/ ming mkhyen brtse dbang grags btags nas srung ma bzhag/dugrub thob chen po rang gi sgrub khang du bzhugs dus sngo lu 'dre mos rgyun du 'tshe ba byed/ nyin zhig bla mas rang gi zhabs zhur rta la rte'u ci 'dra zhig skye ba ltos shog gsung /zhabs zhu bas/rta la dre'u rkang gcig mig gcig pa zhig skyes 'dug zhus pas/bla mas myur du khrid shog gsung nas zhabs zhu bas skye ma thag pa'i dre'u de khrid nas phul/ bla mas dre'u de zhon nas phebs song ste rab dkram dang khams gsum dbang phyug bar du rdzu 'phrul gyis 'dre mo ded pa'i zhabs g.yas rab dkram dang g.yon khams gsum dbang phyug gi ri'i thog rdzis nas 'dre mo rdo rje'i bka' yis 'og tu bsdus/ skabs der rdzu 'phrul gyis bkod pa'i zhabs rjes dang dre'u nub rjes/khyi mo'i rkang rjes gsum ri gnyis kyi thog tu phan tshun gsal le mjal rgyu yod/ da dung rdzu 'phrul gyi lcag tshan 'dre mo la bzhu dus lcag rgyun sne mo rdo la phog pa'i pha (bye da ltar 'bam legs dgon dang ra co dgon gyi srung ma yin/phyag mdzub kyis pha bong la bu ga phug pa'i khung bu dang mi rgod kyi mchan rdo sogs da ltar 'dan stod bar khog phyogs su mjal rgyu yod/57

'dan ma'i lo byus gser gyi 'od thig bong thog tu rgyun rjes re re bzhin gsal ba mjal rgyu yod/ sngo lu 'dre mo la a sngo ral zhes ming gnang nas da ltar rwa co dgon gyi srung ma yin/grub thob rin po ches dre'u rkang gcig zhon nas nam mkha' 'phur te phar ri 'bar lha dang tshur ri rab dkram sogs 'dan lung yongs la phebs/ dbyar dus 'bar lha brag dkar du phebs nas sgom pa dang / dgun dus rab dkram gnas mchog tu bzhugs pa/ gtan gyi gdan sa bde dgongs su yin pa dang /'bar lha brag dkar bzhugs pa'i dus su nyin zhig grub thob mchog gis zhabs zhu ba la khyod rang de ring sgrub phug gi sgor ma bud dang bar chad yong gsungs/phyi dror bsdad du ma tshugs nas sgo phyir bud ma kha 'bar lha'i cho 'phrul gyis nam mkha' nas glog 'tshub/ 'brug sgrog thog ser rgyag pa dang dus mnyam du 'bar lha dngos su rgyug ste zhabs zhu ba de bzung nas gson pags bshus te sha khrag la rol/ bla ma thugs ha cang khros te mi ro'i yan lag thams cad bcad de pha bong ngos su bkal/ phyag 58

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od jig mdzub kyis pha bong ngos la rdzu 'phrul gyis ri mo bris te 'bar lha bkug dus je nye ru bcar te sha khrag la rol/ de ma thag tu rdo rje phur pas snur te dam la btags/ 'dan lung gi gnas srung bskos/phyi rabs dad ldan gyi gdul bya rnams kyi dran gso'i ched dang sku nyid kyis dgos pa khyad par ba la dmigs nas mi ro'i yan lag dang khrag ris/ mtshams khang nang gi mchod pa mar rgyan thams cad rdo la bsgyur ro/ rdo la bsgyur ba'i khrag ris dang mar rgyan rnams da ltar dngos su mjal rgyu yod/'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa 'dan yul phebs par gsan ma thag sku nyid thugs ha cang dgyes nas skam pa'i chu 'dod ltar sgug grub thob mchog gis rang gi bla ma la ci zhig phul dgongs ba'i dus su gzhi bdag khams gsum dbang phyug des bkra shis sgang nas gser lhung bzed gang phul nas rang nyid drung grub dbang gi bka' las mi 'da' ba'i dam bcas/'gro mgon 'dan mar phebs dus bde dgongs dgon dang shri ri dgon pa'i grwa ba rnams ser sbrengs bsgrig nas bsus/drung 59

'dan ma'i lo byus gser gyi 'od thig dbang grub thob nam mkha' legs pa dang 'gro mgon gnyis bkra shis sgang nas zhal mjal te dgyes tshor chen po'i gsung gleng mdzad/ gnas der phebs dus rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa 'grig ste 'phags pa'i zhal nas/ sngon gyi skyes chen mang pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i sa/ nyams dga' ba'i yul 'di la bkra shis sgang zhes mtshan thogs gsung / bod gangs can gyi yul 'dir bka' drin che ba'i lo tsā ba ldan ma mchog gi gdan sa chen po 'dir ma 'ongs par khyod kyi skye rabs rnyiḥyig mtshan can gyis gso zhes gsung nas sa gzhi byin gyis rlobs te bde dgongs su phebs/ grub thob pas lhung bzed gser gyi gang ba de bla ma la phul/ bla mas grub thob pa la mar gnang nas/ 'di'i khyod kyis rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che zhig bzheng gsung /de nas 'gro mgon gyis bde dgongs su shri rim grwa pa rnams dang bde dgon gyi grwa pa rnams la dbang lung dang bka' slob cig rgyas pa gsung / rjes su drung dbang mchog nas gser gtso sbyang mdzad de bka' 'gyur rin po che bzhengs/ da ltar bde 60

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od dzig dgongs dgon du rten gyi gtso bor bzhugs yod/sku nyid srin po brag dkar du phebs nas bod yul gyi lha 'dre gdug rtsub can thams cad dbang du bsdus/ shar kong yul phyogs kyi yul lha rnams kyis rang rang gi srog snying ste rtsi shing rigs mi 'dra ba du ma phul/ yul lha gzhan rnams kyis kyang srog snying phul te grub thob mchog gis sa rdo dang rtsi shing la bsgyur/ da lta'ang srin po brag dkar tu yul gzhan la med pa'i smyug ma sogs rigs mi 'dra ba'i rtsi shing du ma zhig skye yod/mdor na 'dan lung ma tshad bod yul mtha' dag nas lha srin gdug pa can thams cad rdo rje'i bka' yis 'og tu bsdus te las can gyi bu slob rnams sa lam la bkod/ dgung grangs go brgyad la phebs dus lung pa la sri nad kyis mi mang po lnga lam la skyel pas sku nyid kyis sri nad bzheng ste nad yams kyi rgyun bcad/rang gi bu slob rnams la da nga 'gro ran/ bsu ba slebs byung bas nga 'gro la gsungs nas rab byung drug pa'i chu rta lor (spyi lo 1342)gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus/ sku nyid kyi zhal chems la 61

'dan ma'i lo byus gser gyi 'od jig phung po sna lor bkal te song / sna lo gang du bsdad na der zhog gsungs kyang sna lo lam 'og tu bsdad pa bu slob rnams kyis lam 'og tu bzhag ma nus pa gong gi chos sde lung phug ldum bum du drangs te bzhag rten 'brel cung ma legs kyang da ltar srin dang so nad can gyis phyag bskor phul na nad rgyud chad 'gro ba grags/sku nyid la slob ma rang 'dra gsum dang lam zhugs brgya dang brgyad/ thar lam zin pa stong dang lnga brgya/smon lam thebs pa khri phrag lhag byung yod pas drung nam mkha' legs pa zhes yul gangs can la dus da lta'i bar du mtshan snyan khyab pa lags so/gnyis pa/ drung chos sku 'od zer/drung nam mkha' legs pa'i sku phreng gnyis pa drung chos kun 'od zer ni mdo stod nyag chu ring mo'i 'gram rgyud nyag rong chu yon sde par yab 'phrin las dang yum sgrol ma gnyis kyi sras su rab byung drug pa'i lcags pho stag (spyi lo 1350)lor ltas 62

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig bzang po dang bcas te sku 'khrungs/ chung dus nas rig pa dwangs shing shes rab myur la/ rgyud 'jam pa/ kun gyis mthong na yid du 'ong ba/yab kyi mdun nas thog ma yi ge 'bri klog sbyong /zla ba gnyis tsam nas 'bri klog mtha' phyin pa grags/ dgung lo bcu'i dus su khu bo bsod nams rin chen dang mnyam du dpal yul kaḥthog dgon du phebs nas rab tu byung / mdo sngags rgyud sde dang bcas pa la gsan bsam bla na med pa mdzad/ dgung lo nyi shu'i dus su dbus gtsang du phebs nas ris med kyi mkhas grub rnams kyi mdun nas gdams ngag zab chos mtha' yas pa zhus/ khyad par du sa skya dgon du phebs nas sa skya'i chos skor yongs rdzogs dang rje btsun red mda' ba'i mdun nas dbu ma dang 'dul ba sogs dpyis phyin pa sbyong / ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' snying po'i mdun nas zab rgyas kyi dbang lung sogs zhus skabs der sku nyid kyi gzim lam du mi dmar po drag shul can zhig gis khyod dbus gtsang la rgyun ring ma bzhugs/ nges par du 'dan ma'i yul la phebs nas sku sngar ma'i gdan sa 63

'dan ma'i lo khyus gser gyi 'od jig 'dzin dgos zer ba rmis te rang gi bla ma ngor chen rdo rje 'chang la zhus pas bla mas 'dan ma'i yul la song dang khyod rang gi dus gsum gyi gdul bya de na yod gsungs nas rang lo bzhi bcu'i thog dbus gtsang nas 'ong ste/ lam bar du dgon sde la grub mtha' so so'i dbang lung man ngag mtha' yas pa gnang nas lo gnyis 'gor song / dgung lo zhe gnyis thog sku phreng sngar ma'i gdan sa sham sil du zhabs sar 'khod/ gsar rnying ris med kyi chos 'brel rgya chen gnang bas yul phyogs mtha' dag nas 'grims pa'i snod ldan slob bu grangs kyi mi langs ba 'dus nas gdan sa chen po sham sil zhes mtshan snyan bod gangs can du khyab pa byung / sku sngar mas dam pa yod pa'i lha srin gdug pa can rnams rgod pa'i nyams gzigs nas rdo rje 'chang gis yang bskyar du bka' 'og bsdus/zab chos la nyams len gtso bo mdzad pa dang lhag par du 'dan yul la sems can gyi 'gro don dpag tu med pa mdzad mthar dgung grangs gya brgyad du phebs dus rab byung bdun 64

'dan ma'i lo byus gser gyi 'od thig pa'i sa rta (spyi lo 1438)lor sku nyid kyi gdan sar gzugs sku chos dbyings su bsdus/ sku nyid la slob bu phul byung ba bcu dang mkhan chen bcu drug grwa btsun stong dang lnga brgya/ chos 'brel yod pa'i ser skya khri las brgal bar byung ngo //gsum pa/ drung 'jam dbyangs chos 'phel/drung 'jam dbyangs chos 'phel ni khams stod skye rgu mdor mo tshang yab don 'grub rin chen dang yum shes rab sgrol ma gnyis kyi sras su rab byung brgyad pa'i me yos lo (spyi lo1447)lor sku 'khrungs/chung dus nas yi ge 'bri klog dang sman rtsis sogs la zhib tu bslabs nas dgong lo bco lnga'i thog 〈rtsis yig spyi spyod/〉〉mdzad/ phyi lor sku gong ma gnyis kyi gdan sar khri 'khod/ dpal grub chen sa ra ha pas zhal gzigs dang lung bstan yang yang gnang /mkhan po bsod nams rin chen dang stobs ldan rdo brag sogs kyi drung nas mdo sngags kyi gnad rnams la dpyis phyin pa 65

'dan ma'i lo khyus gser gyi 'od jig bslabs/ dgung lo nyer lnga'i thog nas rab byung ba dang khyim pa pho mo brgya phrag mang po la dbang lung dang bka' chos 'chad/ sku nyid kyis lhag par 'dul ba'i sde snod gces su 'dzin pas bu slob rnams kyang mtshan ldan gyi 'dul 'dzin pa sha stag byung / sku phreng snga ma ji bzhin bstan pa la ris su ma 'dzin pa ma tshad rang gi grub mtha' las gzhan la snang chung 'dzin pa dag la bka' bkyon yang yang gnang / nyin bzhin du nyi zhag khrus gcig gi sdom pa dang / zla re bzhin du gso sbyong /lo re bzhin du grwa btsun stong yan la rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa rgyun ma chad pa gnang /nye 'khor du dgon sde la las gzhan gyi lta ba la ha cang sdang stabs sku nyid kyis log par smra ba de dag tshar gcad shugs chen mdzad pa'i dgung lo so lngar phebs tshe/ dgon sde de dag gis bsam sbyor ngan pas drung dbang la mthu dang man ngag ngan pa la rten nas 'tshe ba brtsams/mkhan pa'i dbang po drung 'jam dbyangs chos 'phel mchog gis rang gi slob bu thub bstan la da 66

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gaber gyi 'od thig ni nga rang 'gro ba las thabs med/ khyod bu slob rnams kyis nyams la phan pa'i chos re byed na bzang / sems can rnams bsod nams dman pa'i rjes su gdan sa 'dzin rgyu dka' mo yin pa gsungs nas rab byung brgyad pa'i chu rta lor(spyi lo 1482)rgyal ba lha las bab pa'i dus chen nyin sku gshegs so/thugs dam du zla ba gcig bzhugs nas sku lus gri gang las ma lus pa gzugs sku 'ja' lus rdul phran du gyur/ rjes su gdan sa sham sil dang chos ldan du yod pa rnams 'bam legs sogs la spor/ bde dgongs ni drung grub dbang chos kun 'od zer gyi dngos slob phul byung bcu'i ya gyal stobs ldan bstan 'dzin shes rab kyi bu slob rnams kyis bskyangs so/bzhi pa/drung smyon pa 'bum rams pa/drung smyon pa 'bum rams pa mchog ni khams stod kong po rgya la grong du rab byung brgyad pa'i chu mo glang lo (spyi lo 1493)la sku 'khrungs/ khyim rgyud kyi ming la 'bum rams tshang zhes 'bod 67

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig pas 'bum rams par grags/ yul der gna' bo'i gdod ma'i chos lugs thun mong ma yin pa zhig yod pa ni bsod ldan gyi sems can zhig bkrongs thub na de'i bsod nams yod do cog rang la smin pa khas len/drung 'bum rams par yab kyis gdug rtsub dge bral can gyi chos lugs der ji ltar slob kyang ma sbyong /spyi'i rig gnas dang dam pa'i chos ma slob kyang mkhyen/ yab kyis sbyor dug gzhan la blud pa mthong tshe yab dang yang rgol/yab kyis khyod rang bsod nams 'dzad pa'i las de ma byed zer yang bus kha ma nyan nas pha la lan brjod/ bus pha rdung nas yul mi rnams kyis bu smyon pa red zer pas smyon pa 'bum rams pa thogs/ chung dus nas srog chags grog ma yan la 'tshe ba'i las ma byed pa dang / rang 'dra na gzhon rnams la dam pa'i chos kyang bslab pas na gzhon rnams khong la dga' ba chen po byed/ 'on kyang / rgan rabs pa rnams kyis mi 'di'i gshis ka bsgyur ma thub na nged mes po'i lugs srol la gnod zer nas yab dang bcas pas dug drangs/ 'bum rams pa dug 'thung yang shi ba 68

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od jig phar zhog sku mdog dang lus stobs kyang je yag dang je 'phel phyin/ rgyun gtan rang khyim du gzhon nu rnams bsdus nas chos dang mthun pa'i glu gzhas len la yab kyis ci bshad kyang ma nyan pas yang yul mi rgan rabs pa dang mnyam du gros byed nas kong chu nang la bskyur/ chu bo'i steng du sa thog ji bzhin byon pa dang da dung phyi mig gzigs nas yab la bde mo'ang zhus/ de nas bod kyi sa cha gang yang 'grims nas grub mtha' la phyogs zhen med pa dge pa'i gshes gnyen mang po sten nas gsan bsam mdzad/ dgung lo sum bcu'i thog kong po ri bo gnam lcags 'bar ba la phebs te zas su shing 'bras dang gos su lo ma gyon nas lo bcur sgrub pa mdzad/ dgung lo bzhi bcu'i thog nas brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa dngos su 'dzin nas sku lus gcen bu ru phebs pa dang dur khrod nas mi sha gsol ba/ ri dwags la zhon nas phebs pa/ nam mkha' stong pa las chang blangs te rgyun du gsol ba/ dus dus su gcan gzan dang zas mnyam du rol ba/ dus dus su ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang tshogs kyi 69

'dan ma'i lo sa gser kyi 'od thig 'khor lo la rol ba sogs grub rtags tshad las 'das pa mdzad/yul dbus su phebs nas gtsug lag khang du gtsang smyon dang 'thab/ drung 'bum smyon pas phyag rdo 'phang nas gtsang smyon la ma phog pa rdo de ka ba la brgyab nas nang du 'dzul song / da lta'ang sgrol ma'i lha khang gi sgo khar ka ba de mjal rgyu yod/ slar yang ri bo gnam lcags 'bar ba la bzhugs nas sgrub pa mdzad/sku nyin rab byung bcu pa'i chu mo lug lo(spyi lo 1583)la byon bzhugs kyi bka' ci yang med pas mi snang ba gyur song /lnga pa/ dpal shod bu mo pad+ma 'tsho/dpal shod bu mo pad+ma 'tsho ni tsha ba dpal shod yul du yab bde chen dang yum 'phrin las sgrol ma gnyis kyi sras mor rab byung bcu pa'i chu mo yos lo(spyi lo1603)la sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo chung dus nas skyabs 'gro sogs gsung pa ma tshad nga 'bum rams pa'i skye ba yin gsung nas sku lus stag ris yod pa bstan/70

'dan ma'i lo sa gser gyi 'od thig dgung lo bcu'i thog nas yab yum gnyis rang nyid kyis g.yog pa dang ri khyim gyi bya ba thams cad sgrub/ rgan rgon rnams la brtsi bkur dang rang 'dra rnams la byams sems ldan pa/lo bcu drug nas ma ṇi rgyang ngag blangs pa'i gsung skad snyan zhing 'jebs pa byung / mdzes sdug yid 'ong ldan zhing lang tsho dar la 'bab pa/las la brtson zhing byams sems ldan pa'i na chung ma de sus mjal yang yid la spro sems 'phel ba/ pho gzhon rnams kyis sems pa shor sa dang mo gzhon rnams kyang yid smon byed sa zhig yin pa dang /dgung lo nyi shu phebs dus su sde ba gzhan zhig la smon lam log pa'i bdud mo zhig yod pa de 'dul ba'i dus la babs nas dgong mo zhig la pad+ma 'tsho'i gzim lam du/ bu mo khyod kyi thabs dang rdzu 'phrul gyis sgo nas bdud mo 'dul dgos gsungs/ de nas pad+ma 'tsho khyim der bu dgu yod pa che ba dang 'grig mthun gyis sgo nas bag ma song / bag bshad kyang rang gis mdzad nas bdud mo las rgyal pa'i rten 'brel 'grigs pad+ma 'tsho la khyim gzhis kyi bya ba gang thad la mnar gcod tshad 71

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig med btang pa ma tshad za mnar 'thung mnar yang byas mod/'on kyang pad+ma 'tsho la mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis las rogs dang gsol ston phul/ma rgan bdud mo des lo rer bu re zas nas mthar bu gcig lus song / ma rgan des pad+ma 'tshos nga'i bu rnams zas song zhes yul sde kun la bsgrags/ nyin zhig pad+ma 'tsho thugs ha cang skyo nas bshums/ bus mthong nas bdud mo khyod kyis gcen po rnams zas pas da nga yang za bsam pa min nam zhes brjod dus pad+ma 'tshos nga min khyod tsho'i ma rgan red/ bu brgyad las mi tshad sems can brgya phrag mang po zas zin pas na nga rang skyo por 'dug gsung / de nub bu des pad+ma 'tsho khrid nas ma'i rjes song / ma rgan ni bdud dpon zhig yin pa mthong / bu skrag nas pad+ma 'tsho la skyabs zhus pad+ma 'tshos rang gi sked rags dgrol te bur bcings nas mdud pa dgu brgyab nas bzhag ma rgan gyis nga'i bu sa gang du yod kyang gnas 'dir khug cig thengs brgyad 'bod pas mdud pa brgyad grol/da pad+ma 'tshos bskungs pa 'dra/72

'dan ma' lo byus gser gyi 'od thig sang nyin thabs yod zer nas bdud tshogs grol/ phyi nyin bud med cig gis bu'i ming bos nas mdzo mo khrid shog zer nas bu song / pad+ma 'tshos kyang phyag tu sta re bzhes te rgyug mdzo mo ha cang khros nas bu la bltas te shor byung pas pad+ma mtshos sta re g.yug thengs gcig gis ma rgan bdud mo zhugs yod pa de btul/khyim du song dus ma rgan yang shi zin 'dugapad+ma 'tsho 'jig rten pa'i khyim gzhi la thugs skyo nas rnal 'byor ma'i tshul mdzad nas bod yul gyi dgon sde rnams la bskor ba phyin/ dgon pa re rer slebs dus sku nyid kyis brla spu gris bshags nas shang rus cha gcig blangs te dgon pa de la rkang du bzhag slar yang rtswa 'jag ma cha re rkang rus kyi tshab tu byas nas phebs/ dgon pa re re bzhin du de ltar phebs/ pad+ma 'tsho'i rkang dung da lta la'ang mang po mthong rgyu yod de/ da ltar 'dan chos 'khor dgon du cha gcig dngos su mjal rgyu yod/sku nyid dgung lo ha cang bgres pa'i dus su skye gzugs je mdzes su phyin pa dang bltas na bcu drug na gzhon las kyang 73

'dan ma'i lo rgyas gser gyi 'od jig gzhon sha chags/ nyam thag can gyi nad pa rnams kyis sku nyid kyi gsung skad thos pa tsam gyi nad sel ba dang / sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba rnams yid bde ba ru bsgyur/ rmas ma sogs kyis thos tshe zug rngu drag po las grol nas yid bde sems skyid du gyur/ sku gsung thugs kyis sems can gyi don dpag tu med pa mdzad nas mthar rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa pho byi lo(spyi lo 1708)lor dgung lo brgya dang lnga la sku lus pad+ma bzhin du je mdzes su gyur nas gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus pa'o/drug pa/ drung lha rje kun bzang nyi ma mchogadrung lha rje kun bzang nyi ma ni mdo smad lho rgyud mgo log yul du mgo log dpon gyi bu rig rgyal dang g.yog mo chos sgron gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sa 'brug lor (spyi lo 1748)sku 'khrungs/ sku rabs nas sku rabs su byang chub kyi sems rin po che rang rgyud la goms pas na khye'u dus nas byar sems kyi spyod par 'bad/ sku nyid dgung lo bcu gsum gyi bar 74

'dan ma'i lo thas gaber gyi 'od jig du slob sbyong gi go skabs ma rnyed par lus song/ lo der sku nyid kyi yum chen chos sgron grongs song bas dwa phrug tu lus/ a mdo'i tshong pa lo rig zer bas g.yog phrug nyar/ zhor du rang gi bu dang mnyam du 'bri klog re bslab/g.yog phrug rig pa ha cang dwangs ba'i dus yun mi ring ba 'bri klog phal cher mkhyen/ tshong pas g.yog phrug 'di btang ste sman rtsis re bslab na bzang bsam nas lam rgyags dang bcas bskur nas bla brang du brdzangs/ dgung lo bco lnga'i dus su bla brang du slebs nas sman pa grwa tshong du gso rig skar rtsis sogs sbyong / lha rje mkhas pa dag la sten nas gso ba rig pa'i rgyud bzhi yan lag dang bcas par mtha' phyin pa mdzad bla brang du lo ngo drug tsam bsdad ring nyin mtshan ltos med ngang du gso rig dang mdo sngags rig gnas bcas la thos bsam rgya cher skya/jordopasdo/dge rgan gyi tsha bo rig bzang zer ba zhig gis ma nyes kha g.yogs kyi rku btsugs te dgon pa nas phyi phud byas/ de nas 75

'dan ma'i lo thas gser gyi 'od thig brag dkar sprel rdzong du phebs te sangs rgyas sman bla sgrub nas bde gshegs sman pa'i rgyal pos dngos su zhal gzigs/ gzhan yang skyes chen gyis mkhas grub mang po la bsten nas gsar rnying ris med kyi gzhung la zab rgyas kyi thos bsam bla na med pa mdzad/sku nyid kyi rtsa rlung la sten nas bod kyi yul gru kun la nad pa nyam thag rnams sdug bsngal las grol ba'i ched du zhabs kyis bcags/ phyogs gang du phebs kyang sman yon mi bzhes pa ma tshad da dung nyam nga ba'i dbul po rnams la sku nyid kyi na bza' sogs kyang gnang / snga phyir slob bu yang mi nyung ba zhig bsdus te 'gro ba nad pa mang po'i nad kyi zug rngu mtha' dag bdud rtsi sman gyis zhi bar mdzad/bya bral ba drung lha rje mchog dang sman lung gi 'brel ba yod do cog rgyu byang chub kyi sems dang 'bras bu thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang la dkon nas mtha' dgung lo gya gnyis thog rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i lcags stag lor (spyi 76

'dan ma'i lo khyus gser gyi 'od thig lo1830)bsam yas he rir gzugs sku 'ja' lus la bsdus so/ /bdun pa/ drung blo bzang thub bstan rnam rgyal/drung blo bzang thub bstan rnam rgyal mchog ni khams 'dan stod rma mgrin sde ba'i nang yab 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho dang yum 'jam dbyangs sgrol ma gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i kun ldan zhes pa lcags pho byi ba'i lor (spyi lo1840)sku bltams dgung lo dgu pa'i steng nas rma mgron dgon pa'i tshogs la zhugs nas chos spyod dang tshogs phyag len skor la thos bsam zhib mo gnang / dgung lo nyi shu bzheng dus rma mgrin dgon pa'i khrir phebs/ sku nyid gzim lam ha cang gsal ba'i rgyun du yul mi rnams la legs nyes kyi thad gzim lam gyis brtag rogs mdzad/dgong mo zhig sku nyid kyi gzim lam du nga dmag zor rgyal mo yin gsung pa'i gzhon nu ma lang tsho dar la bab pa zhig gis77

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig ser shul dgon du rgya 'gong ma rung ba zhig gis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la ha cang 'tshe 'dug khyod rang cis kyang dgon der phebs dgos/ thog mar sham sil la song nas 'phrin bcol gyis dang / der khyod kyi sku rabs sngar ma rnams kyi gdan sa yin pas chos skyong rnams kyi 'phrin las yod gsung ba ma tshad da dung ras thun zhig gnang nas 'di nyar dang dgos pa'i dus shig yod gsung pa rmis/ nam sngar mo sngas mgo la ras thun de yod pa kha grol dus nang du be con khrag gis bangs pa zhig yod pa dang /zhogs pa de la myur par sham sil du phebs/ dgun zla dkyil ma yin yang 'brug sgrog dang 'ja' shar ba sogs bstan srung 'khor dang bcas pas bsu ba'i ltas byung / de nas 'phrin bcol rgyas pa mdzad nas myur ba ser shul du phebs/ thog ma nas rgyud pa grwa tshang du zhugs nas gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa'i bskor la zhib sbyang mthar phyin pa mdzad/ sku nyin 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen ha cang zhan pa'i grwa mang gis skyo po rong phrug 'bod/dus der ser shul dgon du tshogs chen dbu mdzad su 78

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig phebs na zla ba re gnyis las ma bzhugs pa sku grongs/ dgon pa'i rim gro ji ltar mdzad kyang ma phan pa bla chen gang drag rnams 'dus nas ci dga' gang drag gi gros mol mdzad/ mthar brtag ril 'phang ba der yod su la'ang ma babs/ de nub rgyud pa mkhan po'i gzim lam du bu mo zhig gis rong phrug bskos dang / de ni grub chen sa ra ha yi 'phrin las kyi sprul pa yin zer ba rmis/ phyi nyin tshogs 'du'i dbus su mkhan pos mdangs kyi rmi lam brjod par tshang mas lto'i don du 'ong ba'i skyo po de 'dra yin ga la srid ces snang chung byas/ skabs der khri pas phal cher yin yang srid nga la'ang de 'dra ba'i rtags mtshan byung gsungs/mkhan po dang khri pa gtso pas rong phrug 'bod du bcug nas slar yang brtag ril 'phangs/ rong phrug bab song bas mjug mtha' rong phrug tshogs can dbu mdzad bskos/ dpyid chos chen mo'i dus su yang rgya 'gong gis sku nyid la 'tshe ba brtsam/ sku nyid kyis dmag zor ma'i be con phyag tu bzhes nas phyag g.yug mdzad pa ma rung ba'i 'gong po de rang dbang med pa sku'i 79

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig mkhris su slebs pa dam 'og tu bcugs te g.yog su bskos/ser shul la log 'dre ma rung ba thams cad bka' 'og tu bsdus te rang nyid sku mtshams la bzhugs dmag zor mas 'al gzigs/me mtshams khang gi khor yug tu ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis tshogs 'khor bskor ba sogs yul mi rnams kyis mthong ba'i bla ma la skul ba ched che 'debs/de nas bzung bla mas kyang sku sngar ma'i rnam thar bskyongs nas gnas nges med du phebs pa dang sgrub pa mdzad pa ma tshad bod yul gyi log 'dre gdug pa can thams cad dam la bzhagadagung lo drug cu nas gya drug bar du sgrub pa kho na mdzad/ dgung lo gya drug gi dus su rab byung bco lnga pa'i me stag (spyi lo1926)lor gnas chen po gangs ri ti se brgyud du dgongs pa chos dbyings su bsdus pa'o//brgyad pa/ drung 'jam dbyangs seṅge mchoga'adan ma mchog sprul drung 'jam dbyangs seṅge mchog ni (kye zhal gzigs dus sku nyid kyis phyag bris mdzad pa'i lha mo thang ga da ltar rma mgrin la yod/ 80

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig rab byung bcu drug pa'i phur bu zhes pa'i sa/ pho spre'u lor (spyi lo 1968)khams 'dan stod pad 'dab ceru nga/'i grong sder yab mi nyag 'ja' lus pa chos nyid 'od zer gyi gdung rgyud bsod nams dbang phyug dang yum rong thar stobs rgyal gyi rgyud pa bkra shis lha mo gnyis kyi sras su sku bltams/ chung dus nas skye gzugs legs la spyod pa bzang ba kun gyi yid du 'ong ba zhig yod/ dgung lo drug nas yab dang sku'i gcen po sa skya'i g.yag phrug pa sangs rgyas dpa' bo'i mdun nas thog ma 'bri klog bslab/ dgung lo dgu'i thog sde ba'i gzhi rim slob grwar 'grims nas bod rgya'i yig rigs dang ang rtsis sogs legs par sbyong mod/'on kyang /khyim tshang gi 'tsho ba'i thad dka' ngal ha cang che stabs slob grwa nas bud de yab dang mnyam du sa mthar lha slong ba 'gro dgos byung / skabs der yab kyi mdun nas 'jam dpal mtshan brjod blor bzung ba dang / dgung lo bcu gnyis dus nas spar rkos kyi bya ba sgrub nas khyim mi rnams la 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen bskrun/ dgung lo drug nas bcu drug bar du 'jam 81

'dan ma'i tsā khyus gser gyi 'od thig dbyangs kyi gzungs a ra pa tsa na d+dhā:zhal mdon mdzad/dgung lo bcu bzhi thog klu lding mkhan po'i mdun nas rab tu byung / de nas 'bam legs dgon gyi tshogs la zhugs te cho ga chos spyod kyi bskor la slob gnyer gnang / lo bzhin du ang dang po'i bya dga' sha stag blangs/ 'bam legs dgon pa'i mgon bla bskos nas mgon bla'i bya ba mthar phyin pa mdzad/nyin mor yul mi rnams la dge ba'i sna 'dren mdzad nas lung pa de'i rdo lag pa tsam yan la ma ṇi dang a ra pa tsa sogs rkos/ dgun kha 'bri chu'i dar thog tu bye ma'i ma ṇi blug nas yul mi kun gyis bla ma bzhin du brtsi/dgung lo bco brgyad bzhes dus 'brug pa bka' rgyud pa'i bla ma stobs ldan g.yang dga' mchog gi mdun nas snying thig sngon 'gro rtsa rlung 'phrul 'khor dang chags med gnas bshad/ rje btsun mi la'i rnam thar/blo sbyang gdams ngag smra khrid sogs zhus/skabs der nang chen rgyal sras can mdun nas na ro chos drug dang dkon mchog spyi 'dus bcas dbang lung khrid sogs cha 82

'dan ma'i lo thas gser gyi 'od thig tshang ba gson te sngon 'gro'i mtshams yongs rdzogs mdzad/ bla ma stobs ldan mchog gis rang gi gsol phor nang zho gang blug nas khong la khyod rang ma 'ongs pa sems can la phan pa chen po bsgrub par the tshom mi 'dug nga'i gdams ngag gi bdud rtsi zab mo 'di khyod kyis myong bar gyur gsung nas zho de gnang / khong gis zho de gtsang dag bzhes pas bla ma thugs ha cang dgyes/sku nyid kyi thugs la'ang nyams rtogs khyad pa ba 'khrungs/dgung lo bcu dgu thog rang yul pad 'dabs grong du bzhugs skabs kyi dgong mo zhig mgon po ma nor nag po sku dngos su phebs nas khyod rang rong thar shākya'i rnam 'phrul yin pas ci yin yang nged dgon du phebs dgos/ khyed rang nged dgon pa'i rten bdag yin pa nges par du phebs dgos zhes pa sku nyidal lung bstan yang yang 'ong /dgung lo nyi shu thog ser shul dgon du phebs nas 'dzin grwa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen thub mgon dang / se ra dge sogs sten/ bla grwa yongs kyi gtsug rgyan mkhan rin po che thub bstan 83
