'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig dbang po mchog gi mdun nas phar phyin dang dbu ma// 'dul ba/lam rim/ grub mtha' sogs cha tshang ba zhus te slob gnyer yang dag pa mdzad/ ser shul dgon yongs kyi lo mthar rgyugs sprod skabs ang dang po'i bya dga' thengs gsum thob/ skabs der dge skos rin po ches sdang ba dang lhag par dpe cha ba re res phrag dog la ston nas dngos zhugs ma thub kyang zur zhugs mdzad/ rjes su dge rgan mdzad nas slob ma'ang mi nyung ba zhig bskyangs/ dus der sku nyid kyis nyin rer dpe cha mda' tshad ma shog lteb bcu re tsam blor 'dzin nus pa'i blo rig la sus kyang 'gran zla bral/ mkhan rin po che dang khri skal bzang gnyis nas 'jam dbyangs seṅge 'dra ba la sprul sku zhes btags na dngos gnas 'grig gi 'dug ces yang yang gsungs pa ma ched khri skal bzang nas grwa mang tshogs pa'i dbus su khong la skyabs 'jug kyang thengs mang po zhus/ dgung lo nyer gsum thog a rig rdza la phebs te mkhan chen pad tshe mchog la sten nas mi pham dgar lan kun dpa' spyod 'jug dang bod sprul sher phyin/tshad ma rnam 84

'dam ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig 'grel byams chos sde lnga/ dbu ma rig tshogs/ mi pham mkhas 'jug sogs la mtha' phyin pa sbyong / mkhan po mchog nas khong la lhag par du thugs brtse che ba ma zad sku nyid la mkhan po'i thob gnang nas ris med kyi slob bu rnams la tshad ma khrid du bcug dgong lo nyer bzhi'i thog gi dgun khar rang yul du phebs te 'bri chu'i khar skyo sangs su byon nas sku nyid kyi thugs la thun mong ma yin pa'i nges pa zhig rgyud la 'khrungs nas zhabs rjen ma 'khyag rom thog tu phebs pas 'khyag rom rang sa zhur/ pad 'dabs ba ye shes lhun 'grub sogs mi kha shas chu len du 'ong ba dang 'khel nas sku nyid kyis ngas zhabs rjes shig e bzhag ces a mtshar gyi tshul du dris pa/ chu len ba tshos sku mkhyen khyed kyis zhabs rjes shig bzhag rogs gnang na nga tshos ma ṇi dang sirnyi sa ya re khas len chog zer pas na sku nyid kyis rdo zhig gi thog zhabs spos nas zhabs rjes dwangs gsal le bzhag slar yang khong tshos zhu ba la brten nas zhabs gnyis ka'i rjes de bzhag nas phebs/ 85

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig dpyid kyi dpal yon bzhad dus slar yang a rig rdza la phebs nas a rig chos sgar rgya bskyed mdzad par sku nyid kyis mthar ma phyin bar du zhal 'debs zhus nas bzhugs/de nas khams rdzong sar bshad grwar phebs nas mkhan chen pad+ma dam chos kyi mdun nas mngon pa mdzod dang rang stod byams chos 'grel ba sogs zhus te lo gcig bzhugs/de bzhin du dge bka' rnying ris su med pa'i mkhan slob dag la sten nas sku nyid kyis bstan pa thams cad 'gal med du mkhyen nas yul nges med du phebs nas bod kyi rig gnas skor la slob sbyong mdzad pa ma tshad 'dzam gling spyi'i rig gnas la'ang thugs gnyer mdzad/ dgong lo nyer bdun thog skye rgu'i sgrol ma'i byag rtsar phebs nas sgrub pa mdzad skabs zhogs pa zhig sku nyid thugs thun gyi bzhugs dus rang gi mdun gyi brag ngos nas lang tsho dar la bab pa'i gzhon nu ma zhig thon nas nga dpal ldan lha mo yin gsungs nas rang la thim/ thim nas kyang sku nyid kyi thugs la nyams rtogs khyad du 'phags pa 'khrungs pa 86

'dan ma'i lo byus gser gyi 'od jig ma tshad phyi nyin gyi bya ba rnams kyang thugs la tsham tshom med par mnga'/dgung lo nyer brgyad thog spyi lo go drug lo rab byung bcu bdun pa'i 'dzin byed ces pa'i me pho byi ba'i lo'i hor zla drug pa'i tshes bzhi nyin drung dbang sku phreng gong ma rnams dang 'gro mgon chos 'phags la sogs pa'i skyes che dam pa rnams kyi lung bstan dang /lhag par du gling 'di na ched che ba'i nyi zla ji bzhin bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu rnams kyis ngos 'dzin la brten nas 'dan ma'i bde dgongs thub bstan gling gi gser khri la mnga' gsol/ de nas bzung 'dan ma mchog sprul rin po che sku nyid kyis bde dgongs dgon gyi rten dang bstan pa thams cad phyogs yongs nas slar gso dang / lo tsā ba ldan ma rtse mang gi gdan sar ris med 'dan ma'i thub bstan gling rmang nas bskyar bzhengs mdzad/bskyar bzhengs kyi thog ma sa thig 'debs pa'i dgong mor bkra shis sgang du gzims/ dgong mo thun gnyis pa'i skabs 87

'dan ma'i lo khyus gser gyi 'od thig gna' yi chas byed pa'i mi ma yin pa mang po zhig sku mdun du 'ong nas la las nga nam mkha' legs pa'i bka' srung yin zer/la las phyag g.yog yin zer pa dang khyod 'dir phebs pa legs zer nas gar la rol/ gtso bo zhig gis khyod kyis bkra shis sgang du bzhengs nas 'byor ba 'phel la brten pa yun ring gnas/sa dma' 'dabs su bzhengs na dge 'dun 'phel la 'byor ba 'bring / zhes brjod nas da dung khyod la rogs ci dgos kyang nged rnams kyis bsgrub chog zer nas yal song / sa skya'i g.yag phrug pa'i rnam 'phrul rang gi gcen po sangs rgyas dpa' bo dang rong thar rgyal sras/ bstan gsar sprul sku gsum gyis gzim lam du'ang gcig mtshungs te rgyab ri'i thog tu mi dkar po zhig gis phyag tu mdung dkar po khur nas bran rnams la pho brang dmar po brtsigs bcug pa dang / khong gis 'dan ma'i lha khang phyogs la me tog gi rab gnas bzhin gtor 'dug pa dang 'dan ma mchog sprul du nged rnams kyis dus gtan du srung yong zhes rmis pa dang / phyi nyin 'dan ma'i lha khang dngos su las 'go btsugs 88

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig par g.yas thog ba chos sgron gyis me tog gcig rnyed pa rang khyim du khur bas dgong mo rmi lam du mi dkar po 'ong nas nga'i me tog yar khur shog ces drag po byed pa dang / chos sgron nyar ma phod pa grwa pa zhig la sprad/ grwa ba'i rmi lam du'ang de bzhin rmis nas nyar ma phod par gyur/ de lta bu'i rtags dang dge mtshan khyad du mnga' bas ris med 'dan ma'i thub bstan gling bde blag ngang du rkang tshugs pa dang /da dung go dgu lo rab byung bcu bdun pa'i myos ldan zhes pa'i sa mo yos lo'i rgyal ba lha las bab pa'i dus chen nyin dbu 'dzugs mdzad pa'i rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu rnams sku tshe brtan ched dang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang sems can gyi bde skyid la dgongs nas ris med 'dan ma'i smon lam chen mo lo rer bzhin du dgon sde bzhi bcu lhag tsam gyi dge 'dun pa dang bla chen mkhan sprul dag phebs nas tshogs bzhin pa mchis/ nyis stong lo smon lam chen mo'i bsang mchod kyi dus blangs pa'i glog brnyan ngos su mi ser po zhig gis rmog ser po gyon pa zhig kyang shar 'dug pa ngo 89

'dan ma'i lo sa gser gyi 'od dzig mtshar ha cang che ba sems so/ sku nyid kyis phyogs gzhan zhig nas yul mi dbul po dag la 'tsho ba'i thad rogs skyor mdzad pa dang / nye 'khor du ljon shing mdzugs pa sogs tshad ldan gyi bya ba mtha' yas pa mdzad/ lhag par du khams stod 'dan ma'i dwa phrug gso skyong slob grwa zhig dgongs nas nyin mtshan ltos med du slob grwa'i bya ba la brel bzhin mchis/ mdor na sku nyid kyi ched du thab chas cha tshang ba zhig kyang med pa rang nyid la yod tshad bstan 'gro'i ched du btang ba dang gangs ljongs skyes che du mas sku nyid la zhabs brtan dang gsol 'debs 'bul ba dang / thugs kyi dgongs bzheng ji ltar ba bzhin du 'grub pa'i smon 'dun gnang dang gnang bzhin pa lags so/ drung dbang sku phreng rim byon gyi rnam thar bsdus pa re zhig bris zin pa dge legs 'phel/ 90
lte da snye snyekhro rkeṅge wa/ na
phy-iṭ+wāṃr+ghaṃ ༷/gakā//swā/ ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ twe byebye byebyeskre tram̐t+t+waṃ/ jikā ṭ+wāṃ rdo ༵sbya kā ṅgikaubye sdonā ༷kā rnyizlosna ṭ+wāṃr+sha t+na ༵py-i zlozlo

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig 'dan sgrol ma lha khang gi byung ba mdo tsam gleng ba/sman ljongs gangs ri shel gyi mchod rten gyi lcags ri'i dpal ldan tshar du dngar pa'i yul ljongs kyi ya gyal mdo khams sgang drug gi yan lag tsha ba sgang gi char gtogs/ snyan par grags pa'i ba dan rlung ltar g.yo ba'i 'dan sgrol ma lha khang ngam klong thang sgrol ma lha khang zhes pa'i byung ba mdo tsam gleng bar bya ba 'di lta ste/dang po/ gnas gang la bzhengs pa dang gnas de la zhabs kyis bcags pa'i skyes mchog dam pa rnams kyi ming tsam bstan pa/bsil ldan gangs ri dkrigs pa'i yul ljongs kyi nang sa/ses mdo smad sa'i thig le gling ge sar rgyal po'i blon chen sngo rgyud tsha zhang 'dan ma'i bzhugs gnas/ dge bcu'i dpal gyi yon tan du mas rab tu phyug pa'i lha ming mi yul la chags pa 'dan ma ('dan khog)zhes 'bri chu dal 'bab ring mo'i stod rgyud/ shar na nyi zla skar gsum gyi sgron me/ /lho na tsan dan nags 93

'dan ma'i lo byus gser gyi 'od jig kyi bdug spos// nub na gangs dkar shel gyi lha bshos/ byang na gnas ri pad ma'i 'gying sa bcas yul gru phun sum tshogs par dam pa'i skyes bu du ma'i sku bltams yul dang sgam sgrub mdzad gnas/ chos dbyings su bsdus pa bcas gya nom pa'i bya ba brgyud mar bzhugs pa'i gnas mchog ste rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i nang gses lo tsā ba 'dan ma rtse mo dang sa'i zlum bo kun du grags pa gyur pa'i rdza dpal sprul rin po che'i sku gong ma klong dgon paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'gro mgon chos rgyala'aphags pa'i dngos slob drung nam mkha' legs pa/ rgyal ba sku phreng dgu pa lung rtogs rgya mtsho dang de'i sku mched mkhas chen chos khog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/sde dge'i bstan 'gyur gyi zhu dag pa tshul khrims rin chen/karma ba sku phreng bcu drug pa bcas skyes bu dam pa 'di dag sku bltams pa'i gnas yin pa dang / rgya gar phyogs su grags pa che'i jo bo rjes smi ti dzhan dang bod kyi nang chos la mdzad rjes rlabs po che ldan pa'i lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje/ rig pa'i dpa' bo 'ju mi pham bcas skyes mchog rnams chos dbyings su thim pa'i 94

'dan ma'i lo thas gser gyi 'od jig gnas/ rdza dpal sprul rin po che dang gu ru rin po che bcas 'phags pa'i rigs bzang grangs las 'das pa dag gis sgom sgrub rol sa yin pa bcas legs par rgyan pa'i sa dpyad kyi yon tan phun sum tshogs pa'i yul ljongs der/sngon dus rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos sprul pa mdzad nas sa dgra srin mo gan rkyal gyi ru gnon du bzhengs par 'gyur zhes lung bstan pa'i gnas mchog de ni da lta ser shul rdzong gi grong khyer gyi lho phyogs su le dbar bdun cu lhag gi sar/ dpal sde dge par khang gi byang phyogs le dbar nyis brgya drag gi gnas su 'dan ma zhes grags pa de ni klong thang sgrol ma lha khang gang du bzhengs pa'i gnas yin no/gnyis pa/ lha khang bzhengs tshul dang nang rten gtso bo bstan pa/de yang dus rabs bdun par rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos bka' bzhin rgya mo bzas spor thang brgyad cu skor gyi gab rtse 95

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig bkol nas lha khang dang 'phrul snang ra mo che gtsug lag khang rnams sa cha gang la brtsigs pa rtsis pas/ kha ba can bod kyi rgyal khams 'di/ srin mo gan rkyal du nyal ba'i gzugs su shes nas yan lag dang srin lag rnams non par mi 'gyur ba'i gzer bcu gnyis te mtha' 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang bzhi dang yang 'dul gyi lha khang bzhi/ ru gnon gyi lha khang bzhi bcas brtsigs shig de'ang ru gnon gyi lha khang bzhi'i bye brag srin mo gan rkyal gyi lag mthil g.yas gnon pa byed pas gnas 'dir klong thang sgrol ma'i lha khang mi nyag gis lag dpon byas nas thog ma bzhengs su grags/ dus rabs bcu bdun skabs me tog pad ma 'dab brgyad kha bzhad pa bzhin gser ldan dga' ma 'dir rgol bral gyi sa g.yo dza drag byung ste glang rgan thang du pad ma'i ge sar rjes 'gran gyi lha khang de sa'i pad ma 'dab brgyad kyi khug tu lhung nas snang ba'i dbang po'i lam du mthong rgyu med par gyur/don der gzhigs te thams cad mkhyen pa rgyal dbang lnga pas 'bri chu dal 'bab kyi nye 'gram du slar gso mdzad de 'dan 96

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig sgrol ma lha khang zhes brjod/de'i nang rten gtso bo ni lha sa'i jo bo rnam gnyis dang gnyis su med pa'i sgrol ma gsung 'byin ma dang /rgyal ba sku phreng lnga pa'i gsol lha sgrol ma nga 'gro ma/ sgrol ma ja brgya ma/ sgrol ma seng khri lnga pa bcas lo rgyus yun ring yod pa'i gser sku lu ma dang rin thang ldan pa'i mes po'i shul rgyu mang po yod de/ sgrol ma gsung 'byin mar jo bo shākya mu ne'i rin thang dang lo rgyus grub byed bcas gnyis min yin pa zhes bgres bo mang pos smras te sngon rdzu 'phrul gyi bzo bo bu shwa karmas jo bo shākya mu ne'i ldug lhag gis sgrol ma de blug pa zer pa'i gtam rgyud de dmangs khrod du khyab gdal che po yod pa dang / sgrol ma gsung 'byin zhes pa'i ming byung tshul yang gtam rgyud ngo mtshar can zhig brjod srol du bgrang bya mi nyung ba'i sngon du dri gtsang mchod 'os gnas kyi rgyu gnyer pas byang nyi ma rdza chu khar dkar zas rnam gsum la sogs phyugs ldan pa'i rgyu yon slong ched sgrol ma'i gser sku 'di khyer te lam du skyod par zhag gcig chu brtsegs la zhes pa'i ri'i nye 'dabs su bsdad de phyi nyin rta 97

'dan ma'i lo byus gser gyi 'od jigaXbadun dbang po sa 'dzin gyi gong du bzhon skabs nyar tshags gzab nan byas pa'i gser sku de nyid ga song rjes med gyur bas khong 'jigs skrag dang sdug bsngal che po skyes te lam zlog nas 'bri chu'i nye 'gram du phebs te rang lceb kyi bya mtha' rol pa'i tsher lhung lhung du 'bab pa'i chu sgra las rnyog 'dzing skad kyi ma 'khod pa'i dben gnas brag dmar og khug dungos nas skad zhi zhing 'jebs pa'i ngang‘dam nyams ci byed pa yin/ nga 'dir yod’’zhes sgrol ma'i gser sku las gsung byung pas slad du sgrol ma gsung 'byin zhes ming thogs pa dang brag dmag og khug gi ngos su da ltar sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig gi rang byon gsal po mngon/ sgrol ma nga 'gro ma ni dus rabs bcu bdun nang glang rgan thang du sa g.yo byung ste lha khang zhig nang rten sa 'og tu sbas pas rgyal dbang sku phreng lnga pa'i thugs su sgrol ma gsung 'byin gyi tshab gang lags dgongs par khong gi gsol dad rol pa'i sgrol ma'i skus nga 'gro zhig gsung ste sgrol ma nga 'gro zhes ming bkod pa grags/ sgrol ma ja brgya mar mtshan don gsal po ma (kye 'dan ma'i srib phyogs kyi gzhi bdag brag ri zhig gi ming ngo / 98

'dan ma'i lo khyus gser gyi 'od jig nges la phal cher ja sgom brgyas blus par ming du thob pa snyam/sgrol ma seng khri lnga pa ni seng ge lnga'i khri byas pas khyad chos der gzhigs nas btags pa gleng 'dug 'di dag ni lha khang bzhengs tshul dang nang rten gtso bo bstan pa'o/gsum pa/ lha khang de nyid 'phel rim dang ji ltar byung tshul bstan pa/de ni rgyal po srong btsan sgam pas spyi lo 641lor rgya bza' bod du gdan drangs skabs thog ma bzhengs pa dang rgyal dbang lnga pas rab byung bcu gcig par slar gso bgyis/ spyi lo 1956lor dge lugs pa'i dgon rnying 'dir sprul sku gnyis dang bla grwa sum brgya lhag yod pa dang / bgrang bya bcu'i ring rig gnas gtor brlag gi smug sprin ngan pa de dri bral kun khyab ngos nas yal ba'i phyis su/spyi lo 1983lor chos sgo 'byed par bla grwa nyi shu rtsa bzhi yod pa dang /dus dang rkyen bzang po'i dbang du yul sde'i dad chen rnams kyis srung skyob dang gsar bzhengs byas pa brgyud/ da ltar lha khang 'di nyid mdo smad sa'i thig le'i 99

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig bstan pa'i rgyan bu zhig gyur pa ma zad/ si khron zhing chen gyis rig gnas dngos rdzas srung skyob kyi gnas zhes pa'i brda yig kyang gnang yod pa'o/ngo mtshar can gyi lha khang 'di'i bod gangs can pa'i sngon byon gyi skyes bu dam pa'i sems pa dang spobs pa rgya che/ 'dzugs skrun gyi thabs shes mtshon pas/ de bzhin gangs ljongs kyi na gzhon tshos brtson pa'i lam du bskyod nas ma 'ongs bod ljongs su gser 'od 'bar pa'i phra tshom du gzi'i phra re rgyag pa smon/mdo stod 'dan ma'i thub bstan gling gi lo rgyus rags bsdus bzhugs so/bgrang bya stong dang nyis brgya lhag gi lo rgyus ldan pa'i 'dan ma'i thub bstan gling 'di ni yul gangs can pa'i cha shas mdo khams stod kyi char/ 'bri klung dal bu bab pa'i g.yon zur du sa yi dge mtshan khyad par du 'phags par pad+ma'i 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su ze'u 'bru'i dkyil du gdan khri sum brtsegs kyi 100

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od jig thog tu chags pa dang / 'dab ma re rer bzhin mtha' bskor du sgrub gnas dang gtsug lag khang / sku gdungs dang rang byon sogs kyi bskor bar de yang shar du gnas mchog seṅge nags rdzong dang 'dan mkhar shar lung ri drug shar lho ru glang thang sgrol ma lha khang dang rgya bzas bzheng ba'i bzang spyod lcag bris ma lhor rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa sku phreng dgu pa lung rtogs rgya mtsho'i 'khrungs gzhis dang sku nyid kyi lte khrag mchod rten/ lho nub tu 'phags pa gnas brtan bcu drug gi gnas mchog dang zhu chen tshul khrims rin chen gyi gdan sa/ dil 'go ri khrod dang 'ju mi pham pa'i sku gdung mchod rten/ nub tu jo bo smriti dzha ṇa'i gdan sa dang sku gdung mchod rten/ nub byang du slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi lo ltas sgrub phug dang grub thob sgrub gnas/ byang shar du gnas chen pad+ma ri dang rdo rje phag mo'i rang byon bcas kyis dkyil 'khor gyi tshom bu bzhin du yongs su bskor ba'i dbus de la/ lo stong dang nyis brgya'i sngon du o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis rdzu 'phrul gyi skye ba drangs ba'i gdul bya 101

'dan ma'i spo thas gser gyi 'od thig thog ma ba bod kyi rje 'bangs nyer lnga zhes sa steng du grags pa'i dpal 'bar ba'i ya gyal lo tsā ba 'dan ma rtse mang sku bltams/sku na phra ba'i dus yul dbus su phebs nas mkhan slob chos gsum la sten nas gsang sngags rnying ma'i bskor gyi rgyud sde yongs rdzogs dang rdzogs pa chen po sogs la thugs gnyer mthar phyin pa mdzad nas grub pa'i go 'phang dngos su bzhengs/lo tsā ba mchog sku bgres ba'i dus su rang nyid kyi sku bltams pa'i gnas khyad pa ba 'dir phebs nas sgrub pa mdzad/ rim bzhin 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho ltar 'dus nas lo tsā ba mchog gi sgrub khang de'ang rgya bskyed mdzad de dgon par bsgyur/ yul phyogs mtha' dag nas 'grims pa'i dge 'dun pa stong las brgal ba der bshad sgrub kyi grwa'ang btsugs nas 'chad nyan kyi bya ba mdzad skabs der dge 'dun pa rgan rabs rnams dgon pa'i rgyab ri la phebs nas sgrub pa mdzad/lo tsā ba 'das rjes kyi lo lnga bcu lhag tsam gyi rjes su dgon pa la cung nyams chag song bas dge 'dun pa rnams kyang gong 102

'dan ma'i lo sa gser gyi 'od thig gi bde dgongs dang shri ri ma gnyis dgon par bsgyur nas sgrub pa la lhun blangs/ spyi lo dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang bod gangs can gyi rgyal po glang dar khrir 'khod pa nas bzung sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa drung nas bsnub kyang yang 'dan ma'i dgon chen 'dir rma g.yo gtsang gsum phebs par bsten nas rten dang bstan pa la nyams chag ma byung /bod sil bu thor rjes su rim bzhin bu dgon gnyis ched che dar rgyas byung ba ma dgon nyams par gyur/ dus rabs bcu gnyis pa'i nang 'gro mgon ti shrī ras pa shri ri ma dang bde dgongs la phebs nas zab rgyas kyi bka' slob gnang / de nas bzung shri ri ma yang 'ba' rom bka' brgyud pa'i dgon pa zhig tu gyur/dus mtshungs su 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa'i dngos slob drung nam mkha' legs pa mchog gis bde dgongs dgon gyi rten bdag mdzad pa nas bzung bde dgongs nyams pa slar gso dang ma nyams gong 'phel du mdzad pa ma tshad 'gro mgon 103

'dan ma'i lo byus gser gyi 'od thig 'phags pa 'dan yul du phebs dus ched du rang gi dngos slob drung grub thob nam mkha' legs pa'i zab rgyas kyis spyan 'dren mdzad/ lo tsā ba ldan ma rtse mang gi gdan sa 'dan ma'i dgon gyi chags shul la gzigs nas drung grub thob pa la/‘ma 'ongs dus kyi khug so zhig/khyod kyi 'phrin las sprul pa la//rnyiḥyig ming can mtshan pa des//'dir 'ong 'phrin las rgya cher 'byung / /’’zhes dang da dung gnas 'dir‘bkra shis sgang ’’zhes thog dang gsungs nas thugs ha cang dgyes/ drung nam mkha' legs pas bkra shis sgang nas gser lhung bzed gang 'phags pa la phul/ 'phags pas mar gnang nas slob bu bzang po khyod kyis 'dis bka' 'gyur zhig bzhengs gsung pa bzhin drung sprul mchog nas kyang de de bzhin du mdzad/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa mchog bde dgongs su phebs nas shri ri ma dgon pa'i dge 'dun dang bcas pa la dbang lung dang bka' chos mang du stsol/ de bzhin du bde 104

'dan ma'i lo byus gser gyi 'od thig dgongs ni dpal sa skya ba'i ring lugs dri ma med pa mdzad/dus rabs bcu bzhi pa'i stod du drung chos sku 'od zer mchog gis bshad sgrub kyi 'chad nyan du ma mdzad de mtshan bde dgongs su sku nyid kyi dngos slob phul du byung ba bcu yi ya gyal rtogs ldan bstan 'dzin shes rab la skyong du bcugalo rgyus kyi dus mtshams brgyud nas dgon de gnyis la'ang 'phel 'grib ci rigs pa byung / rab byung bcu gcig pa'i nang phyag na pad+mo rgyal mchog thams cad mkhyen pa sku phreng lnga pas gangs can ljongs 'di'i chos srid kyi 'gan tshang ma phyag tu bzhengs rjes 'dan ma g.yas thog dpon gyis gong sa mchog la bde dgongs dgon dang shri ri ma dgon pa gnyis phul/ gong sa lnga pa mchog gis shri ri ma bde dgongs su bsdams te dgon pa gcig tu byas te mtshan yang mdo stod 'dan ma'i bde dgongs thub bstan gling zhes ched brjod dang bcas gnang ba ma tshad zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba'i bshad sgrub kyi dgon sde zhig la bsgyur/dus de tsam nas dgon 'di la dar rgud che chung byung ma myong ba 105

'dan ma'i lo thas gser gyi 'od thig dang grub mtha' ris med kyis tshul du bstan pa bskyangs pa ste ris med kyi bstan 'dzin skyes su gdan drangs nas bka' lung zhus/lhag pa du sprul ba'i sku rin po che rnam lnga yang grub mtha' la phyogs zhen cung zad kyang med pa bshad sgrub kyi grwa la'ang gsar rnying gi slob dpon rnams drangs nas zab chos 'chad du bcug pa dang / lo ngo stong las brgal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams la yang ched che rtsis su 'dzin nas rab gnas dang byil dam legs pa mdzad/bcos bsgyur ma byed gong du'ang bde dgongs su bshad sgrub 'chad nyan gyi grwa yod pa ma tshad grwa grangs kyang nyis brgya lhag tsam zhig mchis/ rig gsar gyi dus zing nang du ngo mtshar che la sgyu rtsal gyi gson nyams ldan pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten mang por god chag tshad med pa byung pas kha thor du song /phyis su rab rgyal lcags bya lo(1981)dgon 'dir skyar gso'i chog mchan thob pa dang chabs cig byin che bka' bstan gtsos sku 106

'dan ma'i lo rgyas gaber gyi 'od thig gsung thugs kyi rten 'thor ba mthong tshad slar bsgrugs te de sngar bzhin 'dan yul gyi dgon sde yongs las sku gsung thugs kyi rten yang rtser son/skabs der dgon 'di yi bla chen mkhan rin po che ngag dbang rnam rgyal dang mkha' lding bla ma/ bla ma rin chen rnams kyis gtso bo mdzad nas yul mi rgan rabs dang shes ldan phugs bsam can rnams kyis rten dang rten gzhi nyams gso bcas phyogs yongs nas bdag 'dzin mthar phyin pa mdzad/(spyi lo 1996)'dzin byed me byi lor drung nam mkha' legs pa sku phreng brgyad pa 'dan ma mchog sprul drung 'jam dbyangs seṅge mchog bde dgongs dgon gyi khrir phebs/ sku nyid kyis dgongs pa rgya cher bzhengs te rten dang bstan pa thams cad nyams pa slar gso dang ma nyams bdag gces legs pa mdzad de mi lo bdun brgya'i sngon nas 'jigs zin pa'i lo tsā ba ldan ma rtse mang gi 'khrungs gzhis gdan sa chen po ris med 'dan ma'i dgon chen thub bstan gling rmang nas skyar bzhengs 107

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig mdzad pa dang / da dung khams stod dwa phrug slob grwa'i slob khang sogs bzhengs bzhin pa mchis/bde dgongs dgon gyi rten grangs kyi mi langs ba yod pa re re bzhin 'bri ma thub par/ sku'i rten gyi gtso bo bstan pa'i sku tshul khrims ma sogs dang / gsung rten gtso bo la drung nam mkha' legs pas bzhengs pa'i bka' 'gyur gser bris ma gtso pa'i po ti stong lhag tsam/ de bzhin du byin ldan gyi thugs rten yang grangs las 'das pa/ mdor na dgon 'di'i lo rgyus dang sku gsung thugs rten rnams 'dan yul gyi dgon sde yongs kyi mtho gras su slebs/
ka phul wa—ṅgehūṃ ——
g.yul dga'('das)bla ma 'jam dga'

'dan ma'i lo sa gser gyi 'od thig 'dan ma'i dus chen gyi skor/ spyir bod mi rigs ni dus chen la gtsigs 'dzin byed pa'i mi rigs shig yin/ bgrang bya mang ba'i lo rgyus kyi dal 'bab ring po'i khrod bod mi la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i dus chen mang po zhig yod par ma zad/ chos dang 'jig rten gnyis ka'i dus chen mang po zhig kyang yod pa dang / 'dir brjod pa bya ba'i 'dan ma chu nyin srib la'ang dus ston dang chos ston/ gnyen ston sogs dga' spro'i gsol tshig dang de 'brel gyi ltad mo mang po yod de/dang po bod kyi lo gsar/ bod zla dang po'i tshes gcig nyin 'dir dbus gtsang dang khams phyogs kyi yul gzhan dang 'dra pa gnam lo gsar bzhad kyi dgyes ston la rol/ nyin 'di'i snga nub nyin kha shas su brel ba che shos kyi dus shig ste lo gsar gyi sta gon gtso bo yar lha la gro nas mar chab sogs mchod pa dang /mar slong po la gro 'bras sha dag gi sbyin pa gtong rgyu g.yo ba dang /sgos su grogs po dang bza' mir bza' btung gro dbyibs sna 111

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig tshogs can dang g.yung drung gi ri mos rgyan pa'i zhib thud gru bzhi/dri zhim khengs pa'i chang rag sder mar gong pa'i bu ram dang shing 'bras sna tshogs/ de min 'dan ma'i nyin phyogs dang srib phyogs kyi lung sde'i srol dang dud ka'i 'khos dpag la gzhigs te mchod gshom gyi mdun nam yang na cha sgam steng sgrig gshom byed/ gzhan yang nyer shu dgu la ja khang nang gi dud rgan thams cad phyags phyis dang g.yo tshang gi rtsig ldebs su du dreg yod sar dkar rtsi yi dkar rtags bkra shis rtags brgyad la sogs pa bkra shis pa'i ri mo dang / phyi sgo'i mdun du g.yung drung ngam bkra shis kyi ri mo sna tshogs kyi dkar thig 'then pa/ log gsar nyin bco lnga'i ring du bsang mchod byed kyi lha shing shug pa thul ba dang / lus mgo mjug gi tshi drag dang gos dri nag can ma lus bkru ba sogs mdor na rten 'brel phyin ci ma log pa byed cing / tshes gcig gi zhogs pa snga langs kyis rgyan gos gzab mchor gyis rgyan te sngon la skar chu len pa dang sku bsang 'bul ba/ mchod khang gi rten mchog rnams kyi spyan sngar mchod mjal 112

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od jig zhu ba/ slad du rang khyim gyi bza' mi thams cad 'dus par gsol ja 'bru dang / gro 'bras phye mar/ chang phud/gro gzan/gro ma mar khu/ sha// thud/sogs ro bcud ldan pa'i zas bzang la ci 'dod ltar longs su spyod pa dang / bza' tshang gi gral 'go la bzhugs pa'i khyim bdag gis zhi dul 'dzum mdangs kyi rnam 'gyur bcangs te khyim mi yongs kyi mdun du gtam gyi 'go ma bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs/ a ma bag dro sku khams bzang zhes shis tshig brjod pa dang sbrags chang phud 'thor ba thengs gsum bgyis slad lhag bsam rnam dag gis 'gro ba sems can thams cad gnam lo gsar pa la ngan 'gog bar chad mi yong ba'i smon lam dang rang gi khyim mi la nad med zhing ci bsam lhun grub kyi smon lam brjod pa dang / nyin der rang khyim so sor spro skyid byed pa las phan tshun mgron skyod byed srol med la kha rtsod dang mthu/ mna'/ sdug ngu sogs rten 'brel ngan pa yi bya spyod gtam gsum gang cir 'dzems bya byed pa/ da dung nyin 'di'i snga dro chu tshod bcu yas mas su 'dan sgrol ma lha khang 113

'dan ma'i lo khyus gser gyi 'od jig gi nye 'dabs su gzhis chags pa'i dud ka tshang mas rta sga chas byas nas lha khang gi rgyab gnas su bsang skor rgya che byed srol yod pa/ lo gsar tshes pa gnyis nas bco lnga bar zas sna grangs mang bshams bsgrigs te bzang sa'i khyim tshang phan tshun mgron 'bod res byed pa dang / 'dan ma'i lo phyug tu lung sde so sos glu len gar rtse byed pa/ na gzhon rnams kyis rta rgyugs byed pa/rgas po dag gis rta dpyad rgyag pa/ 'ben la mda' rtsal 'gran pa sogs dga' ba skyes shing don snying mngon pa'i rtsed mo mang po 'di'i skabs su rol ba'o/'dan ma'i smon lam chen mo/'dan ma'i smon lam ni lo re'i rgyal ba lha las bab pa'i dus chen nyin la 'dan ma mchog sprul drung 7'jam dbyangs seng ges rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu rnams sku tshe brtan ched dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang sems can gyi bde skyid la dgongs nas sde dge dang rdza chu kha/ 'jo mda'/ skye dgu bcas kyi bla sprul grwa jo mang po 'dan ma'i yul du gdano〉 drangs nas rten mchog spyan sngar mchod sbyin gzab rgyas dang 114

'dan ma'i lo khyus gser gyi 'od thig bstan pa rgyas phyogs/'gro ba bde ba'i zhal 'don thugs smon rgya che mdzad kyi red/ bkra shis dge ba'i dus 'di dang bstun nas ma byin pa'i bya spyod srog bcad pa dang du ba 'then pa/ chang rag 'thung pa bcas khas len dam bca' byed bcug pa/sgrol ma'i gter dbang /sgrol ma'i gter dbang ni bod zla dang po'i tshes bcu bzhi dang bco lnga la bod gangs can gyi yul 'di srin mo gan rkyal nyal ba'i gzugs kyi srin lag rnams non par mi 'gyur pa'i gzer bcu gnyis te mtha' 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang bzhi dang yang 'dul gyi lha khang bzhi/ ru gnon gyi lha khang bzhi bcas brtsigs shig de yang ru non gyi lha khang bzhi'i bye brag srin mo gan rkyal gyi lag mthil g.yas gnon pa byed pa'i sgrol ma lha khang gi nang rten gtso bo lha sa'i jo bo rnam gnyis dang gnyis su ma mchis pa'i sgrol ma gsung 'byin mas dbang skul mdzad pa la zer/ 'di'i skabs su 'dan ma'i chu nyin srib dang yul lung gzhan dag las 'ong pa'i bla grwa dang mang tshogs khri yan la gnas/'di ni 'dan ma'i phyi nang kun la grags pa'i chos ston chen po 115

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig zhig go/rta rgyug dus chen/'dan ma'i rta rgyug dus chen ni lo re'i zla bdun pa'i zla mjug gam spyi zla brgyad pa'i tshes shar dus rgyug srol yod/ spang du me tog sna lngas rgyan zhing dgung tu kun phan nyi zer bkrag sa gzhi thams cad rin po che grub pa bzhin pa'i dus su 'dan lung gi tsho pa yongs kyis ka phud sde'i nye gnas su bkra shis rtags brgyad la sogs bkra shis pa'i ri mos bris pa'i gur khang che chung bzo dbyibs mi gcig pa mang po phubs te/ zas rigs sna tshogs nang du bsgrigs bshams la rta ma rgyug sngon nyin kha shas su rta rgyug gi sta gon je legs phyin slad bro gzhas 'khrab pa dang / rta la rgyug sbyong pa/ rgyugs thang la rgyus len byed pa sogs rta rgyugs gong gi gral sgrig yag po byas nas rta rgyugs pa yin/rta rgyug ltad mo la rgyug chen dang 'gros rgyug zha 'phen/ yob 'gyur bcas yod de/ rgyug chen ni rta rgyug ma shugs sna gang ring gi bang rtsal 'gran pa/ rta rgyug 'gran bsdur gong la bdag pos rgyug ma la dar tshon sna lnga'i mdzes rgyan gyis legs bar brgyan 116

'dan ma'i lo byus gaber gyi 'od jig —te bsang khri chen po la skor ba bskor nas bsang btang ste 'gran bsdur nang du mi rta god chags mi yong ba dang ang dang por slebs pa'i smon lam brgyab rjes rgyugs 'go phyin nas dus gcig tu rgyug gi yod/ rgyug mkhan phal cher phru gu lo bcu yas mas sha stag yin/'gros rgyug ni rta 'gros ma'i mgyogs tshad dang 'gros yag sdug 'gran pa/ de ni rgyug thag gi thog mtha' bar gsum la rta rgyugs bkod 'doms pa gtso bo dang ltad mo ba rnams kyis 'gros ma'i mgyogs tshad dang 'gros bzang ngan dbye 'byed byas te ang rab 'bring tha gsum dbye gin yod/zha 'phen zhes rta thog nas me mda'i tsha kha 'gran pa dang yob 'gyur ni rta thog nas kha btags sgrug pa la zer zhing 'di gnyis kyi rta rtsal nyin tu mkhas pa re zung la dmigs bsam gyi bya dga' ras cha dang ja sogs sprod pa'i srol yod/ 'dan ma'i rtags rgyugs dus chen ngo sprod ma go brda gsar 'di lta'o//

'dan ma'i lo sa gser gyi 'od jig 'dan ma'i gnyen ston/spyir sa'i zlum po la 'tsho ba rol ba'i 'jig rten pas khyim tshang skyong ba la/ gnyen sgrig gi bya ba ni skyes pho mo kun gyis tshe smad kyi skyid pa'i ja chang mnyam 'thung dang sdug gi rang sems gso rogs btsal pa yin pas tshe gang bo'i don dag gal chen zhig tu brtsis pa/ de yang 'bri chu sngon mo'i nye 'gram du gnas pa'i tsha zhang 'dan ma'i shul rgyud gzhon nu rnams kyis 'don mos ltar rang dbang rang 'thad kyi mdza' zhing brtse ba'i zhags pas lhan gcig tu bcings nas/ phan tshun bza' zla byed rgyu'i gros mol mi 'gyur gor mo rdo bzhin brjod de yab yum rin po che la bkur pa'i tshul gyis zhus pa las blo 'jags kyi dga' spro'i bdud rtsi 'jo ba las bar chad kyi ser ba gtan nas mi phab pa ni 'dan ma'i yab yum mang shas kyi lugs srol legs po zhig go'adan ma'i pho gzhon mo gzhan rnams kyis khyim don bya ba ni gyi 18

'dan ma'i lo byus gser gyi 'od jig rgyu mtshan gang la'ang mi 'dri ba dang cha rkyen 'dzoms mi dgos pa ni ma yin te/ phan tshun mi rabs bdun gyi tshun du nye ba'i 'brel ba yod mi nyan pa/ rims nad ngan pa phyi rgyud la 'brel 'os pa'i rigs mi gtsang ba dang / chos lugs dang cha lugs mi gcig pa'i mi rigs gzhan dag gi mag pa dang mna' ma 'gro ba bcas su sde pa dang nye mi khyim bdag gis sngon 'gog byed pa yin/ pha mas bu rgyud la sems dkar bcings ba dang / nyi mas 'gro la 'od zer 'phro ba'i gtam gyi dpe bzhin pha ma 'ga' res rang rgyud kyi ma 'ongs pa'i 'tsho ba'i thad la bsam blo gtong stangs mi 'dra bar mig rgyang ring bo med de gnas skabs bcas kyi longs spyod la dmigs shing dpal 'byor gyi 'tsho ba gcig pu la bsam nas u tshugs kyi nye sgrig byas te bu dang bu mo'i rang 'dod kyi bsam blo la zhags pas bcings pa yod mod/'on kyang mang che ba ni de lta ma yin par dus bzhi la sngo pa'i brtse dung ne'u gsing du khyim gzhis kyi me tog pad mar rang mos kyi 'khor nas pha ma la bstod pa'i glu re len nas 'jig 119

'dan ma' lo sa gser gyi 'od jig rten khyim tshang gi bya bar brtson pa'o/gnyen ston gyi mdzad sgo'i bya rim ni bod spyi'i srol lugs dang mthun te/ phyogs khag gnyis kyi mtha' mjug gi gros thag gtsang mar bcad pa rgyud/bla ma la nyi ma dang skar ma brtag cing /bkra shis dus bzang gi nyin zhig gtan la phab rjes/ sde ba kun la gsang ste rta ljang gi 'od zer nub ri'i phag tu yib cing dgung sngon rgyu skar yongs su bkra ste thams cad rmi lam zhing khams su bde bar gnas pa'i dus der bu la rgyan dang gos kyi g.yogs te/ phyi'i rgya sgo chen mo'i g.yas g.yon du chu zom bkra shis pa'i kha grangs mtshon pa bsgrigs shing dkyil du bkra shis mi 'gyur pa'i rten 'brel gyi ri mo bris nas skabs su babs pa'i bus dga' pa'i mdangs kyi rgyang nas yong ba'i mna' ma la re sgug byed cing / bu mo yang gnas su bros pa'i rtags bkod nas dga' dang skyo ba'i mig chu 'don bzhin skyel pa'i a zhang dang 'grogs te tho rengs skar chen gyi dus su khyo bo'i khyim du thon pa red/

'dan ma'i lo sa gser gyi 'od jig de yang bag ma khyo bo'i khyim du 'byor ma thag a khu dang yang na dbang thag chod pa'i mi bdag cig gis bkra shis pa'i mjal dar 'bul ba dang rten 'brel bzang ba'i smon tshig brjod pa/khang pa'i nang rten 'brel gyi sha dang mar/ thud/ gro sogs gral bstar bsgrigs pa de rnams kyi steng kha btags dar sna lnga g.yog pa dang / khang pa'i dbus su bu dang bu mo gnyis kyi gdan bya 'brug kha gtad kyi ri mo yod pa dang g.yos g.yon du tshon ris rnam par bkra pa'i rgya nag bal gdan dang / cog tse bcas bting zhing bsgrigs pa'i thog zho 'o ma dkar zas gsum dang /gro ma mar khu ja chang la sogs rten 'brel gyi dgos mkho gzab cing rgyas pa gshom pa/ de nas bzhugs gral du 'khod skabs bu dang bu mo gnyis sgrol ma lha khang gi phyogs su kha gtad nas sdod pa dang / phyogs gnyis kyi pha ma dang zhang po mgron po rnams g.yas g.yon gyi bal gdan la bzhugs nas skyes bu pho mo gnyis kyi yun ring brtse dung gis skyong pa'i me tog la 'bras su smin pas dga' spro tshul du bkra shis pa'i glu gar 'khrab pa dang rten 121

'dan ma'i lo khyus gser gyi 'od jig 'brel bzang pa'i smon lam mang po smras nas chang mas chang byur byur blugs pa'i dngul phor khyer nas chang phud 'bul ba dang /chabs cig bu dang bu mor slob gso'i nang don ldan pa'i bshad pa'ang gtong srol yod/bya rim 'di dag ni 'dan ma'i bag ston mdzad sgo skabs su lugs srol yin mod/ 'on kyang dus kyi 'pho 'gyur dang mi rigs gzhan dag gi lugs srol gyis shugs can dbang gis da lta la bag ston ma byas gong du pho mo mnyam du khyim gzhis chags nas dpal 'byor kho na yi slad du bag ston bya ba'ang yod pa/ de dag 'dir brjod pa ma yin no/'dan ma'i rgyan gos lugs srol/dang po/ skyes pa'i chas/skyes pa yin na mgo la sog zhwa tshar lo can dang / rna bar gser dngul las rdung pa'i a long la g.yu byu ru phra spras pa dag dang / ske la dngul las grub pa'i ga'u ja sgam 'dra ba re la dar gyis rgyan nas mgul ba dang / stod la 'bu ras kyis bzos pa'i 122

'dan ma'i lo sa gser gyi 'od thig tshil len dkar po gyon/ smad la'ang 'bu ras kyi dor ma dmar po kha zheng shin tu che ba re dang / bod lham mthil brtsegs can sogs gyon/ dkyil la dbyar dgun gyi nam zla dang bstun nas phrug dang tsha ru ther ma sogs kyi mthar stag gzig gi pags pas shan pa dag gyon/ dar gyi ske rags bcangs nas sked la sked gri ring po g.yu byu phra can dang glo gri'am za gri chung ngu re yang btags/ mdun du me lcags dang dngul gyi 'bar khug phra rgyan can dag 'dogs/ sked gri'i 'go mtha' la dar dkar ser dmar ljang gis bkres nas 'phyang ba dang da dung rnam grangs mang po yod kyang re re bzhin brjod pa min/spyir btang gzab mchor la/ mgo la zhwa mo tshe ring dkyil 'khor dang wa zhwa sogs/ stod la tshil len mdog 'dra min gyon pa dang phal cher ba ni dkar pa'o/ de'i thog la nam zla dang bstun nas gong ltar gos gyon nas mtha' la stag gzig gis shan med pa gyon/ bag ston sogs kyi skabs tshang mas stag gzig sram sogs kyi shan pa'i gos gyon pa red/ dbyar dus su 123

'dan ma'i spo thas gser gyi 'od thig gos srab tsam gyon pa dang zhwa mo yang ko zhwa dang bsil zhwa sogs gyon/ rkang la rgya gar nag las thon pa'i ko lham ring thung 'dra min gyon pa dang / lag pa'i mdzub mo la gser dkris kyi rgyan pa sogs rigs sna tshogs mchis/ deng gi gsar skyes mang che ba'i mgo'i ra ba bzhar nas rgya'i lugs srol lam kun gyi ngag rgyun du gsar mgo ‘phin thig’’ces pa de 'jog srol dang / ko bzos yu thung gi lham dang lag bzo'i rkang snam/ stod la bod rngul sogs bskyur nas mgo rnga yongs rdzogs rgya bzos rkyang rkyang gon pa'i lugs srol dar/ yang lo na rgas pa'i skabs su bod lwa ring po gon pa dang mgo la zhwa mo dkyil 'khor rkang la bod kyi brtsegs lham sogs/ bod bzos rkyang ba dang lag la phreng ba bzung ste/ rtag tu khom long btsal nas ma ṇi kha ton byed pa'i lugs srol de rgyun 'dzin byas/gnyis pa/ bud med kyi chas/spel shel ha cang che ba'i thogs la byu ru'i phra btab pa 124

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od jig dag spyi gtsug la rgyan pa dang / g.yu phreng gis mgo dang rgyab thams cad g.yol ba/ rna bar gser dngul las byas pa'i rna rgyan la g.yu byu'i mdzes rgyan spud pa dang / ske la mu tig gi phra rgyan pa'i gzi dang byu ru'i ske phreng gnyis re 'dogs pa/ dus dang bstun nas phrug tsha ru gos chen ther ma sogs la chu sram dkar ba'i mtha' shan khri gang las lhag pa re gon/ dar gyi ska rags steng la dngul gyi shan pa'i chab ma bcings nas de la yang gser dngul gyi lcags thag dang ba so'i glo phreng / 'bar khug khab shugs sogs ma tshang ba med par 'dogs/ dbus nas thon ba'i chu phrug khra bo'i pang khebs rgyab/ rkang du bod lham mthil brtsegs can gyon pa dang / lag pa la byu ru dang g.yu ba so sogs kyi phreng ba dkris pa dang / mdzub mo la dngul gyi sor gdub phra rgyan can gyon pa/ da dung ba so dang dngul las byas pa'i gdub bu sogs kyi lag ske mdzes pa byas/ de dag ni 'dan ma'i bud med rgyan cha spras skabs kyi srol lugs so/spyi btang gi gzab mchor la/ gtsug rgyan dang g.yu phreng 125

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig sogs mgo la btags nas seng ge dang chu srin dbyibs can gyi rna rgyan dang dus rabs kyi rna rgyan 'dra mi 'dra 'dogs bzhin pa dang / kha dog gang rung gi tshil len dbyar dus su rgya gar phur med kyi gong du zhib cha yi ske phreng re dang sgrig pa/ dgun dus tsha ru sogs gyon pa dang lag gdub dang sor gdub sogs kyang gsar du thon pa dag rgyab/ lham ni deng song phal cher ba'i ko lham mtho brtsegs can gyon pa sogs gral dag pa'i mdzes chas spras/ sked pa la chab ma 'dogs pa dang mgo la gtsug spos 'dogs pa ni yul 'di'i khyad chos yin/ rgyun du bud med rnams kyis nag shad che pa'i lwa ring dang rgyan cha nyung shas tsam 'dogs/deng dus skyes mo tsho'ang dus kyi dbang gis wa zhwa dang bsil zhwa bskyur nas rgya'i zhwa mo mchu ring dang stabs bde pa'i rgya mgo bslas te skra sne la me tog bcos ma 'dra min sna tshogs btags pa dang kha ngo la mjes byed kyi ri mo bri pa'i lugs srol sogs dar bzhin no/126

'dan ma'i lo byus gser gyi 'od dzig 'dan ma'i bro chen/dngapo/rgyal mtshan dgon pa ma chags rgyal mtshan dgon pa chags//rgyal mtshan dgon pa chags sa nyi ma shar gyi phyogs//shar gyi rdo rje sems pa rgyal mtshan bla ma bzhugs//rgyal mtshan bla ma'i mdun la bro yi mchod pa 'bul 'gro//rgyal mtshan dgon pa ma chags rgyal mtshan dgon pa chags//rgyal mtshan dgon pa chags sa nyi ma lho yi phyogs//lho phyogs rin chen 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan bla ma bzhugs//rgyal mtshan bla ma'i mdun la bro yi mchod pa 'bul 'gro/rgyal mtshan dgon pa ma chags rgyal mtshan dgon pa chags//rgyal mtshan dgon pa chags sa nyi ma nub kyi phyogs// nub phyogs snang ba mtha' yas rgyal mtshan bla ma bzhugs//rgyal mtshan bla ma'i mdun la bro yi mchod pa 'bul 'gro/

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig gnyis pa/spang la ser bo'i la khar me tog pad+ma ser po steng phyogs lha la mchod 'gro/lha chen tshangs pa dkar po bro la dga' ba yod na bro yi ston mor gzigs rogs//spang la dkar bo'i la khar me tog pad ma dkar po bar phyogs gnyan la mchod 'gro/gnyan chen a khu ge 'dzoms bro la dga' ba yod na bro yi ston mor gzigs rogs//spang la sngon po'i la khar me tog pad ma sngon po 'og phyogs klu la mchod 'gro/klu rgyal gtsug na rin chen bro la dga' ba yod na bro yi ston mor gziṭa rogs//gsum pa/bla ma o rgyan pad ma gang dang gang gi ri la bzhugs 'dug zer/bla ma o rgyan pad ma zangs mdog dpal gyi ri la bzhugs 128

'dan ma'i lo byus gser gyi 'od dzig 'dug zer//bla ma che che chung chung mjal sa la dang la mo phebs 'gro zer//gling phrug ge sar rgyal po gang dang gang la bzhugs 'dug zer//gling phrug ge sar rgyal po khra mo gling dkar stod la bzhugs 'dug zer//gling gi dpa' brtul sum cu mjal sa la dang la mo phebs 'gro zer//tshong dpon nor bu bzang po gang dang gang gi ri la bzhugs 'dug zer//tshong dpon nor bu bzang po rgya nag ri bo che la bzhugs 'dug zer//tshong pa che che chung chung mjal sa la dang la mo phebs 'gro zer//bzhi pa/sa cha yag mo pad ma gdan thog/pad ma yag mo g.yang gi ra ba/ / 129

'dan ma'i lo khyus gser gyi 'od thig ra ba yag mo rang phyogs lha klu bzhugs yod//chos grwa phra mo gso gso gso la rgyas yod//sa cha yag mo pad ma gdan thog/pad ma yag mo g.yang gi rwa ba//ra ba yag mor rang phyogs dpon blon bzhuṭa yod//khrims ra phra mo gso gso gso la rgyas yod//sa cha yag mo pad ma gdan thog/pad ma yag mo g.yang gi ra ba//ra ba yag mo rang phyogs ma sru zhugs yod//gnas ra phra mo gso gso gso la rgyas yod//lnga pa/gangs stod mtho bo ma bzhengs lha khang 'dra byung /seng lcam dkar po ma rdung lha sku 'dra byung //g.yu ral leb mo ma phul yon chab 'dra byung //130

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig brag stod mtho po ma bzhengs lha khang 'dra byung //thang ka rgod po ma rdung lha sku 'dra byung //gshog drug leb mo ma phul yon chab 'dra byung //nags stod mtho po ma bzhengs lha khang 'dra byung //stag mo dmar yag ma rdung lha sku 'dra byung //mdzub drug leb mo ma phul yon chab 'dra byung //drug pa/na chung nga yi pha yul lo chung dukhyod kyi e shes//lo chung khyod kyi shes na rgyal rtse sa thag ring po//sa thag ring du ma bsam bla slob gcig gi chos grwa//chos grwa ma brjed yod na rten 'brel las kyi 'go ma//rten 'brel las kyi 'go ma bsod nams las kyi dang po//na chung nga yi pha yul lo chung khyod kyi e shes//lo chung khyod kyi shes na rgyal rtse sa thag ring po//() lo chung ngam lo phyug 'dan ma la zer ro/131

'dan ma'i lo khyus gser gyi 'od jig sa thag rang du ma bsam dpon blon gcig gi khrims ra/ /khrims ra ma brjed yod na rten 'brel las kyi 'go ma//rten 'brel las kyi 'go ma bsod nams las kyi dang po//na chung nga yi pha yul lo chung khyod kyi e shes//lo chung khyod kyi shes na rgyal rtse sa thag ring po//sa thag ring du ma bsam ma sru gcig gi gnas rwa//gnas rwa ma brjed yod na rten 'brel las kyi 'go ma//rten 'brel las kyi 'go ma bsod nams las kyi dang po//bdun pa/gur gcig gur gnyis gur ma gsum//lha klu dga' ba'i gur lu ser po phud yod//gur 'go mi 'gyur chos kyi char ba 'bab song //gur rked mi 'gyur gser gyi ka ba brgyab yod//gur nang mi 'gyur bla slob bzang po bzhugs yod//gur mtha' mi 'gyur chos grwa stong gi bskor yod//132

'dan ma'i lo byus gser gyi 'od jig brgyad pa/gangs stod mtho bo gcig la seṅge brgya dang rtsa brgyad//seṅge brgya dang rtsa brgyad g.yu ral pad ma 'dab brgyad//g.yu ral pad ma 'dab brgyad steng phyogs lha la mchod 'gro//brag stong mtho po gcig la thang dkar brgya dang rtsa brgyad//thang dkar brgya dang rtsa brgyad gshog drug pad ma 'dab bdu ///gshog drug pad ma 'dab brgyad bar phyogs gnyan la mchong/ 'gro//nags stod mtho po gcig la stag mo brgya dang rtsa brgyad//stag mo brgya dang rtsa brgyad mdzub drug pad ma 'dab brgyad///mdzub drug pad ma 'dab brgyad 'og phyogs klu la mchod 'gro//dgu pa/dgung a sngon g.yang gi ra ba nas//gser nyi zla nang gi nor bu bzhugs//dgung skar tshogs brgyud nas bkra shis shog/sang yang yang 'dzoms pa'i bkra shis shog/ 133

'dan ma'i lo sa gser gyi 'od jig dgon grwa tshang g.yang gi ra ba nas//lha bla ma nang gi nor bu bzhugs//dgon grwa tshang brgyud nas bkra shis shog/ sang yang yang 'dzoms pa'i bkra shis shog/rdzong 'bum ma g.yang gi ra ba nas//gong dpon po nang gi nor bu bzhugs//g.yang bu rta brgyud nas bkra shis shog/sang yang yang 'dzoms pa'i bkra shis shog/'dan ma'i bza' btung g.yos sbyor skor/spyir bod zas ni bod rigs rang nyid kyi khyad chos mtshon par byed pa zhig red la/ bod zas la'ang mi rigs gzhan gyi zas sna dang 'dra ba sna mang zhing ro bcud shin tu ldan pa zhig sgrig gshoms byed rgyu yod/ de bzhin 'dan ma la'ang zas sna gya nom zhing zas bcud phun sum tshogs pa'i yun ring gi g.yo skol gyi nyams myong bsags nas cung cha tshang tsam yod pa ma zad/ rgyu 134

'dan ma'i lo khyus gser gyi 'od jig cha phal cher rang yul nas thon gyi yod stabs skam tshal ltar gyi rin thang ma gnas chen po mi dgos la zas rigs so sor dmigs bsal gyi bro ba yang ldan yod/ bza' btung gi gtso bo ni rtsam pa dang mar/'o ma/gro ma mar khu/sharlangs chen thud pa/sha mog nas chang / bod rag ja bsrubs ma/ sngo tshal sna mang /shing tog gro 'bras/ nas/ bag lo/ gro ma'i thud/ phyur ba'i thud/ sha khu bcas yin/ gro ma mar khu ni gro ma btsos par mar khu dang phye ma ka ras mngar cha rgyab dgos/ sha phal cher zog lug sha dang phag sha bcas za zhing nyung shas kyis nya sha'ang za ba/rlangs chen thud pa ni 'bras rlangs btsos byas rjes rgud 'brum dkar po dang mnga' cha brgyab nas mar khu'i nang sbol pa de yin/sha mog mog sha rngo srol med la sha tshil mnyam du zhib mor btsabs pa'i nang sngo ma nyung ngu re sbyor bsres byas pa zhig yin/nas chang bdud rtsi ni nas btsos te grang ba gyur rjes phabs tshad yod pa zhig sbyor bsres byas nas drod ldan gyi gnas su zla gcig gnyis tsam bsnyal te chang chu ldug nas len pa de ltar yin/135

'dan ma'i lo byus gser gyi 'od thig bod rag dang nas chang gnyis mi 'drar/bod rag ni nas btsos pa la phabs bsres te nyin gsum yas mas bsnyal nas thab ka la bskol ba rlangs pa 'bebs pa'i chu la zer/ gro gzan ni gro zhib btsos rjes mar dang phyur ba/ mngar cha bcas btab ste brdzis pa'i bzo lta sgor ram gru bzhi bzos par go bag lo ni gro phye sbyor ba la me ru bsregs pa'i gro zan leb mo zhig red/bag lo bzo stangs la sha brngos nas nang tshi byas pa dang mar dkar/phyur ba/ mngar cha bcas bag leb kyi dbus su khung bu rkos pa dang / yang nang du ci'ang ma ldug nas leb ngos su mar byug ste thad ka gzan du bya ba yin/ gro ma dang phyur ba'i thud ni gro ma dang phyur ba zhib tu btags nas mar dang ka ra mnyam du g.yos ba'i thud gru bzhi ma dang sgor mo'i dbyibs su mar khus bkra shis mtshon pa'i ri mo bkod pa zhig yin lo gsar dang bag ston bcas kyi dus ston skabs su bkol ba mang / de dag gi zhim mngar ni gtso bo rang gi lag rtsal dang las snon gyi zhib tshags la rag las yod/ gzhan bza' btung yang dus kyi 'pho 136

'dan ma'i tsha sa gser gyi 'od dzig 'gyur dang mi rigs bar gyi 'brel ba'i gser zam la brgyud de 'dra bzo byas pa la nyin bzhin zas sna bzo srol mang po 'phar snod 'gro bzhin yod pa 'dir ma 'god pa'o/gnas chen ko sa la'am pad ma ri'i gnas bshad/gnas mchog pad ma spungs pa'i ri bo 'dir 'phags mchog phyag na pad ma dang tā re pad mo yo gi nī/ slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas bcas mtshan pad ma zhes brjod pa'i skyes bu dam pa dag gis zhabs kyis bcags nas byin gyis rlabs pa'i gnas khyad par can yin pas pad+ma ri zhes grags/gnas chen pad ma ri bo ni 'dan yul gnas chen yongs kyi yang rtse dang 'dan ma'i mkhar gyi g.yas ri klong thang sgrol ma lha khang gi rgyab ri dpal bde dgongs dgon pa'i g.yon ri bcas yin pa ma zad mdo khams gnas chen nyer lnga'i ya gyal te gnas chen ko sa la zhes gar dbang 'gro 'dul gling pas 〈137

'dan ma'i lo khyus gser gyi 'od dzig gter lung man ngag lam rims〉las gsung yod pa dang / phyi'i dbyibs gzugs la bltas na dzam lha'i sku brnyan dang gnyis su mi mchis la thag mi nye pa'i yul dma' bo nas bltas na rngam brjid ldan pa'i ri bo gru 'dzin dang mtshungs pa/ nang du bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi zhing dang / mtha' nas chos skyong srung ma dang yul lha gzhi bdag rnams kyis bskor ba'i gnas yin skabs su bab pa'i brjod bya la/ gnas chen pad ma spungs ri dang mdun ri seṅge gnam rdzong / bye che bskor lam/bye chung bskor lam bcas sa bcad bzhi'i tshul du brjod pa/dang po/pad ma srungs ri/rang re'i bod kha ba can gyi ljongs 'di la bstan pa'i snying po gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa spyi dang bye brag tu zab mo gter gyi 'phrin las kyi gdul ba mtha' yas 'dul ba mdzad pa'i slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas nyid gnas 'dir ched du zhabs 138

'dan ma'i lo sa gaber gyi 'od jig bcags nas pad ma'i shel gyi sgrub phug tu bzhugs/ pad ma shel gyi phug pa ni rin po che shel dang rdo rje pha lam/ rdo yi snying bo bcas las grub pa'i sgrub phug cig yin pa dang / sgrub phug gi nang ngos la gsar rnying gi yi dam mang po'i dkyil 'khor dang rang byon sogs mjal rgyu yod pa/ phug pa'i nang gi g.yon ngos su slob dpon pad ma'i thugs tshab slob dpon nyid kyi sku brag la rang byon gsal bo me long gi ngos bzhin bzhugs pa de thugs sprul dngos yin gleng ba ste/ rdza dpal sprul rin po ches mdun nas thugs sprul pad ma skyes/ /'gro ba'i don la sprul pa 'gyed/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / sku mdun du rang res smon lam bzang bo ci rigs pa 'debs na byin rlabs ni sku dngos ltar yin pas som nyi mi dgos pa dang / phug tu srid pa'i klong nas brdol ba'i rlung gi 'byung ba gnod pa'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa/ der phyag dang smon lam byas na 'byung ba rlung las grub pa'i nad rims thams cad drung nas 'byin pa'i phan yon dang ldan par grags/ phug pa'i phyi ngos kyi brag leb la rtag 139

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig pa'am 'gyur ba med pa'i brda g.yung drung gi rang byon dang mi rtag pa'am 'jig sla ba'i brda la 'ja' tshon gyi rang byon yang 'dug par 'di ni phyi rabs gdul bya rnams la khyad du dgongs nas lam ston gyi brda zhig yin pa gdon mi za'o/dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i nang rdza dpal sprul o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po mchog gnas bye brag pa 'dir phebs nas pad ma shel phug la sku mtshams yun ring bzhugs myong pa dang / skabs der/ 'dan khog gzim dpon yar log tshang gi bu bkra shis dge legs dang 'ju tshang gi bu mo lo nyer lnga lon pa gnyis khyo shug tu gyur rjes mnga' 'bangs longs spyod rgyas nas bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba dpal la rol ba dang / glo bur du yul der rims nad ske skrang gis gang zag mang po dbang med kyi lnga lam du btang / bu bkra shis dge legs kyi chung ma'ang brgal thabs dben pa'i grongs song /bkra shis dge legs skyo ba dpag med skyes te pad ma shel phug tu phebs nas rdza dpal sprul drung du 'khor bar nges 'byung skyes tshul dang rab tu byung 140

'dan ma'i lo thas gser gyi 'od jig 'dod yod tshul sogs rgyas par zhus/ dpal sprul rin po ches rjes su bzung nas kho rab du byung slad khos yang yang bla mar tshe rog shi ba'i sdug bsngal dang 'jig rten 'khor ba'i bya bar don snying med pa zhu par brten bla mas de ga'i khyad chos dang khong gi mi tshe gcig gi lo rgyus dang skyid sdug gi nyams myong la gzhigs te〈lha chos dang mthun pa'i gtam pad ma tshal gyi zlos gar 〉mdzad pa las/ gnas la rtse mtho pad+ma'i ri/ /lha gcig sgrol ma'i zhing khams yin//zhes pa'i gnas 'di'i khyad chos bstan yod pa ltar/pad ma shel phug gi g.yas su lo ma bdun pa'i ri phug yod/'phags pa gnas brtan nags na gnas kyi sku rgyab dang dbu phyag kyi rang byon cha tshang ba zhig ma nyams par gnas yod/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das zhal bzhugs pa'i dus tsam du gnas brtan nags na gnas dgra bcom stong dang bzhi brgya'i tshogs dang bcas pa gnas 'dir phebs nas 'gro don bsgrub bzhin yod pa dang /lo ma bdun pa'i ri phug gi nye 'khor la dgra bcom pa rnams kyis chos kyi bgro gleng mdzad pa'ang bzang 141

'dan ma'i lo rgyas gser gyi 'od jig gsum lhan 'dzoms kyi dus su mjal rgyu dang thos rgyu 'dug zer nas smra srol yod/ 'di'i g.yas su mtshan nyid chu zhes pa zhig yod de/ ha cang ngo mtshar che bas gu ru'i gter chu zhes brjod/chu de phar ltas na zangs khro gang tsam yod pa dang bri gang 'gyur ba med la skabs 'ga' mtshams pa mang nas brgya phrag gis gsol yang 'grib mi 'gror skabs rer mtshams pa gcig las med kyang chu de 'phel ba med la sngar bzhin 'khyil pas/ gu ru shel phug tu bzhugs skabs klu'i yul nas phur ba red ces pa'i zer srol yang 'dug gang ltar chu de ni yan lag brgyad ldan gyi dwangs chu zhig yin pa dang 'byung ba chu la byung pa'i nad rigs 'joms pa'i nus pa yod la char chu yun ring 'bab kyang rnyog rgyu med dgun dus 'khyags rom dang bral pa'i ya mtshan yang ldan/pad ma shel gyi sgrub phug de'i 'dabs su rta phag yab yum gyi phug pa/ rnal 'byor bla med rgyud sde las pha rgyud kyi lha rta mgrin dang ma rgyud las byung ba'i rdo rje phag mo gnyis kyis ru tra 142

'dan ma'i lo khyus gser gyi 'od thig thar ba nag po bsgral te kho'i khog pa la gzhal yas khang gi thig gdab/ yan lag brgyad la gsang sngags 'byon pa'i gnas dur khrod brgyad du byin gyis rlabs/ dbang po'i dwangs ma dang khams dkar dmar las sku gsung thugs kyi rten grangs med dang /mig gi 'bras bu dkar nag las sgrol ma mched gnyis grub cing 'gro ba'i rten skal du gyur/ phug pa der rta phag gi rang byon sogs mjal rgyur da lta gsal po mngon pa/ rta mgrin dang phag mo gzhan du lo bsgrub byed pa las 'dir zla sgrub byed pa'i byin rlabs skyen pa dam pa gong ma rnams kyis gsungs/ de nas 'og tu mar gzhu 'dom bcu tsam bab na/ o rgyan pad ma 'byung gnas mchog gis mdo khams phyogs kyi drag lha gdug pa can thams cad dam la btags nas zab mo gter gyi bdag por bskul dus ma 'ongs pa'i gdul bya rnams yid ches skyes pa'i phyir ram grol ba'i ched du sku rdzu 'phrul gyi phyag rjes mthong ba rang grol mchog bzhag yod/ mthong ba tsam gyi sdug bsngal mtha' dag las grol ba dang lus sems la rgyun mi chad par bde ba 143

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig dang ldan pa 'byung rgyu yod pa phyag rjes de che zhing dag la/blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis 'di mjal ma thag tu yid la dga' bde'i khyab nas rang bzhin gyi phyag 'tshal lo/ de nas phar tsam du zhe chen kun bzang 'gro 'dul gyi sgrub phug dang phyag rjes mjal rgyu yod pa dang / de'i gong du rgyu lcags nag 'dra pa'i pha bong khang brtsegs gnyis tsam zhig gi phyogs thams cad 'ja' ris dang dbus su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dkyil 'khor sogs kyi rang byon 'khrul bar dogs pa med pa dag yod la de gar ma ṇi sogs 'don na phan yon 'bum 'gyur du 'gro ba brjod/sku der 'ga' res 'jigs byed dang sgrol ma phag mo/la las o rgyan mjal ba'ang grags/ de nas mar 'ong na slob dpon pad ma shel phug la zhabs sor 'khod rjes dgra lha wer ma bcu gsum gyis dga' ba'i bro 'khrab pas rjes su rdo la seng ge dang stag dom/ dred mong /ri spyang sogs kyi rjes mngon gsal dod yod pa dang / de'i g.yon phyogs nas thur du mar 'ong na slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas kyi rang byon blta ba'i chog mi 144

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig shes pa zhig yod/ g.yas g.yon du mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal dang lha lcam ma gcig lab kyi sgrol ma gnyis kyi rang byon ha cang dwangs ba'i rnam pa can zhig yod de gu ru gtso 'khor gsum gyi sku mdun du sgo gsum rnam pa dag pa'i smon lam sogs bya na gnas skabs kyi nad mug 'khrug rtsod sogs rang sar zhi ba dang mthar thug zangs mdog dpal gyi zhing khams la skyes ba'i phan yon dang ldan pa grags so/gnyis pa/mdun ri seng ge gnam rdzong bshad pa la/〈gnas yig〉〉las ‘mdun 'khod dpal gyi 'gying ldan seng ge brag’’ces pa ltar gnas de la zangs mdog dpal gyi yon tan legs 'dzoms zla ba'i bod kyi lo rgyus dulas srin mo gan kyal du nyal ba'i lag mthil yin zhes brjod pa'i gnas 'dir phyogs kun du grub pa'i dbang phyug dang rig 'dzin gyi rnal 'byor rnams kyi sgrub phug byin rlabs can mang po yod pa ste/(kye 〈rgyal rabs gsal pa'i me long 〉〉las brjod pa'o/145

'dan ma'i lo byus gser gyi 'od thig dang por/ sngon glang thang sgrol ma bulha khang gi chags shul la gter ston nyi ma grags pas phyag btab dang thog bzhes pa'i bdud 'dul mchod rten shel dkar phung po bzhin pa de mjal ba dang / der phyag dang bskor ba zol med dam ngag sdom nas bskor ba bdun brgyab na bdud kyis mi tshugs pa'i byin rlabs chen po stsol red cig yul sde'i bgres po rnams kyis gleng gin yod de g.yas phyogs kyi 'khris su gter ston nyi grags kyis sman bla bde gshegs brgyad sgrub nas zhal gzigs gnang sa'i sgrub phug yod/'dabs 'og tu sman gter las rjes su shul pa'i khung bu bcas mang po mngon pas sman sgrub phug pa zhes zer/ steng gnas su mkha' 'gro'i 'bum rdzong du grags pa'i mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi sgrub phug dang / nye 'gram gyi khor yug dag la khong nyid gtso byas pa'i mkha' 'gro rnams kyis tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya che po bskor nas gnas 'dir byin gyis rlabs pa dang dus phyis su yang ma cig lab kyi sgrol ma 'dir phebs nas gong bzhin tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen bskor nas byin gyis rlabs (kye klong thang sgrol ma lha khang bris pa'ang yod do/ 146

'dan ma'i lo thas gser gyi 'od thig pa'i rjes shul da lta'ang gsal bor mjal rgyu yod/ ma rgyud kyi yi dam sogs phug pa 'dir sgrub na zab lam myur bar gsung /gnas 'dir rang bzhin gyi dri bzang 'thul bas slebs pa tsam gyi khams dwangs bar 'gyur pa'i yon tan dpag med yod pa dang de'i g.yon phyogs kyi mtho sa la lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje'i mtshams phug brag la khyad mtshar gyi sgo dang sge'u rang byung sgrub pa zhig yod de/ dus rabs brgyad pa'i mjug la gong nyid kyis gnas 'di byin rlabs che ba dgongs nas zhabs kyis bcags nas sgrub pa yun ring mdzad pa dang / 'og tu lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje'i gdung rten las bzhengs pa'i byang chub mchod rten dang bcas pa 'di na bzhugs yod/mchod rten gyi g.yon nas song na gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i gnad la phul du phyin zhing mthu dang rdzu 'phrul la mnga' rnyed pa'i rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i nang gi lo chen bai ro tswa na gnas 'dir ched du phebs nas sgrub pa mdzad pa'i phug pa dang de'i 'khris su pha dam pa sangs rgyas kyi sgrub phug pha dam pa gangs kyis ra ba bskor pa'i yul ljongs la 147

'dan ma'i lo byus gser gyi 'od thig lan skor lnga phebs pa nas thengs dang po mdo khams phyogs la phebs dus gnas mchog 'dir bzhugs par grags/ de dus gnas 'dir chos ston pa'i gdul bya med pas yul mtha' 'khob cig yin yang phyis su gnas 'di dag la sangs rgyas bstan pa dar bar 'gyur pa'i byin gyis rlabs/ de ma tshad spyi lo1113lor glang thang sgrol ma lha khang du dpyad kyi dkar nag khra gsum gter du sbas ba mdzad/ de nas phar ma ṇi'i rang byon sogs mjal nas song na gangs can grub brgya'i gtsug nor rje btsun mi la'i sgom phug bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod/ de'i yar thog tu phyi rabs gang zag rnams la 'chi ba mi rtag mtshan byed kyi sku'i rdzu 'phrul gyis bskrun pa'i bar do'i zung khung zer pa'i brag khung bu can zhig mjal rgyu yod/ seng ge nag rdzong gi lho nub phyogs nas mar 'ong na 'brom ston dga' 'phag zer ba'i jo bo rje bod du phebs dus su 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas 'dir mtshams la bzhugs skabs/ jo bo bod la phebs pa'i gtam de 'brom ston nas gson ma thag dga' spro bsam gyi 148

'dan ma'i lo thas gser gyi 'od thig mi khyab pa skyes nas bro 'khrab pa'i zhabs rjes yod pa dang / de nas mar 'ong na chos sku rang byon yod sar slebs pa/ der rje btsun sgrol ma'i rang byon dang rgya bzas bzhes pa grags pa'i kun du bzang po'i rdo brkos ma zhig yod/ de'i mtho phyogs la 'dan ma'i tshogs gtor zer ba'i yul sde kun gyis shes pa'i ri de'u 'bur zhig tshogs gtor bzhin khyad chos ldan pa'i rang byung gi dngos po bcos min zhig mig lam du gsal/gsum pa/bye chen bskor lam bshad pa/'dir bye chen zer ba ni gtan 'bebs bgyis pa'i lam thag tu bskor dang gcig tsam brgyab na sirnyi bye chen gcig 'don pa'i phan yon yod par bye chen zhes brjod/bye chen bskor bar nyin gcig gi dus 'gor te dang po glang thang sgrol ma lha khang nas gtsang rgyas pad ma/ gtsang rgyas pad+ma ni sngar bstan pa tshong dpon nor bu bzang po'i skye ba bzhengs dus 'dir phebs nas zhag gcig bzhugs myong zer srol yod la/da ltar der rde'u 149

'dan ma'i lo khyus gser gyi 'od thig 'bum zhig bskor rgyu yod pa dang / de nas song na ngo mtshar can gyi sirnyi brag dkar la slebs te bshad rgyur zangs mdog dpal ri'e chags tshul yod zer/ gang ltar brag la sirnyi rang byon 'dra ba zhig yod pa gor ma bkum/ de nas mi ring pa'i gnas su bstan 'gyur brag ces pa zhig yod de bstan 'gyur cha tshang zhig dang rdo zur dag la yig 'bru'i 'bur dod pa'i rang byon mngon la/ de'i yar du 'dom pa bcu phrag gi gnas su bka' 'gyur brag yin par phar lta skabs gzhung po ti brgya phrag mang po brtsigs yod par zur dag yi ge'i rang byon yang bsnyon med gsal zhing bzang spyod dang shes rab snying bo sogs 'don na bka' 'gyur dag 'don dang phan yon mnyam zhig grags/ de nas rnga rdung brag zhes par slebs brag 'di ni ngo mtshar khyad du 'phags pa'i brag zhig yin/ dus bzang tshes bzang 'phrad skabs brag de nas rnga dang sil snyan rol mo sogs kyi sgra thos rgyu yod pa ma zad/khor yug kun tu dri bzang gis khyab/skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi mthong lam la dgra bcom dag gis chos kyi bgro 150

'dan ma'i lo byus gser gyi 'od thig gleng mdzad pa'ang mjal pa'i go skabs yod/ de'i nye 'gram du bkra shis mtshan bya bar 'phags yul gru ba thob chen po sa ra ha pa bod la thog ma phebs pa'i gnas yin/ bkra shis mtshan zer ba ni grub mchog nyid nas rten 'brel gyi sgo nas mtshan btags pa lags/de'i gsham du 'dan ma'i sgrub phug la 'dan mas 'chi med tshe yi lha tshogs 'grub ste skye 'chi rang dbang thob pa grags la/ sgrub phug kha la rtswa klu bdud rdo rje zer ba dang chu 'gro ba 'dren pa zer ba sogs yod pa/ sgrub phug gsham du shug pa'i 'dab mas phyag rgya rol nas skye yod pa'i rang byung gi ngo mtshar che ba'i rtags yag po yod/ 'dan ma'i sgrub phug nas mar bab song na glang chu'i phar ri la slebs/ de'i kha thad la brag cig yod pa der rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rang byon khra lam me mjal rgyu ldan la de'ang phyag dang smon lam byed rgyur gal che/ de nas glang chu'i tshur rol la ka la pad mo zer ba'i rde'u 'bum zhig la slebs der bskor ba byas nas lo chung rjongam sgrol ma lha khang la thon no/(kye lo chung ni 'dan mar nas kyi rdzong zhes brjod pas lo phyug nas sgra 'gyur pa 'drar/'dan khog gi mi gzhan no/ 151

'dan ma'i lo khyus gaber gyi 'od jig bzhi pa/bye chung bskor lam bshad pa/bye chung skor lam du bskor ba gcig la ma ṇi bye chung gcig gi phan yon yod pas na bye chung zhes zer/de yang dang po sgrol ma lha khang dang gtsang rgyas pad+ma/ de nas la brgyab ste gong du bud na dur khrod glang mo rgyan bya ba slebs/dur khrod der rgya gar bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod nas sa rta stan tsam zhig khyer 'ong pas/ 'di dang bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod dang khyad med gsung nas sngon byon skyes bu dam pa rnams der sku gdung bzhus pa dang bya la btang ba/ rjes su yang yul 'di nas bla sprul 'ga' zhig gi gdung bzhus/ de nas song na gong du brjod pa'i bar do'i zur khung la slebs/ de'i thog la gna' bo'i mkhar shul zhig yod pa la bod sil bu thor rjes su 'dan ya lung khri ka rgyal po'i pho brang gi shul yin pa dang / kha cig gis be ri rgyal po'i pho brang gi shul yin zer ba'ang yod/ de nas song na mkha' 'gro'i bro ra zer pa'i dur khrod la thon/ dur khrod du ma dang mkha' 'gro rnams kyis gshin po'i rnam shes thar 1 da2

'dan ma'i lo khyus gser gyi 'od thig lam drangs pa'i byin rlabs yod pas deng sang yang phung po 'di gar 'jog pa rgyun mi chad/ dur khrod kyi nye 'dabs su 'dan ma'i nas rdzong gi phab shul te zheng che pa'i brag shur nas rgyun ldan du rde'u nas 'bru 'dra ba zhig bab kyin yod pa/ de nas pad ma ri'i zur nas 'ong ba gong du pad ma ri'i gnas bshad skabs kyi o rgyan pad ma 'byung gnas gtso 'khor gsum gyi rang byon dang dug sbrul ri bor thug de ni gu ru rin po chen pad+ma shel phug la bzhugs skabs dug sbrul dam la btags pa'i shul yin/slob dpon mchog gis rdo rjes gnon pa'i na sbrul sked par rmas pa'i rma shul yod pa/ mtha' mar ka li pad+ma dang sgrol ma lha khang du'o/smras pa/ bye chen bye chung bskor ba gcig tsam gyis//phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab yod pa de//kho bos sgro btags bya ba ma yin te//sngon ma'i gnas yig dag la zhib par gsal//153

'dan ma'i lo sa gser gyi 'od jig 'dan ma'i nyin phyogs gnas kyi bshadapa/'dan stod 'bri chu bab rgyud nyin phyogs kyi char mtsho sngon dang si khron gyi mtshams nas spyi le lnga tsam gyi sa la rtse 'dabs sde pa'i lung pa yod pa dang / de nas rtse chu zhes pa'i chu chung chung de brgyud nas song na stod la rdza ri dang gangs ri/ bar la sngo ljang g.yu'i gdan gyur gyi spang ljongs/ smad la stug pa'i nags tshal gyis rgyan pa'i lung pa de la rtse khog ces brjod/ lung pa 'dir gcan gzan dang ri dwags sna tshogs yod de lhag par du deng sang rgyal spyi'i srung skyob kyi rim pa dang po yin pa'i sha ba dmar skya'ang mang po yod/ ri dwags gzhan ni grangs kyi mi langs/ de las kyang mang ba ni bya bye'u rigs yin la/ bya rigs mi 'dra ba'ang nyi shu lhag yod/ nye char rgyal khab phyi nang gi gnas bskor pa dag gnas mchog 'dir 'ong dang 'ong bzhin pa yin/sde ba'i gang zag dag la ya rabs dang dge ba'i spyod rgyud 154

'dan ma'i lo sa gser gyi 'od thig bzang po'i goms pas na ri skyes srog chags dang bya bye'u dag la gnod 'tshe gtan nas mi byed pa ma tshad da dung de dag la srung skyob gang thub byed kyin 'dugalung pa'i phug tu gdong 'gu zhes pa'i grong tsho de'i g.yas ri shug nags kyi gseb tu chags yod pa'i dgon pa de ni rtse ras dgon pa ste/ 'bri gung bka' brgyud dgon pa zhig yin pa dang da ltar rtse ras sprul sku sku phreng drug pa dkon mchog ngag dbang 'phrin las mchog gis bdag gnyer byas te bzhugs shing /dgon pa de sngar g.yon ri'i spo la gnas kyang nye char g.yas ri la spos nas bang rim gyi dbyibs su gyur/ lung pa'i gzhung tsam du chags pa'i ja ri grong sde'i lung shul rgyud nas mi ring pa'i gnas su shug pa'i nags khrod kyi nang du ja ri jo mo dgon pa mchis/ dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i nang stobs ldan bstan 'dzin shes rab kyis phyag btab pa nas bzung nye 'khor gyi jo mo rnams byin rlabs can gyi gnas mchog 'dir phebs nas slob gnyer mdzad/ da lter mkha' 'gro ma lo brgya dang bcu phrag 155

—— 'danama'alo rgyus gser gyi 'od dzig gnyis lhag tsam lon pa zhig gis dgon bdag mdzad nas sku lus ha cang bde thang ngang bzhugs yod do/ dang thog lung pa 'di la gser pa zer zhing rjes su sgra gdangs 'gyur nas rtse pa 'bod pa dang / lung pa 'di gling gi skabs su gser pa mched brgyad kyi yul sde'i shul nas chags pa'i sde ba dang / gser pa'i nyi 'bum dar yag gi mkhar dmar gyi shul yin par grags pa'i pha bong sha stag las brtsigs pa'i rtsig rmang dang ha cang rgya che pa'i gyang gis mthar bskor nas bzhengs 'dugadhide nas rtse chu'i smad la gu ru'i sbas yul zhig yod pa der seng ge'i rang byon mngon pa'i pha bong zhig yod pa nang du gnas ri 'bar rda gser kong gi lde mig yod zer/ pha bong der gzungs dang ma ṇi'i rang byon yod kyang la las de dag gsal ba byed ched yig gzugs rkos nas da ltar rang byon gyi rin thang med pa bsgyur 'dug 'di 'dra ba deng sang mang po zhig 'phro brlag bzo bzhin pa/ de la chu 'go zhig yod pa dbyar dgun nam yin yang khrus brgyab mkhan mang ste yul mi rnams (kye 'di la ngos 'dzin tshul mi 'dra ba yod pa gser rta la'ang 'di'i mkha' shul yod pa grags/156

'dan ma'i lo khyus gser gyi 'od thig kyis char 'bod chu 'go zer zhing char chu dkon dus bla ma dag gnas der phebs te char chu phab pa las mi bab pa'i the tshom med pa goms/de'i g.yon gyi mi ring sa na gur gsum zhes pa'i grong sde zhig yod pa de'i nye gnas su lung pa sa pham nang du lha rje rtse ram par grags pa'i gzhi bdag cig yod la rtsi shing dang srog chags sman rigs sogs bgrang gis langs pa dka' ba ste/shug pa/stag ma/ thang shing /pe lo shing /su ru/spen ma/glang ma/'om bu/sur dkar sogs shing rigs mang po dang /stag (bshad srol)gzig dred mong / phag rgod/sha ba/dom/gla ba/dgo ba/ 'phar ba/wa/ spyang ki bcas gcan gzan dang ri dwags kyi rigs/ dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu/ dbang po lag pa/ rtsa mkhris/ bong ba dkar po bcas sman rigs mang po yod/ gnas de ni 'dan yul gyi rang byung dngos po'i gter mdzod yin pa brjod/de nas 'bri chu'i rgyud nas mar 'ong na dge lugs pa'i dgon pa 'bar rda dgon pa la slebs/ dben gnas dgon pa'i 157

'dan ma'i lo khyus gser gyi 'od thig 'dabs su chos lung nang nas bzhur pa'i chos lung chu'i 'gor song na gnas ri 'bar rda gser kong du slebs/ bka' rab 'byams bstan pa dar rgyas kyis gnas sgo phye ba dang khong ni dkar mdzes gor lo sa khul brag gdong zhes par sku 'khrungs te byis pa'i dus su dar rgyas dgon pa'i chos grwar zhugs/ na son rjes khong nyid dbus la phebs te 'bras spungs su slob gnyer mthar phyin mdzad nas rab 'byams pa'i go 'phang mtshan snyan thob/ de nas khams su phebs nas gor lo lung pa'i brag ri'i yo kyu brag dkar sgrub phug tu sgrub pa yun ring mdzad de mthar grub pa'i go 'phang rnyed/ de nas khong gi sgrub phug tu nyin bzhin ma dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bskor pa yul mi rnams kyis mthong /sgrub phug sgo la rtag tu bud med mang po yod pas yul mis ma dad pa dang dar rgyas dgon gyi grwa tshogs las kyang phud/ nyin zhig gi dgong mo la grub thob rin po ches sring mor 'gro ba'i don chen zhig mchis pas nub phyogs la phebs pa yin zhes gsungs te 'dan khog tu phebs 'bar rdo chos lung nas mi rgan 158

'dan ma'i lo rgyas gser gyi 'od thig zhig la thug pa khyod kyi ming ci btags dris par bgres pos nga'i ming la chos ldan zer/ de nas lung pa dang chu'i ming dri skabs mi rgan gyis chos lung dang chos chu zhes brjod/ rab 'byams pas rten 'brel 'grig song smras nas lung pa'i phud la phebs te 'bar rda gser kong gi gnas sgo phyes/ /khong gis sgrub khang zhig kyang brgyab/ de'i nang sku gsung thugs rten grangs kyi mi langs pa yod pa de dag mang che ba chos ldan tshang nas bzhengs/ chos ldan tshang gis bzhengs pa'i rten gyi zhabs su chos ldan tshang zhes pa'i gser yig gi rtags gsal yod/ rten gyi gtso bo byams pa gsung 'byin ma zhig yod pa rig gnas gsar brje skabs su brlags zin/ da ltar de'i sku tshab byams pa dang ris med kyi yi dam mang po'i sku 'dra bzhengs pa'o/'bar rta gser kong gi gnas 'di ni rigs gsum mgon po'i gnas yin la mthar bskor du gnas srung ma rdu ral ba dang ca rdu ral pa sogs ral pa spun bdun gyis bskor yod pa dang / gnas 'di la gnas phug che chung gsum yod la dang po 159

'dan ma'i lo khyus gser gyi 'od jig gnas phug de'i phyi dbyibs la gnas chen dag pa tsa ri'i bkod pa cha tshang ldan pa dang / gnas phug gi sgo la dam can rwa 'od rgyal po dang ma rdu ral pa sogs kyi rang byon/ nang du bod yul gyi gnas chen mang po'i rang byon gsal por ri mo bris pa bzhin yod pa/ 'dren byed kyis mthong ba dang por dal 'bab chu bo ring mo dgu dang brgal lam zam pa chen mo dgu yod pas la dgu dang lung dgu'i rang byon yul ljongs bcos ma la 'gran pa/ tsa ri'i dkyil 'khor thang gi rang byon dngos dang stod gangs rin po che ti se yi rang byon/ mtsho sngon po khri shor rgyal mo'i mtsho snying dang bcas pa'i rang byon ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gtor dang tshogs chang gi rang byon/ dkar po ya 'gran zhes pa brag dkar po gcig las gcig mtho ba'i dbyibs kyi rang byon/bka' srung la ral ba spun bdun/ sku gsung thugs bcas rang byon mang po yod/ nang du mjal khar 'gro dus dpal 'bar mang tsam khyer pa ma gtogs glog dang mar me sogs kyis mthong ba dka'/ phug pa'i phyi la khung bu mdzub mo 'dzul sa zhig yod pa 160

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig der mig btsums te mdzub mo btsugs nas tag tag thad dus pha ma la drin lan 'jal thub zer pa dang / gal te mdzub mo khung ba la ma thad na de las ldog pa brjod/ de'i gsham du klu mo'i 'dzul khung zhig yod pa'i nang du 'gro ha cang dka'/ thar na dge ba mang pa'i lung rten dang ma thar na sdig pa mang pa'i rtags yin zer/ gnas phug 'bring ba'i gzhung du ma ṇi rang byon dang rdzu 'phrul bya rgyal gyi gshog rjes/ phyag rdo sogs yi dam gyi rang byon yang 'dugaganas phug chung ba ni gser kong ngam sgrub phug gi mdun du gting mtha' bral ba'i sa dong zhig yod pa de yin la/ dong gi nang du ro mngar zhing mkhal nad bad kan sogs phan pa'i sman rigs cong zhi len rgyu yod/ de la'ang cong dkar dang cong dmar zhes pa sne gnyis yod pa la pho cong dang mo cong zhes gso rig nas bshad pa de yin no/cong dong du dpangs tshad spyi khru brgya tsam yod la thag pa mang po sne mthud de mi btags nas dong du mngags tshe mi drug 161

'dan ma'i lo byus gser gyi 'od thig bdun tsam mnyam du gtong ba ma gtogs len pa dka'/ mi gnyis kyis cong zhu len dgos pa dang gzhan gyis dpal 'bar bzung nas gsal ba byed pa/ dong gi 'ga' phyogs su zheng chung ba dang mtho tshad dma' pas 'gro ha cang dka' ba/ de'i g.yas nas la 'go'i bar du bka' rab 'byams bstan pa dar rgyas kyis gnas sgo thog ma phye dus bzhag pa'i zhal rjes re re bzhin gsal le mjal rgyu yod/ gser kong rgyab kyi brag ngos la khong gis gnas 'di'i gnas yig sbas pa'i yul du grags par 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs phyag stong gi rang byon cha tshang ba yod pa dang / pho ba'i nad yod pa rnams pho ba gtug na nus pa khyad mtshar thon pa'i rdo dang / mgo nad yod na mgo bcug pa las drag pa'i rdo khung bcas kyang yod/ stag lor gnas bskor na phan yon yig brgya dung nyer bzhi dang ri bskor la yig brgya dung bcu gnyis/ bar bskor la yig brgya dung drug gi phan yon yod pa grags/162

'dan ma'i lo byus gser gyi 'od jig rma mgrin dang dung lung nang bar gyi gnas bshad pa/'brug sgras mngal chags kyi mgrin dbyibs 'dra pa'i sa ngos su bzhengs pa'i rma mgrin dgon pa ni sngon chad rnying ma'i dgon pa duzhig yin pa dang / rgyal dbang lnga pa'i yongs 'dzin 'jam dbyangs dge 'dun rgya mtshos dge lugs par bsgyur nas dgon pa'i bya gzhag 'gan bzhengs mdzad/ bod gzhung gis dgon pa 'dir lha khang ser po bzhengs chog rgyu'i chog mchan yang gnang /yi dam gsang bde 'jigs gsum dang chos skyong la dpal ldan lha mo dam can chos rgyal sogs dge lugs pa'i thun mong srung ma rnams bstod pa dang / gzhi gsum gyi phyag las ma tshang ba med pa gnas/ da skabs dgon pa'i bdag gnyer rdo rgod sprul sku yin pa'o/dgon de'i rgyab ri brag la spyi khru bdun can gyi rje btsun byams pa mgon po'i rang byon dang rgyab phyogs su rdo ra dkar () bka' brgyud brjod pa'ang yod/163

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od jig mo'i nang du gting mtha' zab pa'i sgrub phug de ni o rgyan gyi sgrub phug yin zer/ phug pa'i sbug tu song na thon pa dka' la'ang rang byung gi 'od zer gyis mun pa bsal la 'jam thing thing gi zhor du dal 'bab phran bu zhig 'bab pa'i shor sgra las gzhan ci yang thos rgyu med/ sgrub phug 'di'i nang o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas zhag bdun gyi ring mtshams gnyer byas pa grags/brag phug de'i rgyab tu thad thug g.yu mtsho 'khyil zhing mtsho chung 'di'i nang du nya sogs srog chags med kyang klu btsun po gnas pa brjod de char 'bod rnams kyis bum pa phul na char 'bab kyi nus pa ldan pa smras/ rma mgrin nas gzhung lam brgyud nas 'ong na 'dan yul gyi yul lha btsun shos dang ri bo mtho shos lab pa'i jo bo dpal seng gi nye 'dabs pad ma nang dhidu slebs/gnas der drung grub dbang sku phreng gnyis pa drung chos sku 'od kyi gdan sa yin pa dang /bulung pa'i 'dabs la pad 'dabs zer ba'i sde ba che shos shig yod de dang thag mi ring pa'i gnas () bar khog dang sham sil yang zer/() 〈drung chos sku 'od zer gyi rnam thar drung grub dbang sku phreng rim byin gyi rnam thar 〉〉las gsal/ 164

'dan ma'i lo rgyus gser gyi 'od thig su dpal sa skya pa'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa'i 'dan stod 'bam legs dgon pa chags yod pa dang / de nas g.yas g.yon gyi grong pa kha shas brgyud na dge rong du thon te 'bri gung bla ma rig 'dzin rgod ldan sku 'khrungs sa yin pa dang de'i nye gnas su dung lung 'dabs la slebs/ khong du yar song na rig 'dzin gter stod gling pas gnas sgo phyes pa'i o rgyan gyi gnas mchog 'dzam gling nang thon/dhiganas 'dir yar gsom dang mar gsom gnyis yod pa smad du gsom shug gi nags phran yod pa dang / 'dzam gling lung gzhung nas song na dang po mar gsom nam mkha' lding brag tu thon der sgrub phug ha cang che po zhig yod par o rgyan rin po che'i sgrub phug yin/ mkha' lding brag la zla bdun sgrub pa brgyab ces gsung pa bzhin zla ba bdun bzhugs myong pa'i sgrub phug cig yin/sgrub phug gi sbug tu sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi dus su ting nge 'dzin la snyoms pa bzhag pa'i rang rgyal dgra bcom zhig bzhugs yod/ sku lus ni shing phra ma lta dang dbu la'ang ral ba shing lo bzhin skye yod/() 'dzam gling nang dang 'dzam gling gzhung zhes pa ni gnas 'di'i sa ming yin/ 165

'dan ma'i lo thas gser gyi 'od jig shangs sgo nas dbugs phra mo yod pa zhig mjal rgyu yod/ sgrub phug de'i phyi mkha' lding brag ngos la 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i rang byon yod de mjal nas smon lam sogs 'debs na bsam don 'grub rgyu yod pa'i the tshom med zer/ o rgyan rin po ches kyang thugs rje chen po'i sgrub pa mdzad pa/ mar gsom brag la thugs rje sgam sgrub mdzad gsung pa ltar mar gsom ni thugs rje chen po'i gnas yin pa gsal po ston yod/ 'di nas tshes dus bzang ba'i skabs rer rnga dang rol mo'i sgra chen sgrog nas 'bri chu'i pha rol du'ang go ba grags/ de'i phar tsam gyi brag ngos chen po ni 'dzam gling yar gsom yin/ 'di ni o rgyan gyi gter yul yang dag pa zhig yin pa ma zad o rgyan gyi rang byon ngo mtshar ldan pa'ang yod/ngo mtshar che pa'i rang byon de nyid gnas phug gi nang du dod de da dung de'i 'gram du zur khang dang pha ma drin lan 'jal thub min gyi lta dpyad byed yul sogs yod/ches legs pa zhig ni sgrub phug kha'i brag ngos la khung bu ha cang chung ba zhig yod pa 'bud na dung skad lhang lhang grags pa/ mdun du 166

'dan ma'i lo rgyas gaber gyi 'od jig dmyal ba'i khro zangs zer ba'i khro zangs kyi dbyibs chags rdo 'khor zhig yod pa/ sngon gyi bshad srol du chos dung de 'bud thengs rer dmyal pa'i khro zangs nang du chags pa'i sems can rnams gcig kyang ma lus pa bde chen zhing du 'dren pa lab ste gnas bskor bas 'bud par goms mchis/ de'i yar gnas su pha bong zheng chen g.yag bzhin du rdung na rnga skad rang grags pa dang phan yon gong gi chos dung dang 'dra ba bshad/ mkhris su gser len khung bu rjozhes pa brag ngos la yod pa'i lag 'go thar tsam gyi khung bu dogs ldan zhig yin/ lag 'go nang du bcug na rang rang gi las dbang dang bstun nas dngos po re rnyed rgyu yod zer/mi mang gis len yang 'dzad pa med pa brjod/g.yas kyi gsham du sa yi lha mos o rgyan rin po che la phul ba'i rin chen maṇ+ḍal yod/ maṇ+ḍal de ni rin po che sha stag las grub ste 'bur dod kyi ri'i mthar bskor du da lta'ang rin chen rigs 'dra min mang po bud bzhin yod/ rin chen de dag da ltar nye 'khor du gzhi chags pa'i so nam pas mgul rgyan gyi () kha skad du gser lan pa dga' zer/ 167

'dan ma'i lo khyus gser gyi 'od thig sgrub chas shig rtsis te spud pa grangs las brjod dka'/yar gsom dang mar gsom gnyis kyi dkyil du dgon mthil zer ba dang / gnas de la mi bsod nams las dbang can dag gis dgon pa rngam brjid ldan pa dang gzan sham dmar po bklubs nas dgon gseb tu byon pa'i grwa pa mang po bcas mig zung du 'dren rgyu yod pa bshad/ de dang thag nye ba'i be rgan brag la o rgyan dang 〈bzang spyod〉kyi rang byon mjal rgyu yod pa/ de'i 〈bzang spyod〉〉la bltas nas tshar gcig bklags na 〈bzang spyod〉'bum gcig 'don pa dang phan yon mnyam pa gsungs/de'i g.yas su yar cung zad song na da lta'ang sbas yod pa'i gter rtags gnyis mchis khung bu zhig gi ngos na zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya'i rang byon dang pad ma'i rang byon 'bur/de la o rgyan rin po che'i phyag phreng gi rang byon yod par rang gi phreng ba sogs reg na byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab stsol ba gsungs/de nas gnas rgyab tu song na rdo rje phag mo'i 'khrungs rjes 168

'dan ma'i 'o sa gaber gyi 'od jig sam phag mo'i lte phrag chu 'go gnas yod pa de'i chab 'thung na phag mo'i dngos 'grub yod pa grags/chu'i mthar la sngo mtsho zer ba'i mtsho sngo shom shom zhig yod pa'i nang du sngo po dang khra bo/dmar bo bcas rigs mi 'dra ba'i nya khyu grangs las 'das/gnas der gzhi bdag she la mi ru tra zer ba'i ban rgan zhig yod pa ri 'dabs kyi sde ba yongs kyis gsol/ gzhi bdag de'i g.yas kyi rnam bcu dbang ldan gyi rang byon yod sa'i rma sras brag la da dung gnas sgo phye rgyu yod bcas rig 'dzin gter bdag gling pas gsungs/gnas chen 'di'i bskor lam ste dang po dung lung 'dabs sam lha lung nang nas ki ri la dang lags so sgang / sngo zer rdza rjokham bu rta ra/dhikhu byug la mo/ brag lung phug/dhimadzer khrus chu/du(bye rdza de gna' dus su 'od sngo po zhig 'tshe ba grags/() brag ri'i mthar bskor gyi rwa ba 'dra ba/(kye phag mo'i lte khrag chu 'go yin pa brjod/(kye gdong dang lag pa sogs mdzer pa bud yod na chu der khrus na drag pa'i nus ba ldan/ 169

'dan ma'i lo byus gser gyi 'od jig dngul chu tsha kha/dhidakar mo la rtse/du khra rdzong rdza bcas brgyud nas lha lung nang du slebs pa la bskor ba gcig yin/ de nas lung khog tu yar cung zad skyod na pha bong gcig gi thog nor bu dga' 'khyil dbyibs kyi bzang spyod kyi rang byon cha tshang mjal rgyu yod/ de'i gsham du stobs ldan karma rgyal dbang gis gnang bzhag pa'i ma ṇi mdzam gling g.yas bzhag yod/ da lta dung lung khag gi yul sde ba'i mis 'go 'dzugs byas nas rgya khyon che ru gtong bzhin yod pa/ gnas 'di ni lug gi lo la 'khor ba dang bskor ba gcig brgyab na sirnyi dung bcu gsum gyi phan yod pa grags/ dung lung nang ngam rigs gsum mgon pa'i gnas ri ni dung lung grong gi g.yon gyi le dbar gcig tsam gyi char brag dkar gyi mdun du phug pa zhig yod par lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes bde mchog gi sgrub pa mdzad de thog ma gnas sgo phyes/ bde mchog gis lha lung la gnang ba'i gsol chab la gnam mthil chu (bye der dngul gter zhig yod pa gna' dus su rgya mis dngul rdo nas dngul bzhu ba'i shul dang sgar shul sogs yod bas btags so/(kye la rtse 'di yang lha rje yi gzhi bdag cig yin pa dang lung pa de'i rtsi shing thams cad sman rtswa yin pas brjod/170
